## Create a business ruleset

<a id="opIdcreate_a_business_ruleset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/business_rulesets' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /business_rulesets`

Creates a business ruleset. A ruleset groups business rules so that they can be evaluated together, in the priority order you assign, using the strategy set in `execute_mode`.

Use this operation when a decision is made by several rules that belong together, such as all the checks that a quote must pass or the ladder of discounts that can apply to it. Once the ruleset exists, a single call to [Apply business rules](/docs/api/business_rules/apply-business-rules) with its `ruleset_id` evaluates all of its rules.

Passing `rules` is optional. You can create an empty ruleset and fill it later with [Add business rules to a ruleset](/docs/api/business_rulesets/add-business-rules-to-a-ruleset).  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* Business rules must be enabled for the site.
* Each rule referenced in `rules` must already exist.  

### Impacts

**Business ruleset**  
A business ruleset is created with `active` set to `false` and with the rules you passed in `rules` as its membership.

Nothing is evaluated yet. A rule is evaluated through a ruleset only when both the ruleset and the rule itself are `active`, so each one has to be activated separately.  

### Implementation Notes

* Create the rules first with [Create a business rule](/docs/api/business_rules/create-a-business-rule), then reference their identifiers in `rules`. A `rule_id` that does not resolve to an existing rule is rejected.
* Call [Activate a business ruleset](/docs/api/business_rulesets/activate-a-business-ruleset) once the membership is in place, so that Chargebee starts evaluating the ruleset.  

### Use Cases

Evaluate every rule in the group  
Leave `execute_mode` at its default of `execute_all`, or set it to `execute_all_true` if you only want the rules that matched to be returned. Use this when the rules are independent of one another, such as a set of validations that should all be reported.  
Pick the first rule that matches  
Set `execute_mode` to `stop_on_first_true` and assign the priorities so that the most specific rule is evaluated first. Evaluation stops at the first rule that matches, which makes the ruleset behave like an ordered list of alternatives.  
Stop at the first failed check  
Set `execute_mode` to `stop_on_first_false` so that evaluation stops at the first rule that is not satisfied. Use this when later rules only make sense if the earlier ones passed.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-a-business-ruleset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» id|body|string|false|Unique identifier for the business ruleset. If not provided, Chargebee generates one.<br>|
|» name|body|string|true|Display name of the business ruleset.<br>|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of what the business ruleset does.<br>|
|» execute_mode|body|string|false|Strategy that determines how the rules in the ruleset are evaluated and when evaluation stops.  <br>**Default value**<br><br>* `execute_all`.<br><br>* execute_all - Every rule in the ruleset is evaluated and all the results are returned. This is the default.<br>* stop_on_first_true - Evaluation stops as soon as a rule evaluates to `true`. The rules that come later in the evaluation order are not evaluated.<br>* execute_all_true - Every rule in the ruleset is evaluated, and only the rules that evaluated to `true` are returned.<br>* stop_on_first_false - Evaluation stops as soon as a rule evaluates to `false`. The rules that come later in the evaluation order are not evaluated.<br>|
|» rules|body|[object]|false|The [business rules](/docs/api/business_rules) that make up the ruleset, along with the priorities that determine their positions in its evaluation order. Each entry takes the `rule_id` of an existing business rule and an optional `priority`; when `priority` is omitted, it is assigned from the position of the entry in the array. Pass the list as a JSON array.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Each `rule_id` must belong to a business rule that already exists.<br>* A `priority` can be used by only one rule in the ruleset. Two entries that carry the same `priority` are rejected.<br><br>**Example →**<br>`rules = [{"rule_id":"custom-uuid-1","priority":1},{"rule_id":"custom-uuid-2","priority":2}]`<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|chargebee-event-actions|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-webhook|all-disabled|
|» execute_mode|stop_on_first_true|
|» execute_mode|stop_on_first_false|
|» execute_mode|execute_all|
|» execute_mode|execute_all_true|

## Activate a business ruleset

<a id="opIdactivate_a_business_ruleset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/business_rulesets/string/activate' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /business_rulesets/{business-ruleset-id}/activate`

Activates a business ruleset by setting its `active` attribute to `true`, so that Chargebee evaluates the rules it contains.  

### Impacts

**Business ruleset**  
The ruleset `active` attribute is set to `true`. Applying the ruleset with [Apply business rules](/docs/api/business_rules/apply-business-rules) evaluates the rules it contains, in their priority order, following the strategy in `execute_mode`.

Activating the ruleset does not activate its rules. A rule is evaluated through the ruleset only when the rule itself is also `active`.  

### Implementation Notes

Check the membership with [List rules in a business ruleset](/docs/api/business_rulesets/list-rules-in-a-business-ruleset) before calling this operation, and activate any rule that is still switched off with [Activate a business rule](/docs/api/business_rules/activate-a-business-rule). Otherwise the ruleset goes live evaluating only part of its membership.


<h3 id="activate-a-business-ruleset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|business-ruleset-id|path|string|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|

|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|

## Add business rules to a ruleset

<a id="opIdadd_business_rules_to_a_ruleset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/business_rulesets/string/add_rules' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /business_rulesets/{business-ruleset-id}/add_rules`

Adds one or more business rules to a ruleset without changing any of its other attributes. The rules are appended to the end of the ruleset's evaluation order, so you cannot choose their priorities here.

Use this operation to extend a ruleset that is already in use. Unlike [Update a business ruleset](/docs/api/business_rulesets/update-a-business-ruleset), it leaves the rules already in the ruleset in place, so you do not need to resend the whole membership.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* Each rule referenced in `rules` must already exist, and must not already belong to the ruleset.  

### Impacts

**Business ruleset**  
The rules are appended to the end of the ruleset's evaluation order, each given a priority above the highest priority already in use, and `updated_at` and `updated_by` are set. The rules already in the ruleset keep their priorities, and the `name`, `description`, `execute_mode`, and `active` attributes of the ruleset are unchanged.

A rule can belong to more than one ruleset, so adding it here does not remove it from any other ruleset. A rule added to an `active` ruleset is evaluated only once the rule itself is also `active`.  

### Implementation Notes

Confirm the resulting evaluation order with [List rules in a business ruleset](/docs/api/business_rulesets/list-rules-in-a-business-ruleset), because this operation appends rather than inserting at a position you choose. If the new rules need to be evaluated earlier, set every priority explicitly with [Update a business ruleset](/docs/api/business_rulesets/update-a-business-ruleset).


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="add-business-rules-to-a-ruleset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|business-ruleset-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» rules|body|[object]|false|The [business rules](/docs/api/business_rules) to add to the ruleset. Each entry takes the `rule_id` of an existing business rule. Pass the list as a JSON array.<br><br>To place a new rule earlier in the evaluation order, set the priorities explicitly with [Update a business ruleset](/docs/api/business_rulesets/update-a-business-ruleset) instead.  <br>**Impacts**<br><br>* Each rule is appended to the end of the ruleset's evaluation order, taking a priority above the highest already in use, in the order the entries appear in the array.<br>* Rules already in the ruleset keep their priorities.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Each `rule_id` must belong to a business rule that already exists.<br>* A rule that is already in the ruleset cannot be added again.<br><br>**Example →**<br>`rules = [{"rule_id":"custom-uuid-3"},{"rule_id":"custom-uuid-4"}]`<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-webhook|all-disabled|

```json
null
```

## List comments

<a id="opIdlist_comments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/comments' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /comments`

Retrieve the list of comments sorted by the recent ones on the top.

If you want to retrieve the list of comments for an [entity](/docs/api/v2/pcv-1/comments/list-comments), for example, subscription you can filter them by passing the entity type and unique identifier for that entity, for example, subscription ID.


<h3 id="list-comments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|

|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset`<br>to the value of `next_offset`<br>obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|entity_type|query|string|false|Type of the entity this comment generated for.<br><br>* item - Entity that represents item<br>* order - Entity that represents an order<br>* item_price - Entity that represents item price<br>* customer - Entity that represents a customer<br>* invoice - Invoice description<br>* business_entity - Entity that represents item of type business entity<br>* plan - Entity that represents a subscription plan<br>* price_variant - Entity that represents a price variant<br>* coupon - Entity that represents a discount coupon<br>* subscription - Entity that represents a subscription of a customer<br>* item_family - Entity that represents item family<br>* transaction - Entity that represents a transaction.<br>* addon - Entity that represents an addon<br>* credit_note - Credit note description<br>* quote - Entity that represents a quote<br>|
|entity_id|query|string|false|Unique identifier of the entity.<br>|
|created_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>The time at which this comment was created.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*created_at\[on\] = "1456332678"*<br>|
|sort_by|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Sorts based on the specified attribute.<br>**Supported attributes :**<br>created_at<br><br>**Supported sort-orders :**<br>asc, desc<br><br>**Example →**<br>*sort_by\[asc\] = "created_at"*<br><br>This will sort the result based on the 'created_at' attribute in ascending(earliest first) order.<br>|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-coupons">coupons</h1>

Overview -------- Coupons are deductions applied to invoices or invoice line items.

## List coupons

<a id="opIdlist_coupons"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/coupons' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /coupons`

List all the available coupons that are created for a specific promotion or offers. You can find list of coupon codes that are currently active, expired, archived or deleted.


<h3 id="list-coupons-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset`<br>to the value of `next_offset`<br>obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Used to uniquely identify the coupon in your website/application and to integrate with Chargebee.  <br>**Note:**<br><br>When the coupon ID contains a special character; for example: `#`, the API returns an error. Make sure that you [encode](https://www.urlencoder.org/) the coupon ID in the path parameter before making an API call.<br><br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*id\[is\] = "OFF2008"*<br>|
|name|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>The display name used in web interface for identifying the coupon.  <br>**Note:**<br><br>When the name of the coupon set contains a special character; for example: `#`, the API returns an error. Make sure that you [encode](https://www.urlencoder.org/) the name of the coupon set in the path parameter before making an API call.<br><br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*name\[is_not\] = "Offer 10"*<br>|
|discount_type|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>The type of deduction. Possible values are : fixed_amount, percentage.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*discount_type\[is\] = "fixed_amount"*<br>|
|duration_type|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Specifies the time duration for which this coupon is attached to the subscription. Possible values are : one_time, forever, limited_period.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*duration_type\[is\] = "forever"*<br>|
|status|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Status of the coupon. Possible values are : active, expired, archived, deleted.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*status\[is_not\] = "active"*<br>|
|apply_on|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>The amount on the invoice to which the coupon is applied. Possible values are : invoice_amount, each_specified_item.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*apply_on\[is\] = "invoice_amount"*<br>|
|created_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>Timestamp indicating when this coupon is created.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*created_at\[before\] = "145222875"*<br>|
|updated_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>To filter based on updated at. This attribute will be present only if the resource has been updated after 2016-11-09.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*updated_at\[on\] = "1243545465"*<br>|
|sort_by|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Sorts based on the specified attribute.<br>**Supported attributes :**<br>created_at<br><br>**Supported sort-orders :**<br>asc, desc<br><br>**Example →**<br>*sort_by\[asc\] = "created_at"*<br><br>This will sort the result based on the 'created_at' attribute in ascending(earliest first) order.<br>|
|currency_code|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>The currency code ([ISO 4217 format](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/supported-currencies.html)<br>) of the coupon. Applicable for *fixed_amount*<br>coupons alone.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*currency_code\[is\] = "USD"*<br>|
|applicable_item_price_ids|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>List of itemPrice ids for which these coupons are applicable.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>in, is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*applicable_item_price_ids\[is\] = "day-pass-USD"*<br>|

`POST /coupons/{coupon-id}/update_for_items`

This API updates a coupon that is created for a specific promotion or offers.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="update-a-coupon-for-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|coupon-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|The display name used in web interface for identifying the coupon.  <br>**Note:**<br><br>When the name of the coupon set contains a special character; for example: `#`, the API returns an error. Make sure that you [encode](https://www.urlencoder.org/) the name of the coupon set in the path parameter before making an API call.<br><br>.<br>|
|» invoice_name|body|string|false|Display name used in invoice. If it is not configured then name is used in invoice.<br>|
|» discount_type|body|string|false|Specifies the type of discount to be applied.<br><br>* percentage -<br>  A percentage of the original price is deducted as a discount. The discount percentage is specified in [discount_percentage](/docs/api/coupons/update-a-coupon-for-items#discount_percentage).  <br>  [Learn more](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/coupons.html#percentage-coupons)<br>  about `percentage`<br>  coupons.<br>* fixed_amount -<br>  A fixed amount is deducted as a discount. The discount amount is specified in [discount_amount](/docs/api/coupons/update-a-coupon-for-items#discount_amount).  <br>  [Learn more](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/coupons.html#fixed-amount-coupons)<br>  about `fixed_amount`<br>  coupons.<br>* offer_quantity -<br>  A specified number of units of the item price are offered for free. The number of free units is specified in [discount_quantity](/docs/api/coupons/update-a-coupon-for-items#discount_quantity).<br>  The `offer_quantity`<br>  option is valid only when [apply_on](/docs/api/coupons/update-a-coupon-for-items#apply_on)<br>  is set to `each_specified_item`<br>  and the [pricing_model](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#pricing_model)<br>  of the item price is `per_unit`.  <br>  [Learn more](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/coupons.html#offer-quantity-coupons)<br>  about `offer_quantity`<br>  coupons.<br>|
|» discount_amount|body|integer(int64)|false|The value of the deduction. The format of this value depends on the [kind of currency](/docs/api/currencies)<br>.<br>|
|» currency_code|body|string|false|The currency code ([ISO 4217 format](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/supported-currencies.html)<br>) of the coupon. Applicable for *fixed_amount*<br>coupons alone.<br>|
|» discount_percentage|body|number(double)|false|The percentage of the original amount that should be deducted from it.<br>|
|» discount_quantity|body|integer(int32)|false|Specifies the number of free units provided for the [item price](/docs/api/item_prices)<br>, without affecting the total quantity sold. This parameter is applicable only when the [discount_type](/docs/api/coupons/update-a-coupon-for-items#discount_type)<br>is set to `offer_quantity`<br>.<br>|
|» apply_on|body|string|false|The amount on the invoice to which the coupon is applied.<br><br>* invoice_amount -<br>  The coupon is applied to the invoice `sub_total`<br>  .<br>* each_specified_item -<br>  Applies the coupon to specified items (plans, addons, or charges), with the discount applied to each matching `invoice.line_item.amount`.<br><br>  Requires applicability to be configured using [`item_constraints`](/docs/api/coupons/update-a-coupon-for-items#item_constraints)---for example `all`, `criteria`, or `specific` with `item_price_ids`.<br><br>  When you attach this coupon to a subscription, at least one of that subscription's plans, addons, or charges must match those rules. If none do, the request fails.<br>|
|» duration_type|body|string|false|Specifies the time duration for which this coupon is attached to the subscription.<br><br>* forever - The coupon is attached to the subscription and applied on the invoices until explicitly removed.<br>* one_time -<br>  The coupon stays attached to the subscription till it is applied on an invoice **once**.<br>  It is removed after that from the subscription.<br>* limited_period -<br>  The discount is attached to the subscription and applied on the invoices for a limited duration. This duration starts from the point it is applied to an invoice for the first time and expires after a period specified by `period`<br>  and `period_unit`<br>  .<br>|
|» duration_month|body|integer(int32)|false|**(Deprecated)**<br>The duration of time in months for which the coupon is attached to the subscription. ## Delete a coupon

<a id="opIddelete_a_coupon"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/coupons/string/delete' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /coupons/{coupon-id}/delete`

If no Subscriptions/Invoices are linked to this Coupon, the Coupon will be deleted from your Chargebee site. This action cannot be undone.

To ensure that existing Subscriptions/Invoices are not affected, Coupons associated with them will not be deleted, but moved to "Archived" state. Once a Coupon has been archived, it cannot be edited or used again unless [unarchived](/docs/api/coupons/unarchive-a-coupon). Unused Coupons codes are deleted.

## Copy a coupon

<a id="opIdcopy_a_coupon"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/coupons/copy' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /coupons/copy`

Copies a coupon over from one site to another. Copying of [archived](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#status) coupons is not supported.

The item prices that are linked to the coupon in the source site are also linked to the coupon in the destination site. However, this will only work if those item prices exist and with the same [ids](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#id), in the destination site. Hence, it is recommended that the item prices be copied over before copying the coupons.

The value for [redemptions](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#redemptions) is not copied. It is set to `0` for the newly created coupon. Hence, if such a coupon had `expired` in the source site due to `redemptions` having reached [max_redemptions](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#max_redemptions), it's [status](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#status) would be `active` in the destination site.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="copy-a-coupon-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» from_site|body|string|true|Your Chargebee site name having the coupon to be copied.<br>**Note:**<br>Unless you are copying from a twin site (acme \& acme-test are twin sites), [contact support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support)<br>to have this allow-listed.<br>|
|» id_at_from_site|body|string|true|Id of the coupon to be copied. The new coupon created in this site will have the same Id.<br>|
|» id|body|string|false|Id of copied coupon in this site.<br>|
|» for_site_merging|body|boolean|false|If copy action is performed as part of Chargebee site merge action, pass the value as true.<br>**Note:**<br>If this parameter is passed true coupon state, redemptions, coupon set and coupon codes associated with this coupon will be copied.<br>|

|» apply_on|body|string|true|The amount on the invoice to which the coupon is applied.<br><br>* invoice_amount -<br>  The coupon is applied to the invoice `sub_total`<br>  .<br>* each_specified_item -<br>  Applies the coupon to specified items (plans, addons, or charges), with the discount applied to each matching `invoice.line_item.amount`.<br><br>  Requires applicability to be configured using [`item_constraints`](/docs/api/coupons/create-a-coupon-for-items#item_constraints)---for example `all`, `criteria`, or `specific` with `item_price_ids`.<br><br>  When you attach this coupon to a subscription, at least one of that subscription's plans, addons, or charges must match those rules. <h1 id="chargebee-api-creditnotes">credit_notes</h1>

A [Credit Note](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/credit-notes.html) is a document that specifies the money owed by a business to its customer.

## Record refund for a credit note

<a id="opIdrecord_refund_for_a_credit_note"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes/string/record_refund' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /credit_notes/{credit-note-id}/record_refund`

Records a refund for a refundable credit note.

This API does not process an actual refund for online payments by returning money to customers.

Use this API to record refunds processed outside Chargebee (for example, directly through a payment gateway or via offline methods such as bank transfers or checks) so you can reconcile them in Chargebee.

To process refunds via Chargebee for online payments and automatically return money to customers, use the [Refund a credit note](/docs/api/credit_notes/refund-a-credit-note) API instead.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* The credit note [`type`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#type) must be `refundable`.
* The credit note [`status`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#status) must be `refund_due`.  

### Impacts

**Transactions**  
Chargebee records the refunds by creating transactions of [`type`](/docs/api/transactions/transaction-object#type) `refund` and links them to the credit note. The refund transactions are recorded in the following order:

1. [`linked_payments`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_payments) of the invoice associated with the credit note. This is recorded as [`linked_refunds[]`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#linked_refunds) in the credit note.
2. [`linked_taxes_withheld`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_taxes_withheld) (if available). This is recorded as [`linked_tax_withheld_refunds[]`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#linked_tax_withheld_refunds) in the credit note.  

### Implementation Notes

Before using this API, ensure:

* The credit note [`type`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#type) is `refundable`.
* The credit note [`status`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#status) is `refund_due`.
* If [reason codes](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/site-configuration/reason-codes#managing-reason-codes-for-credit-notes) are mandatory in Chargebee Billing, include the `refund_reason_code` parameter with a value from the configured list of codes.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

## Import credit note

<a id="opIdimport_credit_note"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes/import_credit_note' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /credit_notes/import_credit_note`

Imports a credit note into Chargebee Billing. This endpoint allows you to import a credit note from external systems, such as accounting software, into Chargebee.

Use this operation during data migration or reconciliation to ensure historical credits are represented in the system. The credit note is linked to a reference [invoice](/docs/api/invoices) and can be allocated to other invoices or recorded as refunded to the customer.  

### Impacts

**Credit Note**  
The credit note's [`billing_address`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit-note-object#credit_note_billing_address), [`shipping_address`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit-note-object#credit_note_shipping_address), and [`vat_number`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit-note-object#credit_note_vat_number) are copied from the reference invoice.  
**Invoices**  

##### Reference invoice

* See [Impact on reference invoice](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit-note-object#ref-invoice-impact).

##### Other invoices

* If `allocations[]` are provided, then for each allocated invoice:
  * the invoice's `amount_due` decreases by the allocated amount
  * the invoice `status` changes to `paid` if the `amount_due` becomes zero
* an [applied credit](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#applied_credits) record is created to track the allocation.  
**Transactions**  
If `linked_refunds[]` are provided, then for each refund provided, a [`transaction`](/docs/api/transactions/transaction-object) of `type` `refund` is created with `status` set to `success`.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|

|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|

|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» id|body|string|true|The unique identifier for the credit note (credit note number).  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Must not conflict with existing credit note numbers in your Chargebee Billing site.<br>* Must not conflict with future credit note numbers that your Chargebee Billing site may [generate](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/invoices-credit-notes-and-quotes/invoice-numbering).<br>|
|» customer_id|body|string|false|The unique identifier of the customer for whom the credit note is created.  <br>**Required if**<br><br>* `subscription_id` is not provided.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Must match the [customer](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#invoice_customer_id) of the `reference_invoice_id`.<br>|

|» reference_invoice_id|body|string|true|The unique identifier of the invoice against which this credit note is issued. The invoice must already exist in your Chargebee Billing site.<br>|
|» type|body|string|true|The credit note type. Determines how the credit note can be used. [Learn more](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit-note-object#credit_note_types) about credit note types.<br><br>* refundable - Refundable credit note.<br>* store -<br>  Store credit note.  <br>  **Constraints**<br><br>  * The `type` value `store` is not supported for this API operation.<br>* adjustment - Adjustment credit note.<br>|
|» currency_code|body|string|false|The currency code ([ISO 4217](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) format) for the credit note.  <br>**Required if**<br><br>* [Multi-currency pricing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/site-configuration/multi-currency-pricing) is enabled for the site and `customer_id` is provided.<br>|
|» create_reason_code|body|string|true|The [reason code](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/site-configuration/reason-codes#managing-reason-codes-for-credit-notes) for creating the credit note.  <br>**Required if**<br><br>* Reason codes are mandatory in Chargebee Billing.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Must be a valid and enabled reason code from the list configured in Chargebee Billing.<br>* The reason code can also be from **Refund Credit Note** reason codes.<br>* The codes are case-sensitive.<br>|
|» date|body|integer(unix-time)|true|The date when the credit note was issued.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Must be a date in the past.<br>* Must be after the [`date`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#invoice_date) of the reference invoice.<br>|

## Delete a credit note

<a id="opIddelete_a_credit_note"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes/string/delete' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /credit_notes/{credit-note-id}/delete`

This API [deletes a credit note.](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/credit-notes.html#voiding-or-deleting-a-credit-note) A credit note once deleted, is deleted permanently. You cannot delete a credit which has already been deleted or refunded. If you try to delete a refunded or deleted credit note, an error message will be displayed.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="delete-a-credit-note-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

## Send an einvoice for credit notes

<a id="opIdsend_an_einvoice_for_credit_notes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes/string/send_einvoice' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /credit_notes/{credit-note-id}/send_einvoice`

This endpoint is used to send an e-invoice for invoice.
To support cases like TDS and invoice edits, we need to stop auto e-invoice sending and be able to send e-invoices manually.
This endpoint schedules e-invoices manually. This operation is not allowed when any of the following condition matches:

* If e-invoicing is not enabled at the site and customer level.

* If there is an e-invoice generated already for the invoice.

* If the **Use automatic e-invoicing** option is selected.

* If there are no generated e-invoices with the `failed` or `skipped` status.

* If the invoice status is `voided` or `pending`.

## Void a credit note

<a id="opIdvoid_a_credit_note"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes/string/void' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /credit_notes/{credit-note-id}/void`

Void or invalidate the specified credit note.

Use this operation for incorrectly generated credit notes, such as those with wrong details or created by mistake. This is a preferred method over [deleting the credit note](/docs/api/credit_notes/delete-a-credit-note), as it preserves the audit trail, allowing for future reference and compliance without removing the original record.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* The credit note `status` must not be `refunded` or `voided`.
* For credit notes of `type` `refundable`, you must remove any allocations or linked refunds before voiding it. Note that only offline refunds can be removed; online refunds cannot.

See **Implementation Notes** for more details.  

### Impacts

**Invoices**  
If the credit note `type` is `adjustment`, the associated invoice `status` changes to `not_paid`, and the `amount_due` on the invoice increases by the amount that was allocated via the credit note.  

### Implementation Notes

Before calling this API, ensure the following:

* The credit note [`status`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#status) must not be `refunded` or `voided`.
* For credit notes of [`type`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#type) `refundable`:
  * Remove any [allocations](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#allocations) of the credit note to invoices by calling the [Remove credit note from an invoice API](/docs/api/invoices/remove-credit-note-from-an-invoice).
* Remove any [linked offline refunds](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#linked_refunds) by calling the [Delete an offline transaction API](/docs/api/transactions/delete-an-offline-transaction).  

#### Related APIs

[Delete a credit note](/docs/api/credit_notes?prod_cat_ver=2#delete_a_credit_note)


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|

## Refund a credit note

<a id="opIdrefund_a_credit_note"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes/string/refund' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /credit_notes/{credit-note-id}/refund`

Refunds a specified amount from a refundable credit note back to the customer's payment source.

This operation supports only refunds against online payments. The refund amount is returned to the customer through the [`payment_source`](/docs/api/payment_sources) associated with the transaction. If multiple transactions are associated with the credit note, call this API once for each transaction.

To record offline refunds, including those for [`linked_taxes_withheld`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_taxes_withheld), use the [Record refund for a credit note](/docs/api/credit_notes/refund-a-credit-note) API.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* The credit note [`type`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#type) is `refundable`.
* The credit note [`status`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#status) is `refund_due`.
* The credit note has an `amount_available` greater than 0.
* Part or all of the credit note's `amount_available` is from online payments.
* The credit note is not [standalone](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/invoices-credit-notes-and-quotes/credit-notes#creating-standalone-credits); it has an associated invoice.
* You can process partial refunds only if the associated payment gateway supports partial refund operations.  

### Impacts

**Credit note**  
* The credit note's `amount_available` is reduced by the refunded amount.
* The credit note's `status` is updated to `refunded` if the refunded amount is equal to the credit note's `amount_available`.
* The credit note's [`linked_refunds`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#linked_refunds) is updated with the details of the refund transaction.  
**Transaction**  
Chargebee creates a transaction of [`type`](/docs/api/transactions/transaction-object#type) `refund` and links it to the credit note under `credit_note.linked_refunds`.  

### Implementation Notes

Before you call this API, make sure the following conditions are met:

* The credit note [`type`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#type) is `refundable`.
* The credit note [`status`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#status) is `refund_due`.
* The credit note has an `amount_available` greater than 0.
* The credit note has the `reference_invoice_id` set.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|credit-note-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» refund_amount|body|integer(int64)|false|The amount to be refunded.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* If multiple [transactions](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_payments) are associated with the credit note, the refund can be processed only for one transaction at a time.<br>* Offline refunds, including those for [`linked_taxes_withheld`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_taxes_withheld), cannot be refunded via this operation. Use the [Record refund for a credit note](/docs/api/credit_notes/refund-a-credit-note) API instead.  <br>**Default behavior**<br><br>* If not specified, the `amount_available` for this credit note is implied.<br>|

Must be one from a list of reason codes set in the Chargebee app in **Settings \> Configure Chargebee \> Reason Codes \> Credit Notes \> Refund Credit Note**.<br>Must be passed if set as mandatory in the app. The codes are case-sensitive.<br>|

The following reason codes are supported now\[Deprecated; use the [create_reason_code](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#create_reason_code)<br>parameter instead\]. Possible values are : write_off, subscription_change, subscription_cancellation, subscription_pause, chargeback, product_unsatisfactory, service_unsatisfactory, order_change, order_cancellation, waiver, other, fraudulent.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*reason_code\[is\] = "waiver"*<br>|
|create_reason_code|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Reason code for creating the credit note. Must be one from a list of reason codes set in the Chargebee app in **Settings \> Configure Chargebee \> Reason Codes \> Credit Notes \> Create Credit Note** .<br>Must be passed if set as mandatory in the app. The codes are case-sensitive.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*create_reason_code\[is\] = "Other"*<br>|
|status|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>The credit note status. Possible values are : adjusted, refunded, refund_due, voided.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*status\[is\] = "adjusted"*<br>|
|date|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>The date the Credit Note is issued.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*date\[on\] = "1435054328"*<br>|
|total|query|object|false|optional, in cents filter<br><br>Credit Note amount in cents.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, lt, lte, gt, gte, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*total\[is\] = "1200"*<br>|
|price_type|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>The price type of the Credit Note. Possible values are : tax_exclusive, tax_inclusive.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*price_type\[is_not\] = "tax_exclusive"*<br>|
|amount_allocated|query|object|false|optional, in cents filter<br><br>The amount allocated to the invoices.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, lt, lte, gt, gte, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*amount_allocated\[is\] = "1200"*<br>|
|amount_refunded|query|object|false|optional, in cents filter<br><br>The refunds issued from this Credit Note.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, lt, lte, gt, gte, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*amount_refunded\[lte\] = "130"*<br>|
|amount_available|query|object|false|optional, in cents filter<br><br>The yet to be used credits of this Credit Note.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, lt, lte, gt, gte, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*amount_available\[gt\] = "1400"*<br>|
|voided_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>Timestamp indicating the date and time this Credit Note gets voided.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*voided_at\[before\] = "1435054328"*<br>|

|sort_by|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Sorts based on the specified attribute.<br>**Supported attributes :**<br>date<br><br>**Supported sort-orders :**<br>asc, desc<br><br>**Example →**<br>*sort_by\[asc\] = "date"*<br><br>This will sort the result based on the 'date' attribute in ascending(earliest first) order.<br>|

## Create credit note

<a id="opIdcreate_credit_note"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /credit_notes`

Creates a credit note for the specified invoice.  

### Impacts

**Invoice**  
See [Impact on reference invoice](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit-note-object#ref-invoice-impact).  
**Credit note**  
* A new credit note of the specified `type` is created.
* If the credit note `type` is `adjustment`:
  * `total` and `amount_allocated` are set to the adjusted amount.
  * `status` is set to `adjusted`.
* If the credit note `type` is `refundable` or `store`:
  * `total` and `amount_available` are set to the refundable amount.
  * `status` is set to `refund_due`.
* The `taxes[].amount` and `line_item_taxes[].tax_amount` are set to the corresponding values on the invoice, prorated by the ratio of `credit_note.total` to `invoice.total`.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-credit-note-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» reference_invoice_id|body|string|false|The identifier of the invoice against which this credit note is issued.  <br>**Required when**<br><br>* `type` is `adjustment` or `store`.  <br>**Note**<br>When not provided and `type` is `refundable`, then `customer_id` must be provided because this creates a [standalone credit note](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/invoices-credit-notes-and-quotes/credit-notes#standalone-credits).<br>|
|» customer_id|body|string|false|The identifier of the customer for whom this credit note is issued.  <br>**Required when**<br><br>* `type` is `refundable` and `reference_invoice_id` is not provided. This creates a [standalone credit note](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/invoices-credit-notes-and-quotes/credit-notes#standalone-credits).<br>|
|» total|body|integer(int64)|false|The total credit note amount.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Pass either the `total` or `line_items` parameter.<br>* If `type` is `adjustment`, `total` must not exceed the amount due on the invoice minus the total amount of any transactions in progress for the invoice. Calculate this as `invoice.amount_due` minus the sum of `invoice.linked_payments[i].amount` where `invoice.linked_payments[i].txn_status` is `in_progress`.<br>* If `type` is `refundable` or `store`:<br>  * If `reference_invoice_id` is provided, `total` must not exceed the refundable amount on the invoice. Calculate the refundable amount as the sum of:<br>    * Sum of `linked_payments[i].amount` where `linked_payments[i].txn_status` is `success`<br>    * Sum of `applied_credits[i].applied_amount` where `applied_credits[i].status` is not `voided`<br>    * Sum of `linked_taxes_withheld[].amount`<br>    * Minus the sum of `issued_credit_notes[i].cn_total` where `issued_credit_notes[i].status` is not `voided`<br>  * If `reference_invoice_id` is not provided, there is no limit on the `total` because this creates a [standalone credit note](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/invoices-credit-notes-and-quotes/credit-notes#standalone-credits).<br>|
|» type|body|string|true|The [type](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit-note-object) of credit note to create.  <br>**Prerequisites**<br><br>* If `type` is `adjustment`, the `invoice.status` must be `payment_due`, `posted` or `not_paid`.<br>* If `type` is `refundable` or `store`, the `invoice.status` must be `paid`, `payment_due`, `posted`, or `not_paid`.<br><br>* refundable -<br>  Creates a refundable credit note.  <br>  **Prerequisites**<br><br>  * The `invoice.status` must be `paid`, `payment_due`, `posted`, or `not_paid`.<br>* store -<br>  Creates a store credit note.  <br>  **Prerequisites**<br><br>  * The `invoice.status` must be `paid`, `payment_due`, `posted`, or `not_paid`.<br>* adjustment -<br>  Creates an adjustment credit note.  <br>  **Prerequisites**<br><br>  * The `invoice.status` must be `payment_due`, `posted` or `not_paid`.<br>|
|» reason_code|body|string|false|The reason for issuing this Credit Note. The following reason codes are supported now\[Deprecated; use the [create_reason_code](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#create_reason_code)<br>parameter instead\].<br><br>* waiver - Waiver<br>* order_cancellation - Order Cancellation<br>* order_change - Order Change<br>* product_unsatisfactory - Product Unsatisfactory<br>* service_unsatisfactory - Service Unsatisfactory<br>* other - Can be set when none of the above reason codes are applicable<br>|
|» create_reason_code|body|string|false|Reason code for creating the credit note.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Must be one of the case-sensitive [reason codes](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/site-configuration/reason-codes#managing-reason-codes-for-credit-notes) set in Chargebee Billing.  <br>**Required when**<br><br>* Reason codes are configured as mandatory on the site.<br>|
|» date|body|integer(unix-time)|false|The date on which the credit note is issued.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Must be on or after the `invoice.date` and cannot be a future date.<br>|
|» customer_notes|body|string|false|A note to be added for this operation, to the credit note. This note is displayed on customer-facing documents such as the [Credit Note PDF](/docs/api/credit_notes/retrieve-credit-note-as-pdf)<br>.<br>|
|» currency_code|body|string|false|The currency code (ISO 4217 format) for the credit note. It is required for a standalone credit note if Multicurrency is enabled.<br>|
|» comment|body|string|false|An internal [comment](/docs/api/comments)<br>to be added for this operation, to the credit note. This comment is displayed on the Chargebee UI. It is not displayed on any customer-facing [Hosted Page](/docs/api/hosted_pages)<br>or any document such as the [Credit Note PDF](/docs/api/credit_notes/retrieve-credit-note-as-pdf)<br>.<br>|
|» line_items|body|object|false|Parameters for line_items<br>|
|» » reference_line_item_id|body|[string]|false|Uniquely identifies a line_item<br>|
|» » unit_amount|body|[integer(int64)]|false|Unit amount of the line item. Required for FLAT_FEE, PER_UNIT and VOLUME pricing model.<br>|
|» » unit_amount_in_decimal|body|[string]|false|The decimal representation of the unit amount of the `line_item`.<br>The value is in major units of the currency. Applicable for the line_item when the `pricing_model`<br>is `flat_fee`<br>, `per_unit`<br>or `volume`.<br>Can be provided only when [multi-decimal pricing](/docs/api/currencies)<br>is enabled.<br>|
|» » quantity|body|[integer(int32)]|false|Quantity of the line item. Required for PER_UNIT and VOLUME pricing model.<br>|
|» » quantity_in_decimal|body|[string]|false|The decimal representation of the quantity of the `line_item`.<br>Applicable for the `line_item`<br>when the `pricing_model`<br>is `per_unit`<br>and `volume`.<br>Can be provided only when [multi-decimal pricing](/docs/api/currencies)<br>is enabled.<br>|
|» » amount|body|[integer(int64)]|false|Amount of the line item. Applicable only for STAIRSTEP, TIERED pricing_model.<br>|
|» » date_from|body|[integer(unix-time)]|false|Start date of this line item.<br>|
|» » date_to|body|[integer(unix-time)]|false|End date of this line item.<br>|
|» » description|body|[string]|false|Description for the line item.<br>|
|» » entity_type|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » entity_id|body|[string]|false|none|

## Update Credit Note Details

<a id="opIdupdate_credit_note_details"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes/string/update' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /credit_notes/{credit-note-id}/update`

Updates the [custom fields](/docs/api/advanced-features#custom-fields) and comment of a [credit note](/docs/api/credit_notes).

Use this operation to add or change custom field values, or to attach an internal comment, without modifying other credit note attributes. Pass at least one credit note custom field or `comment`; otherwise the credit note is returned unchanged.  

### Impacts

**Credit note**  
* Updates any credit note [custom fields](/docs/api/advanced-features#custom-fields) included in the request. Existing custom field values that you omit from the request are left unchanged.
* Adds an internal [comment](/docs/api/comments) when you pass `comment`.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|credit-note-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» comment|body|string|false|An internal [comment](/docs/api/comments)<br>to be added for this operation, to the credit note. This comment is displayed on the Chargebee UI. It is not displayed on any customer-facing [Hosted Page](/docs/api/hosted_pages)<br>or any document such as the [Credit Note PDF](/docs/api/credit_notes/retrieve-credit-note-as-pdf)<br>.<br>|

## Download e-invoice for credit note

<a id="opIddownload_e-invoice_for_credit_note"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes/string/download_einvoice' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /credit_notes/{credit-note-id}/download_einvoice`

Download the e-invoice for the credit note in both XML and PDF formats. The response consists of a `download` object for each format. The XML format follows the [structure as per Peppol BIS Billing v3.0](https://docs.peppol.eu/poacc/billing/3.0/syntax/ubl-creditnote/tree/).  
**Note**

* You can only download e-invoices when their `status` is `success` or `registered`.
* There are some cases in which the PDF is not available for download. In such cases, you can obtain it from the XML by decoding the value for [cbc:EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject](https://docs.peppol.eu/poacc/billing/3.0/syntax/ubl-creditnote/cac-AdditionalDocumentReference/cac-Attachment/cbc-EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject/), which is the Base64-encoded version of the PDF.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|credit-note-id|path|string|true|none|

## Send Credit Note Email

<a id="opIdsend_credit_note_email"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_notes/string/send_email' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -H 'Prefer: respond-async' \
  -H 'chargebee-request-id: 7c9e2f4a-8b1d-4e6f-9a0c-3d5e7f9b1c2d' \
  -H 'chargebee-async-callback-url: https://username:password@example.com'
```

`POST /credit_notes/{credit-note-id}/send_email`

Sends the credit note email to the customer using the site's published **Send Credit Note Email** Engage notification template.

Use this operation to resend or manually trigger the credit note email for a customer outside the normal notification schedule.  
**Async-only**
This operation is [asynchronous only](/docs/api/async_response). You must send `Prefer: respond-async`, a unique `chargebee-request-id`, and a `chargebee-async-callback-url`. The HTTP response is `202 Accepted` with an empty body. When processing completes, Chargebee delivers the outcome to your [async callback URL](/docs/api/async_response) --- a successful `result` contains [`email_logs`](/docs/api/email_logs).  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* Email Engage V2 must be enabled for the site.
* The **Send Credit Note Email** notification template must be published and enabled.
* The from address configured for the notification template must be verified.
* The customer associated with the credit note must have a valid email address.
* The credit note `status` must not be `voided`.
* The credit note `reason_code` must not be `write_off`.  

#### Related APIs

[List email logs for a customer](/docs/api/email_logs?prod_cat_ver=2#list_email_logs_for_a_customer)


<h3 id="send-credit-note-email-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|Prefer|header|string|true|Must be set to `respond-async`. Instructs Chargebee to process the request asynchronously and return `202 Accepted` immediately.|
|chargebee-request-id|header|string|true|A client-generated unique identifier (UUID recommended) for this request. Echoed back as `request.id` in the async callback payload, allowing you to correlate each callback to its originating request.|
|chargebee-async-callback-url|header|string(uri)|true|The callback URL where Chargebee will `POST` the async result. Must be an `https://` URL and may embed basic-auth credentials, e.g. `https://username:password@example.com`.|
|credit-note-id|path|string|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-webhook|all-disabled|

<a id="opIdarchive_a_credit_unit"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/credit_units/string/archive_command' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /credit_units/{credit-unit-id}/archive_command`

Archives an `active` credit unit. Once archived, the credit unit can no longer be used to create grant configurations for items and grant configuration overrides for subscriptions. Any grants that were already configured for this credit unit will continue to be effective.

## Add a new currency

<a id="opIdadd_a_new_currency"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/currencies' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /currencies`

This API is used to add a new currency to your Chargebee site. Prior to using this API, ensure that the [multi-currency feature](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/multi-currency-pricing.html#1-adding-and-managing-currencies)
is enabled.
If the `forex_type`
is set to `manual`
, you can specify the `manual_exchange_rate`
. Additionally, the currency code provided must adhere to the three-letter ISO standard currency codes.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="add-a-new-currency-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» currency_code|body|string|true|A three letter currency code. For example, GBR, INR, and more.<br>|
|» forex_type|body|string|true|This represents the exchange rate type set for the currency.<br><br>* auto -<br>  If `forex_type`<br>  is `auto`<br>  , conversion rate will be auto updated by Chargebee every day with third party providers (using external currency conversion providers)<br>* manual -<br>  If `forex_type`<br>  is `manual`<br>  , you will be able to set the conversion rate for the currency. You need to update the exchange rate each time your exchange rate provider changes it<br>|
|» manual_exchange_rate|body|string|false|This parameter allows you to pass the exchange rate in decimal format. When `forex_type`<br>is `manual`<br>you have to set the exchange rate for additional currencies in `manual_exchange_rate`<br>parameter. A maximum of **nine**<br>decimal values are allowed to pass in this field.<br>|

|chargebee-event-actions|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-webhook|all-disabled|

|» forex_type|auto|

.

<h1 id="chargebee-api-customers">customers</h1>

Represents a customer, which can be an individual or organization that subscribes to your products or services.

## Import a subscription

<a id="opIdimport_subscription_for_items"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/customers/string/import_for_items' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /customers/{customer-id}/import_for_items`

Imports a [subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions) for an existing [customer](/docs/api/customers).

Use this operation when migrating subscriptions from another billing system.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

If you are calling this operation on your live site, ensure you have [requested Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support) to enable it; otherwise the API may return an "API not enabled" error.  

### Impacts

**Subscription**  
A subscription is created for the customer with the details provided in the request.  
**Invoice and payment**  
When `create_current_term_invoice` is `true`, an invoice is created for the current term.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="import-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|customer-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» exhausted_coupon_ids|body|[string]|false|Specifies the IDs of [coupons](/docs/api/coupons)<br>to be marked as exhausted. ## Create a subscription

<a id="opIdcreate_subscription_for_items"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/customers/string/subscription_for_items' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /customers/{customer-id}/subscription_for_items`

**Note:**
This endpoint optionally supports 3DS. To use it [create](/docs/api/payment_intents/create-a-payment-intent)
a `payment_intent`
and provide it via this endpoint.

Creates a new subscription for an existing customer in Chargebee. Any available [credits and excess payments](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#balances) for the customer are automatically applied on the invoice.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
