<h1 id="chargebee-api-features">features</h1>

Subscriptions are created in Chargebee using items.

## List features

<a id="opIdlist_features"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/features' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /features`

Retrieves a list of features meeting **all**
the conditions specified in the filter parameters.


<h3 id="list-features-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset`<br>to the value of `next_offset`<br>obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|name|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>A case-sensitive unique name for the feature. For example: `user license`<br>, `data storage`<br>, `Salesforce Integration`<br>, `devices`<br>, `UHD Streaming`<br>, and so on.<br><br>**Note:**<br>This name is not displayed on any customer-facing documents or pages such as [invoice PDFs](/docs/api/invoices/retrieve-invoice-as-pdf)<br>or [hosted pages](/docs/api/hosted_pages).<br>However, in the future, it is likely to be introduced on the [Self-Serve Portal](/docs/api/portal_sessions)<br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*name\[is\] = "User licenses"*<br>|
|id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>A unique and immutable identifier for the feature. You can set it yourself, in which case it is recommended that a human-readable format (or slug) be used. For example, `number-of-users-ccjht01`.<br>When not provided, a random value is automatically set.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*id\[is\] = "fea-user-licenses"*<br>|
|status|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>The current status of the feature. Possible values are : active, archived, draft.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*status\[is\] = "active"*<br>|
|type|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>The type of feature. Possible values are : switch, custom, quantity, range.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*type\[is\] = "boolean"*<br>|
|metered|query|object|false|optional, boolean filter<br><br>Specifies whether the feature is a metered feature.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*metered\[is\] = "true"*<br>|

## Create a feature

<a id="opIdcreate_a_feature"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/features' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /features`

Creates a new feature.  
**Note:** This operation creates non-metered features only. To create a metered feature, use the [Create a metered feature](/docs/api/metered_features#create_a_metered_feature) operation.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-a-feature-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» id|body|string|false|A unique and immutable identifier for the feature. You can set it yourself, in which case it is recommended that a human-readable format (or slug) be used. For example, `number-of-users-ccjht01`.<br>When not provided, a random value is automatically set.<br>|
|» name|body|string|true|A case-sensitive unique name for the feature. For example: `user license`<br>, `data storage`<br>, `Salesforce Integration`<br>, `devices`<br>, `UHD Streaming`<br>, and so on.<br><br>**Note:**<br>This name is not displayed on any customer-facing documents or pages such as [invoice PDFs](/docs/api/invoices/retrieve-invoice-as-pdf)<br>or [hosted pages](/docs/api/hosted_pages).<br>However, in the future, it is likely to be introduced on the [Self-Serve Portal](/docs/api/portal_sessions)<br>.<br>|
|» description|body|string|false|A brief description of the feature. For example: `Access to 10TB cloud storage`<br>.<br>|
|» type|body|string|false|The type of feature.<br><br>* quantity -<br>  The feature is quantity-based and entitlement levels available for it are a set of predefined number of quantity units. For example, a feature with `name`<br>  such as `number of users`<br>  can have entitlement levels of say, `5`<br>  , `20`<br>  , `50`<br>  , and `100`.<br>  `levels[is_unlimited]`<br>  is used for specifying the "unlimited" entitlement level.<br>* range -<br>  The feature is quantity-based and the entitlement levels available for it are the set of whole numbers within a range. The range is defined by a minimum and a maximum value. For example, a feature such as `number of users`<br>  can have entitlement levels starting at `5`<br>  users and go up to `50000`.<br>  `levels[is_unlimited]`<br>  is used for specifying the "unlimited" entitlement level.<br>* switch - A switch or toggle is a feature that an item or subscription can be either fully entitled to or not entitled to at all.<br>* custom -<br>  The entitlement levels available for this feature are defined as a set of custom values. For example, a feature `Email Support`<br>  can have entitlement levels as `24×7`<br>  and `24×5`<br>  .<br>|
|» status|body|string|false|The current status of the feature.<br><br>* active -<br>  A `draft`<br>  or an `archived`<br>  feature can be changed to `active`.<br>  Any [entitlements](/docs/api/entitlements)<br>  or [subscription entitlements](/docs/api/subscription_entitlements)<br>  defined for the feature take effect immediately.<br>* draft -<br>  The feature is in an unpublished state. [Entitlements](/docs/api/entitlements)<br>  and [subscription entitlements](/docs/api/subscription_entitlements)<br>  can be created for a draft feature but they are not effective until the feature is active. A feature `status`<br>  cannot be changed back to `draft`<br>  once it is in `active`<br>  or `archived`<br>  `status`<br>  .<br>|
|» unit|body|string|false|For features of `type`<br>`quantity`<br>or `range`<br>, this specifies the unit of measure. The value is expected in the singular form and when used by the system, it is pluralized automatically as needed. For example, for a feature such as `user licenses`<br>, the `unit`<br>can be `license`<br>.<br>|
|» levels|body|object|false|Parameters for levels<br>|
|» » name|body|[string]|false|A case-sensitive display name for the entitlement level. Provide a name that helps you clearly identify the entitlement level. For example: a feature such as `Email Support`<br>can have entitlement levels named as `All weekdays`<br>, `All days`<br>, `40 hours per week`<br>and so on.<br><br>When not provided for `feature.type`<br>`quantity`<br>or `range`<br>, this name is auto-generated as the space-separated concatenation of `levels[].value`<br>and the pluralized version of `unit`.<br>For example, if `levels[].value`<br>is `20`<br>and `unit`<br>is `user`<br>, then `levels[].name`<br>becomes `20 users`<br>.<br>|
|» » value|body|[string]|false|The value denoting the entitlement level granted.<br><br>* **When `type` is `quantity`:** this attribute denotes the quantity of units of the feature for this entitlement level. For example, a feature such as `number of users` can have `levels[].value` as `5`, `20`, `50`, and `100`. `levels[].is_unlimited` is used to set the entitlement level to "unlimited".<br>* **When `type` is `range`:** there can be be only two elements in the `levels[]` array; one corresponding to the minimum value (`levels[0]`) and the other to the maximum value (`levels[1]`) of the range of possible entitlement levels. For example, a feature such as `number of users` may have `levels[0].value` = `5` and `levels[1].value` = `50000`. When the upper limit is "unlimited", then `levels[1].value` is not set and `levels[1].is_unlimited` is `true`.<br>* **When `type` is `custom`:** this attribute denotes the value of this custom entitlement level. For example, a feature `Email Support` can have `levels[].value` as one of say, `24×7` and `24×5`.<br>|
|» » is_unlimited|body|[boolean]|false|When `type` is `quantity` or `range`, this attribute indicates whether the entitlement level corresponds to unlimited units of the feature. Possible values are:<br><br>* `true`: The entitlement level corresponds to unlimited units of the feature. `levels[].value` is ignored for this level. This can only be set for the level that has the highest value for `levels[].level.`<br>* `false`: The entitlement level does not correspond to unlimited units of the feature.<br><br>Either this or levels\[value\] should be passed.<br>|
|» » level|body|[integer(int32)]|false|Represents the order of the entitlement levels from lowest to highest.<br><br>* **When `type` is `quantity` or `custom`:** Provide the `level` for the lowest entitlement level as `0`, the next higher level as `1`, followed by `2`, and so on.<br>* **When `type` is `range`:** Provide `0` for the minimum value and `1` for the maximum value in the range.<br><br>When not defined, it is assumed as the index of the `levels[]` array.<br>|

## Delete a feature

<a id="opIddelete_a_feature"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/features/string/delete' \
```

`POST /features/{feature-id}/delete`

of the feature is `active`

## Update a feature

<a id="opIdupdate_a_feature"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/features/string' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /features/{feature-id}`

Updates a specific feature.  
**Note**

The list of objects `levels[]` provided as part of this operation fully replaces the existing list of objects [levels[]](/docs/api/features/feature-object#levels) of the feature.

### Considerations when modifying `levels`

This section describes validations that are performed by Chargebee when modifying the `levels` list of objects for the feature, using this operation.

#### Adding `levels`

Adding a new object to the `levels[]` list is allowed if and only if the feature [type](/docs/api/features/feature-object#type) is `quantity` or `custom`

#### Removing `levels`

Removing an existing object in the `levels[]` list is not allowed if the `value` for that object is currently mapped to one or more [item_entitlement](/docs/api/item_entitlements)s or [subscription_entitlement](/docs/api/subscription_entitlements)s.

#### Reordering `levels`

**Note**

The validation described in this section is only applicable for features of `type` `custom`

If any of `levels[].value` are currently mapped to `item_entitlement`s or `subscription_entitlement`s, then the relative order of the corresponding `levels[].level` must be preserved when invoking this operation.

For example, consider that the `levels[]` list is currently in the state shown below. (For brevity, only the `value` and `level` key are shown here and the JSONs have been compacted.)

```js

{
    "levels":[{
        "value":"email-basic",
        "level":0
    },{
        "value":"email-rise",
        "level":1
    },{
        "value":"email-advanced",
        "level":2
    },{
        "value":"email-pro",
        "level":3
    },{
        "value":"email-scale",
        "level":4
    }]
}

```

Now consider that `email-rise`, `email-advanced`, and `email-pro` have already been mapped to `item_entitlement`s or `subscription_entitlement`s. As seen in the above object, the relative order of `levels[].level` is such that `email-rise` \< `email-advanced` \< `email-pro`.

Invoking this API to change `levels[]` to the state below is allowed since the relative order of `level` corresponding to `email-rise`, `email-advanced`, and `email-pro` has been preserved.

```js

{
    "levels":[{
        "value":"email-basic",
        "level":0
    },{
        "value":"email-rise",
        "level":1
    },{
        "value":"email-scale",
        "level":2
    },{
        "value":"email-advanced",
        "level":3
    },{
        "value":"email-pro",
        "level":4
    }]
}

```

However, changing `levels[]` to the state shown below is not permissible because the `level` of `email-advanced` is provided as greater than the `level` of `email-pro`, thereby disrupting the original order.

```js

{
    "levels":[{
        "value":"email-basic",
        "level":0
    },{
        "value":"email-rise",
        "level":1
    },{
        "value":"email-pro",
        "level":2
    },{
        "value":"email-advanced",
        "level":3
    },{
        "value":"email-scale",
        "level":4
    }]
}

```



> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

## Archive a feature

<a id="opIdarchive_a_feature"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/features/string/archive_command' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /features/{feature-id}/archive_command`

Archives an `active` feature so that no **new** [entitlements](/docs/api/entitlements) or [subscription entitlements](/docs/api/subscription_entitlements) can be created towards the feature. Any pre-existing item or subscription entitlements from the time that the feature was `active` remain effective. This operation changes the [status](/docs/api/features/feature-object#status) of the feature to `archived`.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* Only a feature in `active` status can be archived.
* Calling this endpoint on a feature that is already `archived` returns it unchanged.
* A `draft` feature cannot be archived.


<h3 id="archive-a-feature-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|feature-id|path|string|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|chargebee-event-actions|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-webhook|all-disabled|

## Activate a feature

<a id="opIdactivate_a_feature"></a>

> Code samples


`POST /features/{feature-id}/activate_command`

Activates a `draft` feature so that any [entitlements](/docs/api/entitlements) or [subscription entitlements](/docs/api/subscription_entitlements) defined towards it take effect immediately. This operation changes the [status](/docs/api/features/feature-object#status) of the feature to `active`.

* Only a feature in `draft` status can be activated.
* Calling this endpoint on a feature that is already `active` returns it unchanged.
* An `archived` feature cannot be reactivated using this endpoint. Use [Reactivate a feature](/docs/api/features/reactivate-a-feature) instead.

## Upsert or remove item entitlements for a feature

<a id="opIdupsert_or_remove_item_entitlements_for_a_feature"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/features/string/item_entitlements' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /features/{feature-id}/item_entitlements`

**Deprecated**
This operation is deprecated and no longer maintained. Migrate your integration to [Manage entitlements](/docs/api/entitlements/upsert-or-remove-entitlements-for-a-feature).  
**Warning**
This operation is not supported when [grandfathering](/docs/api/entitlements) is enabled.

Upserts or removes a set of `item_entitlement`s for an `feature` depending on the `action` specified. The API returns the upserted or deleted `item_entitlements` after successfully completing the operation. The operation returns an error when the first `item_entitlement` fails to be processed. Either all the `item_entitlement`s provided in the request are processed or none.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="upsert-or-remove-item-entitlements-for-a-feature-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|feature-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» action|body|string|true|The specific action to be performed for each `item_entitlement`<br>specified.<br><br>* remove -<br>  Deletes the `item_entitlement`<br>  for the `feature_id`<br>  and `item_id`<br>  combination, if it exists.<br>* upsert -<br>  If the `item_entitlement`<br>  already exists for the `feature_id`<br>  and `item_id`<br>  combination, the `value`<br>  of the `item_entitlement`<br>  is updated. If it doesn't exist, a new `item_entitelment`<br>  is created.<br>|
|» item_entitlements|body|object|false|Parameters for item_entitlements<br>|
|» » item_id|body|[string]|true|The `id`<br>of the `item`<br>to which this entitlement belongs.<br>|
|» » item_type|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » value|body|[string]|false|The level of entitlement that the item has towards the feature. The possible values depend on the value of `feature.type`<br>:<br><br>* When `feature.type` is `quantity` and:<br><br>* If `feature.levels[is_unlimited]` is not `true` for any one of `feature.levels[]`, then the value can be any one of `feature.levels[value][]`.<br><br>* If `feature.levels[is_unlimited]` is `true` for one of the `feature.levels[]`, then the value can also be:<br><br>  * any one of `feature.levels[value][]`<br>  * or it can be `unlimited` (case-insensitive), indicating unlimited entitlement.<br>* When `type` is `range` and:<br><br>* If `feature.levels[is_unlimited]` is not `true` for any one of `feature.levels[]`, then the value can be any whole number between `levels[value][0]` and `levels[value][1]` (inclusive).<br><br>* If `feature.levels[is_unlimited]` is `true` for one of the `feature.levels[]`, then the value can be:<br><br>  * any whole number equal to or greater than `levels[value][0]`<br>  * or it can be `unlimited` (case-insensitive), indicating unlimited entitlement.<br>* When `type` is `custom`, then the value can be any one of `feature.levels[value][]`.<br><br>* When `type` is `switch`, then the value is set as `available` or `true`.<br><br>|

|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-gifts">gifts</h1>

Gift represents a subscription of a customer(**recipient** ) to a 'gift plan' which has been gifted by another customer(**gifter**).

## Create a gift subscription for items

<a id="opIdcreate_a_gift_subscription_for_items"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/gifts/create_for_items' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /gifts/create_for_items`

Create a gift subscription with items like plans, addons, or charges and gift it to an existing customer.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

## Cancel a gift

<a id="opIdcancel_a_gift"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/gifts/string/cancel' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /gifts/{gift-id}/cancel`

This API allows to cancel gifts. Only gift in 'scheduled' and 'unclaimed' states can be cancelled.


<h3 id="cancel-a-gift-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|gift-id|path|string|true|none|

|chargebee-event-actions|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-webhook|all-disabled|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-grantblocks">grant_blocks</h1>

A grant block represents a bucket of issued credit grants associated with a given subscription, `unit_id`, and `unit_type`, allocated either through an [item price](/docs/api/item_prices) or via the [allocate](/docs/api/ledger_operations/allocate) operation.

## List grant blocks

<a id="opIdlist_grant_blocks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/grant_blocks?subscription_id=' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /grant_blocks`

Returns a list of grant blocks meeting all the conditions specified in the filter parameters below.


<h3 id="list-grant-blocks-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies the maximum number of resources to return per page.  <br>**Default and Hard Cap**<br><br>* Optional parameter; if omitted, a server-defined default is applied.<br>* Values exceeding the server's maximum limit are capped (clamped) to the allowed maximum.<br><br>**Example →**<br>*limit = "50"*<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Opaque cursor indicating the current position in the result set for pagination.  <br>**Behavior**<br><br>* To fetch the next page, pass the next_offset value returned in the previous response.<br>* The value is opaque and must not be parsed, modified, or constructed manually.<br><br>**Example →**<br>*offset = "\["1771176208000","96000000006"\]"*<br>|
|subscription_id|query|object|true|required, string filter<br><br>Filters results by subscription identifier. This is the subscription whose grant blocks you are listing.<br><br>**Supported operators :** is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*subscription_id\[is\] = "1mGETgZVF2umUZq"*<br>|
|unit_id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filters results by unit identifier. For example, a credit unit id such as `ai_credits`.<br><br>**Supported operators :** is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*unit_id\[is\] = "ai_credits"*<br>|
|account_type|query|object|false|optional, enum filter<br><br>Filters results by the account the grant block belongs to: **provisioned** (plan-issued credits) or **overdraft** (consumption beyond configured grants).<br><br>**Supported operators :** is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*account_type\[is\] = "provisioned"*<br>|
|effective_from|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>Filter by when blocks become effective (`effective_from`).<br><br>**Supported operators :** after, before, on, between (per<br>[List operations](/docs/api/list-ops)).<br><br>**Example →**<br>*effective_from\[after\] = "1765283483"*<br>|
|expires_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>Filter by grant expiry (`expires_at`).<br><br>**Supported operators :** after, before, on, between (per [List<br>operations](/docs/api/list-ops)).<br><br>**Example →**<br>*expires_at\[before\] = "2863729974"*<br>|
|created_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>Filter by when the grant block was persisted (`created_at`).<br><br>**Supported operators :** after, before, on, between.<br><br>**Example →**<br>*created_at\[between\] = "\[1771175750, 1771175800\]"*<br>|
|sort_by|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Specifies the field used to sort the result set.  <br>**Supported attributes**<br><br>* `created_at`<br>* `effective_from`<br>* `expires_at`  <br>**Sort Order**<br><br>* `asc` (ascending order)<br>* `desc` (descending order)<br><br>**Example →**<br>*sort_by\[desc\] = "effective_from"*<br><br>This sorts grant blocks by `effective_from` in descending order (latest effective time first).<br>|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-hostedpages">hosted_pages</h1>

Hosted pages are the easiest way to integrate Chargebee with your website.

## Checkout charge-items and one-time charges

<a id="opIdcheckout_charge-items_and_one-time_charges"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/checkout_one_time_for_items' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/checkout_one_time_for_items`

Create a Chargebee hosted page to accept payment details from a customer and checkout [charge-items](/docs/api/items) and [one-time charges](/docs/api/invoices/create-invoice-for-items-and-one-time-charges).

The following steps describe how best to use this API:

1. Call this endpoint, providing [item prices](/docs/api/item_prices), [charges](/docs/api/items), [coupons](/docs/api/coupons) and a host of other details such as billing and shipping addresses of the customer, to be prefilled on the checkout page. You may also provide `pass_thru_content` containing information and IDs from your systems that must be associated with the checkout page.
2. Send the customer to the Checkout `url` received in the response.
3. Once they complete checkout, the set of charge-items and one-time charges are automatically invoiced against the respective `customer` record in Chargebee, and they are redirected to the `redirect_url` with the `id` and `state` attributes passed as query string parameters.
4. [Retrieve the hosted page](/docs/api/hosted_pages/retrieve-a-hosted-page) at this stage to get the invoice details.

#### Customer resource lookup and creation

When [customer[id]](/docs/api/hosted_pages/checkout-charge-items-and-one-time-charges) is provided for this operation, it is looked up by Chargebee, and if found, the hosted_page is created for it. If not found, a new customer resource is created with an autogenarated ID, and the hosted_page is created.

##### Multiple business entities

If multiple [business entities](/docs/api/advanced-features) are created for the site, the customer resource lookup and creation happen within the [context](/docs/api/advanced-features) of the business entity [specified](/docs/api/advanced-features#mbe-header-main) in this API call. If no business entity is specified, the customer resource lookup is performed within the [site context](/docs/api/advanced-features) , and if not found, the resource is created for the [default business entity](/docs/api/advanced-features) of the site.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="checkout-charge-items-and-one-time-charges-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|

## Extend subscription

<a id="opIdextend_subscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/extend_subscription' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/extend_subscription`

This API generates a hosted page URL to extend the billing cycle of a subscription.

Use one of the following methods to open the hosted page:

* **In-app modal** : Use Chargebee.js [`openCheckout()`](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/js/cbinstanceobj-api-ref#opencheckout-options) to open the hosted page in a modal popup in your website or application.
* **Standalone page** : Redirect the customer to the hosted page `url`.

Do not embed the hosted page in your own [iframe](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/iframe).


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="extend-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» brand_id|body|string|false|The unique ID of the [brand](/docs/api/brands) this hosted page should be linked to. Applicable only when multiple brands have been created for the site. This need not match the brand of the customer or subscription in the request; when the two differ, the value provided here is used for the hosted page. An alternative way of passing this parameter is by means of the `chargebee-brand-id` custom HTTP header; when both are provided, they must specify the same brand.  <br>**Default behavior**<br><br>* When not provided, the hosted page is linked to the brand of the customer or subscription in the request.<br>|
|» expiry|body|integer(int32)|false|Expiry (in days) for the link generated. No expiry will be set if this is not specified.<br>|
|» billing_cycle|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of billing cycles by which the subscription should be extended.  <br>**Default behavior**<br><br>* If the subscription's plan has [`billing_cycles`](/docs/api/item_prices#billing_cycles) set, that value is used.<br>* If the plan's billing cycles attribute is not set, `1` is used.<br>|
|» subscription|body|object|false|Parameters for subscription<br>|
|» » id|body|string|true|A unique and immutable identifier for the subscription. If not provided, it is autogenerated.<br>|

## Checkout gift subscription for items

<a id="opIdcheckout_gift_subscription_for_items"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/checkout_gift_for_items' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/checkout_gift_for_items`

Creates a hosted page for a customer (called the gifter) to gift a subscription to another customer (called the receiver).

#### Gifter customer resource lookup and creation

When [gifter[customer_id]](/docs/api/hosted_pages/checkout-gift-subscription-for-items#gifter_customer_id) is provided, it is looked up in Chargebee when the gifter completes the hosted page checkout. If not found, a new customer resource is created with this ID.

##### Multiple business entities

If multiple [business entities](/docs/api/advanced-features) are created for the site, the lookup and creation of the gifter customer resource happen within the [context](/docs/api/advanced-features) of the business entity specified in this API call. If no business entity is [specified](/docs/api/advanced-features#mbe-header-main), the customer resource lookup is performed within the [site context](/docs/api/advanced-features), and if not found, the resource is created for the [default business entity](/docs/api/advanced-features) of the site.

#### Gift receiver customer resource lookup and creation

Once the gifter checks out using the hosted page returned by this endpoint, Chargebee checks if a customer resource with the receiver's email address exists. The first such customer record is considered the receiver's customer resource. A new customer resource is created for the receiver if none are found.

##### Multiple business entities

If multiple [business entities](/docs/api/advanced-features) are created for the site, the lookup and creation of the gift receiver's customer resource happen within the [context](/docs/api/advanced-features) of the business entity of the gifter


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="checkout-gift-subscription-for-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» layout|body|string|false|Specifies the UI layout for the hosted page. This overrides [the layout](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/hosted-capabilities/hosted-checkout#ui-layout-options) configured in Chargebee Billing.<br><br>* in_app - Renders the hosted page in an in-app layout.<br>* full_page - Renders the hosted page in a full-page layout.<br>|
|» business_entity_id|body|string|false|Sets the [context]() for this operation to the [business entity](/docs/api/advanced-features) specified. Applicable only when multiple business entities have been created for the site. When this parameter is provided, the operation is able to read/write data associated only to the business entity specified. When not provided, the operation can read/write data for the entire site.  <br>**Note**<br><br>An alternative way of passing this parameter is by means of a [custom HTTP header](/docs/api/advanced-features).  <br>**See also**<br><br>Gifter customer resource lookup and creation.<br>|
|» brand_id|body|string|false|The unique ID of the [brand](/docs/api/brands) this hosted page should be linked to. Applicable only when multiple brands have been created for the site. Resources created through the hosted page, such as the customer and the subscription, are linked to the same brand. An alternative way of passing this parameter is by means of the `chargebee-brand-id` custom HTTP header; when both are provided, they must specify the same brand.  <br>**Default behavior**<br><br>* When not provided, the brand of the customer or subscription referenced in the request is used, or the default brand defined for the site when the request references neither.<br>|
|» redirect_url|body|string|false|The customers will be redirected to this URL upon successful checkout. The hosted page id and state will be passed as parameters to this URL.<br><br>**Note** :<br><br>* Although the customer will be redirected to the `redirect_url` after successful checkout, we do not recommend relying on it for completing critical post-checkout actions. This is because redirection may not happen due to unforeseen reasons such as user closing the tab, or exiting the browser, and so on. If there is any synchronization that you are doing after the redirection, you will have to have a backup. Chargebee recommends listening to appropriate webhooks such as [`subscription_created`](/docs/api/events) or [`invoice_generated`](/docs/api/events) to verify a successful checkout.<br>* Redirect URL configured in Settings \> Hosted Pages Settings would be overriden by this redirect URL.<br>* *Eg :* *http://yoursite.com?id=\*\*\&state=succeeded*<br>* This parameter is not applicable for iframe messaging.<br>|
|» coupon_ids|body|[string]|false|List of coupons to be applied to this subscription. You can provide coupon ids or [coupon codes](/docs/api/coupon_codes)<br>.<br>|
|» gifter|body|object|false|Parameters for gifter<br>|
|» » customer_id|body|string|false|The customer ID of the gifter. If not provided, the gifter customer resource is created with an autogenerated ID on checkout.  <br>**See also**<br>[Gifter customer resource lookup and creation](/docs/api/hosted_pages)<br>|
|» » locale|body|string|false|Determines which region-specific language Chargebee uses to communicate with the customer. In the absence of the locale attribute, Chargebee will use your site's default language for customer communication.<br>|
|» subscription_items|body|object|false|Parameters for subscription_items<br>|
|» » item_price_id|body|[string]|false|The unique identifier of the item price.<br>|
|» » quantity|body|[integer(int32)]|false|The quantity of the item purchased<br>|
|» » quantity_in_decimal|body|[string]|false|The decimal representation of the quantity of the item purchased. Can be provided for quantity-based item prices and only when [multi-decimal pricing](/docs/api/getting-started)<br>is enabled.<br>|
|» » unit_price|body|[integer(int64)]|false|The price/per unit price of the item. The value is interpreted as per the type of [currency](/docs/api/currencies).  <br>**Prerequisites**<br><br>* The `pricing_model` of the item price is `flat_fee` or `per_unit`.<br>* [Price overriding](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/price-override.html) is enabled for the site.  <br>**Default value**<br><br>* [`item_price.price`](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#price).<br>|
|» » unit_price_in_decimal|body|[string]|false|The price/per unit price of the item in major units of the [currency](/docs/api/currencies). When not provided, the [value set for the item price](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#price) is used.  <br>**Prerequisites**<br><br>* The `pricing_model` of the item price is `flat_fee` or `per_unit`.<br>* [Multi-decimal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/site-configuration/multi-decimal-support#configuring-multi-decimal-support) pricing is enabled.<br>* [Price overriding](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/price-override.html) is enabled for the site.  <br>**Default value**<br><br>* [`item_price.price_in_decimal`](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#price_in_decimal).<br>|
|» item_tiers|body|object|false|Parameters for item_tiers<br>|
|» » item_price_id|body|[string]|false|The id of the item price for which the tier price is being overridden.<br>|
|» » starting_unit|body|[integer(int32)]|false|The lowest value in the quantity tier.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Must be zero for the lowest tier.<br>* For all other tiers, it must be equal to the `ending_unit` of the next lower tier.<br>|
|» » ending_unit|body|[integer(int32)]|false|The highest value in the quantity tier.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Not applicable for the highest tier.<br>* Must be equal to the `starting_unit` of the next higher tier.<br>|
|» » price|body|[integer(int64)]|false|The overridden price of the tier. The value depends on the [type of currency](/docs/api/currencies).<br>|
|» » starting_unit_in_decimal|body|[string]|false|The decimal representation of the lowest value of quantity in this tier.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Must be zero for the lowest tier.<br>* For all other tiers, it must be equal to the `ending_unit_in_decimal` of the next lower tier.  <br>**Prerequisite**<br><br>* [Multi-decimal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/site-configuration/multi-decimal-support#configuring-multi-decimal-support) pricing is enabled.<br>|
|» » ending_unit_in_decimal|body|[string]|false|The decimal representation of the highest value of quantity in this tier.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Not applicable for the highest tier.<br>* Must be equal to the `starting_unit_in_decimal` of the next higher tier.  <br>**Prerequisite**<br><br>* [Multi-decimal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/site-configuration/multi-decimal-support#configuring-multi-decimal-support) pricing is enabled.<br>|
|» » price_in_decimal|body|[string]|false|* The decimal representation of the per-unit price for the tier when the [item_price.pricing_model](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#pricing_model) is `tiered` or `volume`.<br>* The decimal representation of the total price for the item when the [item_price.pricing_model](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#pricing_model) is `stairstep`.<br><br>**Constraints**<br><br>* The value must be in major units of the [currency](/docs/api/currencies).  <br>**Prerequisite**<br><br>* [Multi-decimal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/site-configuration/multi-decimal-support#configuring-multi-decimal-support) pricing is enabled.<br>|

## Collect now

<a id="opIdcollect_now"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/collect_now' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/collect_now`

This API generates a hosted page URL to collect due payments for the customer.

Open the hosted page in a new browser tab or window using the `url` from this API's response. Do not embed it in your own [iframe](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/iframe).  
**`openCheckout()` not supported**

The Chargebee.js [`openCheckout()`](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/js/cbinstanceobj-api-ref#opencheckout-options) function does not support Collect Now hosted pages. To open a Collect Now page, open the `url` from this API's response in a new browser tab or window (for example, `window.open(response.hosted_page.url, '_blank')`).


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

## Create checkout for a new subscription

<a id="opIdcreate_checkout_for_a_new_subscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/checkout_new_for_items' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/checkout_new_for_items`

Create a Chargebee hosted page to accept payment details from a customer and checkout a new subscription.
The following steps describe how best to use this API:
Call this endpoint, providing [item prices](/docs/api/item_prices), [coupons](/docs/api/coupons) and a host of other details such as billing and shipping addresses to be prefilled for the customer on the checkout page. You may also provide `pass_thru_content` containing information and IDs from your systems that must be associated with the checkout page.  
**Warning**
The first item price in the list (parameter `subscription_items[item_price_id][0]`) must be an `item_price` of [item_type](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#item_type) `plan`.

* Send the customer to the Checkout `url` received in the response.
* Once they complete checkout, a new subscription is automatically created and the customer is redirected to the `redirect_url` with the `id` and `state` attributes passed as query string parameters. Although the customer will be redirected to the `redirect_url` after successful checkout, we do not recommend relying on it for completing critical post-checkout actions. This is because redirection may not happen due to unforeseen reasons. Chargebee recommends listening to appropriate webhooks such as [subscription_created](/docs/api/events) or [invoice_generated](/docs/api/events) to verify a successful checkout.
* [Retrieve the hosted page](/docs/api/hosted_pages/retrieve-a-hosted-page) at this stage to get the subscription and invoice details.

#### Customer resource lookup and creation

When the [customer[id]](/docs/api/hosted_pages/create-checkout-for-a-new-subscription#customer_id) parameter is provided and if a customer resource with the ID is found to be already created in Chargebee, the subscription is created under that customer resource. If not found, then a new customer resource is created with an autogenarated ID and the subscription is created under it.

##### Multiple business entities

If multiple [business entities](/docs/api/advanced-features#mbe-header-main) are created for the site, the customer resource lookup and creation happen within the [context](/docs/api/business_entities#mbe-terms) of the business entity [specified](/docs/api/advanced-features#mbe-header-main) in this API call. If no business entity is specified, the customer resource lookup is performed within the [site context](/docs/api/business_entities#mbe-terms), and if not found, the resource is created for the [default business entity](/docs/api/business_entities#mbe-terms) of the site.  

### Use Cases

#### Billing address editing

The `billing_address` cannot be edited by the user during the Checkout session in either of the following cases:

* When the [`billing_address`](/docs/api/customers#billing_address) attribute for the `customer` resource is already set.
* You pass all mandatory `billing_address` fields via this API.

In such cases, to allow customers to update their billing address, use one of the following options:

##### Chargebee Hosted Pages

* Integrate [Chargebee.js](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/js/cbportal-api-ref) into your website or application. Use the [`openSection()`](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/js/cbportal-api-ref#opensection-options-callbacks) function with `options.sectionType` set to `ADDRESS` to display the Customer Portal's address section.
* Integrate the [Customer Portal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/hosted-capabilities/portal-integration) into your website or application. The Portal enables customers to manage their address information.

##### Customer API

* Use the [Update billing info API](/docs/api/customers/update-billing-info-for-a-customer) and provide the appropriate `billing_address` parameters.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-checkout-for-a-new-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» layout|body|string|false|Specifies the UI layout for the hosted page. This overrides [the layout](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/hosted-capabilities/hosted-checkout#ui-layout-options) configured in Chargebee Billing.<br><br>* in_app - Renders the hosted page in an in-app layout.<br>* full_page - Renders the hosted page in a full-page layout.<br>|
|» business_entity_id|body|string|false|Sets the [context]() for this operation to the [business entity](/docs/api/advanced-features) specified. Applicable only when multiple business entities have been created for the site. When this parameter is provided, the operation is able to read/write data associated only to the business entity specified. When not provided, the operation can read/write data for the entire site.  <br>**Note**<br><br>An alternative way of passing this parameter is by means of a [custom HTTP header](/docs/api/advanced-features).  <br>**See also**<br>[Customer resource lookup and creation.](/docs/api/hosted_pages)<br>|
|» brand_id|body|string|false|The unique ID of the [brand](/docs/api/brands) this hosted page should be linked to. Applicable only when multiple brands have been created for the site. An alternative way of passing this parameter is by means of the `chargebee-brand-id` custom HTTP header; when both are provided, they must specify the same brand.  <br>**Default behavior**<br><br>* When not provided, the brand of the customer or subscription referenced in the request is used, or the default brand defined for the site when the request references neither.<br>|
|» billing_cycles|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of billing cycles the subscription runs before canceling. If not provided, then the billing cycles [set for the plan-item price](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#billing_cycles)<br>is used.<br>|

|» terms_to_charge|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of subscription billing cycles (including the first one) to [invoice in advance](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/advance-invoices.html)<br>.<br>|
|» billing_alignment_mode|body|string|false|Override the [billing alignment mode](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/calendar-billing.html#alignment-of-billing-date)<br>for Calendar Billing. Only applicable when using Calendar Billing. The default value is that which has been configured for the site.<br><br>* immediate - Subscription period will be aligned with the configured billing date immediately, with credits or charges raised accordingly..<br>* delayed - Subscription period will be aligned with the configured billing date at the next renewal.<br>|
|» coupon_ids|body|[string]|false|List of coupons to be applied to this subscription. You can provide coupon ids or [coupon codes](/docs/api/coupon_codes)<br>.<br>|
|» redirect_url|body|string|false|The customers will be redirected to this URL upon successful checkout. The hosted page id and state will be passed as parameters to this URL.<br><br>**Note** :<br><br>* Although the customer will be redirected to the `redirect_url` after successful checkout, we do not recommend relying on it for completing critical post-checkout actions. This is because redirection may not happen due to unforeseen reasons such as user closing the tab, or exiting the browser, and so on. If there is any synchronization that you are doing after the redirection, you will have to have a backup. Chargebee recommends listening to appropriate webhooks such as [`subscription_created`](/docs/api/events) or [`invoice_generated`](/docs/api/events) to verify a successful checkout.<br>* Redirect URL configured in Settings \> Hosted Pages Settings would be overriden by this redirect URL.<br>* *Eg :* *http://yoursite.com?id=\*\*\&state=succeeded*<br>* This parameter is not applicable for iframe messaging.<br>|
|» cancel_url|body|string|false|The customers will be redirected to this URL upon canceling checkout. After a successful checkout, when the customer is redirected, you can retrieve the hosted page ID from the [redirect URL](/docs/api/hosted_pages/create-checkout-for-a-new-subscription#redirect_url)'s query parameters. Using this ID, you can fetch the hosted page and perform actions related to the success of the marketing campaign.<br>|
|» allow_offline_payment_methods|body|boolean|false|Allow the customer to select an offline payment method during checkout. The choice of payment methods can be configured via the Chargebee UI.<br>|

|» » id|body|string|false|A unique and immutable identifier for a new subscription. If not provided, it is autogenerated.<br>|

This parameter overrides the [`item_price_trial_period`](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#trial_period)<br>directly.<br>|
|» » start_date|body|integer(unix-time)|false|The date/time at which the subscription is to start. If not provided, the subscription starts immediately. You can provide a value in the past as well. This is called backdating the subscription creation and is done when the subscription has already been provisioned but its billing has been delayed. Backdating is allowed only when the following prerequisites are met:<br><br>* Backdating is enabled for subscription creation operations.<br>* The current day of the month does not exceed the limit set in Chargebee for backdating such operations. This day is typically the day of the month by which the accounting for the previous month must be closed.<br>* The date is not more than duration X into the past, where X is the billing period of the plan. ## Claim a gift subscription

<a id="opIdclaim_a_gift_subscription"></a>

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/claim_gift' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/claim_gift`

This API generates a hosted page URL to claim a gifted subscription.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|

An alternative way of passing this parameter is by means of the `chargebee-brand-id` custom HTTP header; when both are provided, they must specify the same brand.  <br>**Default behavior**<br><br>* When not provided, the hosted page is linked to the brand of the customer or subscription in the request.<br>|

The hosted page id and state will be passed as parameters to this URL.<br><br>**Note** :<br><br>* Although the customer will be redirected to the `redirect_url` after successful checkout, we do not recommend relying on it for completing critical post-checkout actions. This is because redirection may not happen due to unforeseen reasons such as user closing the tab, or exiting the browser, and so on. If there is any synchronization that you are doing after the redirection, you will have to have a backup. Chargebee recommends listening to appropriate webhooks such as [`subscription_created`](/docs/api/events) or [`invoice_generated`](/docs/api/events) to verify a successful checkout.<br>* Redirect URL configured in Settings \> Hosted Pages Settings would be overriden by this redirect URL.<br>* *Eg :* *http://yoursite.com?id=\*\*\&state=succeeded*<br>* This parameter is not applicable for iframe messaging.<br>|

|» customer|body|object|false|Parameters for customer<br>|
|» » locale|body|string|false|Determines which region-specific language Chargebee uses to communicate with the customer. In the absence of the locale attribute, Chargebee will use your site's default language for customer communication.<br>|

## Create checkout to update a subscription

<a id="opIdcreate_checkout_to_update_a_subscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/checkout_existing_for_items' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/checkout_existing_for_items`

Create a Chargebee hosted page to accept payment details from a customer and checkout to update the subscription.

The following steps describe how best to use this API:

Provide [item prices](/docs/api/item_prices), [coupons](/docs/api/coupons) and a host of other details such as billing and shipping addresses to be prefilled for the customer on the checkout page. You may also provide `pass_thru_content` containing information and IDs from your systems that must be associated with the checkout page.  
**Warning**
The first item price in the list (parameter `subscription_items[item_price_id][0]`) must be an `item_price` of [item_type](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#item_type) `plan`.

* Send the customer to the Checkout `url` received in the response. They can now add a payment method or use an existing one, to complete the checkout.

* The subscription is updated and the customer is redirected to the `redirect_url` with the `id` and `state` attributes passed as query string parameters.

  Although the customer will be redirected to the `redirect_url` after successful checkout, we do not recommend relying on it for completing critical post-checkout actions. This is because redirection may not happen due to unforeseen reasons. Chargebee recommends listening to appropriate webhooks such as [subscription_created](/docs/api/events) or [invoice_generated](/docs/api/events) to verify a successful checkout.

* [Retrieve the hosted page](/docs/api/hosted_pages/retrieve-a-hosted-page) at this stage to get the subscription and invoice details.

### Impacts

**#### Subscription and Ramps: Impact on existing scheduled changes**  
* If the subscription has existing scheduled changes, the behavior depends on whether [Ramps](/docs/api/ramps) are enabled:
  * **Ramps disabled**: Any existing scheduled change on the subscription is deleted.
  * **Ramps enabled with compatibility mode** :
    * If only one ramp is present:
      * If the ramp was created using this API, the ramp is deleted.
      * If the ramp was created using the [Create a ramp API](/docs/api/ramps/create-a-ramp), and the date-time of the new change is before the date-time of the ramp, then the ramp is moved to `draft` status if the [auto-draft conditions](/docs/api/ramps/ramp-object#auto-draft) are met.
    * If multiple ramps are present: all ramps after the date-time of the new change are moved to `draft` status if the [auto-draft conditions](/docs/api/ramps/ramp-object#auto-draft) are met.
* For more details, see [Ramps API compatibility mode](/docs/api/subscriptions#ramps-compat-mode).  

### Use Cases

#### Edit billing address

If the [`billing_address`](/docs/api/customers#billing_address) attribute for the `customer` resource is already set, then the `billing_address` cannot be edited by the user during the Checkout session. To allow customers to update their billing address, use one of the following options:

##### Chargebee Hosted Pages

* Integrate [Chargebee.js](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/js/cbportal-api-ref) into your website or application. Use the [`openSection()`](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/js/cbportal-api-ref#opensection-options-callbacks) function with `options.sectionType` set to `ADDRESS` to display the Customer Portal's address section.
* Integrate the [Customer Portal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/hosted-capabilities/portal-integration) into your website or application. The Portal enables customers to manage their address information.

##### Customer API

* Use the [Update billing info API](/docs/api/customers/update-billing-info-for-a-customer) and provide the appropriate `billing_address` parameters.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-checkout-to-update-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|

|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» layout|body|string|false|Specifies the UI layout for the hosted page. This overrides [the layout](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/hosted-capabilities/hosted-checkout#ui-layout-options) configured in Chargebee Billing.<br><br>* in_app - Renders the hosted page in an in-app layout.<br>* full_page - Renders the hosted page in a full-page layout.<br>|
|» brand_id|body|string|false|The unique ID of the [brand](/docs/api/brands) this hosted page should be linked to. Applicable only when multiple brands have been created for the site. |» mandatory_items_to_remove|body|[string]|false|Item ids of [mandatorily attached addons](/docs/api/attached_items)<br>that are to be removed from the subscription.<br>|

Backdating an invoice is done for reasons such as booking revenue for a previous date or when the subscription is effective as of a past date. Moreover, if `create_pending_invoices`<br>is set to `true`<br>, and if the site is configured to set invoice dates to date of closing, then upon invoice closure, this date is changed to the invoice closing date. taxes and line_item_taxes are computed based on the tax configuration as of `invoice_date`.<br>When passing this parameter, the following prerequisites must be met:<br><br>* `invoice_date` must be in the past.<br>* `invoice_date` is not more than one calendar month into the past. For example, if today is 13th January, then you cannot pass a value that is earlier than 13th December.<br>* It is not earlier than `changes_scheduled_at`, `reactivate_from`, or `trial_end`.<br>* `invoice_immediately` is `true`. .<br>|
|» billing_cycles|body|integer(int32)|false|Billing cycles set for plan-item price is used by default.<br>|
|» terms_to_charge|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of subscription billing cycles to [invoice in advance](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/advance-invoices.html).<br>If a new term is started for the subscription due to this API call, then `terms_to_charge`<br>is inclusive of this new term. See description for the `force_term_reset`<br>parameter to learn more about when a subscription term is reset.<br>|
|» reactivate_from|body|integer(unix-time)|false|If the subscription `status`<br>is `cancelled`<br>and it is being reactivated via this operation, this is the date/time at which the subscription should be reactivated.<br>**Note:**<br>It is recommended not to pass this parameter along with `changed_scheduled_at`.<br>`reactivate_from`<br>can be backdated (set to a value in the past). Use backdating when the subscription has been reactivated already but its billing has been delayed. Backdating is allowed only when the following prerequisites are met:<br><br>* Backdating must be enabled for subscription reactivation operations.<br>* The current day of the month does not exceed the limit set in Chargebee for backdating subscription change. This limit is the day of the month by which the accounting for the previous month must be closed.<br>* The date is on or after the last date/time any of the product catalog items of the subscription were changed.<br>* The date is not more than duration X into the past where X is the billing period of the plan. For example, if the period of the plan in the subscription is 2 months and today is 14th April, `changes_scheduled_at` cannot be earlier than 14th February. .<br>|
|» billing_alignment_mode|body|string|false|Override the [billing alignment mode](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/calendar-billing.html#alignment-of-billing-date)<br>chosen for the site for calendar billing. Only applicable when using calendar billing.<br><br>* immediate - Subscription period will be aligned with the configured billing date immediately, with credits or charges raised accordingly..<br>* delayed - Subscription period will be aligned with the configured billing date at the next renewal.<br>|
|» coupon_ids|body|[string]|false|List of coupons to be applied to this subscription. You can provide coupon ids or [coupon codes](/docs/api/coupon_codes)<br>.<br>|
|» replace_coupon_list|body|boolean|false|If `true`<br>then the existing `coupon_ids`<br>list for the subscription is replaced by the one provided. If `false`<br>then the provided `coupon_ids`<br>list gets added to the existing list.<br>|
|» reactivate|body|boolean|false|This parameter is only relevant for `cancelled`<br>subscriptions. When set to `true`<br>, it activates the canceled subscription; otherwise, subscription changes are applied without altering its `status`.<br>Additionally, if not explicitly set and the `subscription_items`<br>provided in the API differ from the existing items, the subscription will still be reactivated.<br>|
|» force_term_reset|body|boolean|false|**Note** : This parameter is relevant only for subscriptions with `status` of `active`, `non_renewing`, or `cancelled`.<br><br>When you set this parameter to `true`, the subscription term resets to the date of the subscription change.<br>By default, if you change the plan-item price to another with the same billing period, the subscription term remains unchanged. For example, if the subscription renews on the 28th of every month, it will continue to renew on the 28th after the change.  <br>**Note** : If the new plan-item price has a different billing period from the current plan-item price, the subscription term resets automatically, regardless of the value of `force_term_reset`.  <br>**Constraints**<br>If you pass `force_term_reset`, you must also pass `invoice_usages` with the same value when **all** of the following site configuration settings are enabled:<br><br>* [Usage-based billing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/usage-based-billing/setting-up-usage-based-billing)<br>* Mid-term changes for usage-based items<br>* [Invoice and charge for usage-based items when a subscription is changing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/subscriptions/metered_billing#configuring-metered-billing)<br>|

The change occurs as of the date-time defined in `changes_scheduled_at`.<br>* immediately - The subscription change takes effect immediately.<br>|
|» changes_scheduled_at|body|integer(unix-time)|false|The date-time at which the subscription change is to happen or has happened.  <br>**Required if**<br><br>* `change_option` is set to `specific_date`.  <br>**Deprecated for scheduling changes**<br><br>* Setting this parameter to a future date-time for scheduling changes is deprecated. Use the [Create a ramp API](/docs/api/ramps/create-a-ramp) instead.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Do not pass this parameter along with `reactivate_from`.  <br>**Backdated changes**<br><br>`changes_scheduled_at`can be set to a value in the past. |» cancel_url|body|string|false|The customers will be redirected to this URL upon canceling checkout. The hosted page id and state will be passed as parameters to this URL.<br><br>**Note**<br>: - Cancel URL configured in Settings \> Hosted Pages Settings would be overriden by this cancel URL.<br><br>*Eg : http://yoursite.com?id=\&state=cancelled*<br><br>* This parameter is not applicable for iframe messaging and [in-app](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/checkout.html) checkout.<br>|

## Create a pre-cancel hosted page

<a id="opIdcreate_a_pre-cancel_hosted_page"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/pre_cancel' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/pre_cancel`

Creates a `hosted_page`
resource of `type`
`pre_cancel`
. Route canceling users to this page to provide them a retention experience and start saving revenue.
The hosted page is created in accordance with the retention experience [configured in the Chargebee Growth app](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/growth/experiences/setting-up-cancel-pages)
, along with the data provided as input to this endpoint. Call the endpoint before your customer clicks the **Cancel**
button, and when they do, route them to the [url](/docs/api/hosted_pages/hosted_page-object#url)
in the endpoint response.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-a-pre-cancel-hosted-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» brand_id|body|string|false|The unique ID of the [brand](/docs/api/brands) this hosted page should be linked to. Applicable only when multiple brands have been created for the site. This need not match the brand of the customer or subscription in the request; when the two differ, the value provided here is used for the hosted page. An alternative way of passing this parameter is by means of the `chargebee-brand-id` custom HTTP header; when both are provided, they must specify the same brand.  <br>**Default behavior**<br><br>* When not provided, the hosted page is linked to the brand of the customer or subscription in the request.<br>|
|» pass_thru_content|body|string|false|Additional data to be passed to Chargebee Growth. Only the value of `pass_thru_content.custom` is sent to Chargebee Growth. It is sent as the value of the [`custom`](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/js/cancel-page-api-ref#parameters) property. The fields provided in `pass_thru_content.custom` must be preconfigured in Chargebee Growth.<br><br>Although only `pass_thru_content.custom` is sent to Chargebee Growth, all of `pass_thru_content` is stored by Chargebee Billing and is retrievable as an [attribute](/docs/api/hosted_pages/hosted_page-object#pass_thru_content) of the `hosted_page`.<br>.<br>|
|» cancel_url|body|string|false|The customer is sent to this URL if they finally decide to cancel the subscription, despite the attempt to retain them.<br>|
|» redirect_url|body|string|false|The customer is sent to this URL upon successful retention. In other words, this is the page to which the customer is sent when they decide **not**<br>to cancel the subscription.<br>|
|» locale|body|string|false|none|
|» subscription|body|object|false|Parameters for subscription<br>|
|» » id|body|string|true|The unique ID of the subscription which the customer wants to cancel.<br>|

## Acknowledge a hosted page

<a id="opIdacknowledge_a_hosted_page"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/string/acknowledge' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/{hosted-page-id}/acknowledge`

When a hosted page is successfully completed by the user and processed by Chargebee, its [`state`](/docs/api/hosted_pages/hosted_page-object#state)
is automatically changed to `succeeded`
. Acknowledging a hosted page confirms that you have moved the customer details from Chargebee into your system and are ready to fulfill it. This API is used to acknowledge the hosted page in `succeeded`
state and change its state to `acknowledged`
.

**Note:**
The hosted page status must be succeeded for this API call to be allowed.

## Retrieve direct debit agreement PDF

<a id="opIdretrieve_direct_debit_agreement_pdf"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/hosted_pages/retrieve_agreement_pdf' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /hosted_pages/retrieve_agreement_pdf`

This is applicable only for Direct Debit via SEPA, Bacs, Bg Autogiro, BECS (for both Australia and New Zealand) and PAD. For Direct Debit, the customer needs to accept an agreement that allows the merchant to debit their bank account. This agreement PDF allows you to easily display scheme-rules compliant Direct Debit mandates to your customers.

This API retrieves the redirect link to the corresponding agreement for customers. The agreement PDF can be your "Thank You" page or sent by email to customers. Communicating this PDF to your customers is mandatory.

Customer locale is used to generate the PDF in the required language. If a customer language is not supported, the PDF is generated in English. Checkout the [list of languages](https://developer.gocardless.com/api-reference/#mandate-pdfs-create-a-mandate-pdf) supported by GoCardless.

```yaml
null
```
