## Remove payment schedule scheme from an invoice

<a id="opIdremove_payment_schedule_scheme_from_an_invoice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/invoices/string/remove_payment_schedule_scheme' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /invoices/{invoice-id}/remove_payment_schedule_scheme`

Cancels remaining unpaid [schedule entries](/docs/api/payment_schedules/payment_schedule-object#schedule_entries) on an invoice.

Use this when a payment schedule was [applied](/docs/api/invoices/apply-payment-schedule-scheme-to-an-invoice) in error or is no longer required. Unpaid schedule entries are set to `voided`; paid entries and their payments are preserved. After this operation, Chargebee no longer collects the invoice through scheduled installments.  
**Note:**
The invoice must be in `payment_due`, `posted`, or `not_paid` status and must have an associated payment schedule. Use [Retrieve payment schedules for an invoice](/docs/api/invoices/retrieve-payment-schedules-for-an-invoice) to verify.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* The invoice [status](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#status) must be `payment_due`, `posted`, or `not_paid`.
* The invoice must have a payment schedule created via [Apply payment schedule scheme to an invoice](/docs/api/invoices/apply-payment-schedule-scheme-to-an-invoice).
* The invoice must not have any [`linked_payments`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_payments) with `txn_status` set to `in_progress`.
* The operation is not allowed if all [`schedule_entries[].status`](/docs/api/payment_schedules/payment_schedule-object#schedule_entries) on the payment schedule are `paid`.  

### Impacts

**Invoice**  
Returns the updated invoice. Unpaid installment collection stops; any payments already collected for paid schedule entries remain applied on the invoice.  
**Payment schedule**  
* The parent [`payment_schedule`](/docs/api/payment_schedules) is retained on the invoice.
* Paid [`schedule_entries`](/docs/api/payment_schedules/payment_schedule-object#schedule_entries) are preserved.
* Unpaid `schedule_entries[].status` values (`posted` or `payment_due`) are set to `voided`.  

#### Related APIs

[Apply payment schedule scheme to an invoice](/docs/api/invoices?prod_cat_ver=2#apply_payment_schedule_scheme_to_an_invoice)[Retrieve payment schedules for an invoice](/docs/api/invoices?prod_cat_ver=2#retrieve_payment_schedules_for_an_invoice)

## Collect payment for an invoice

<a id="opIdcollect_payment_for_an_invoice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/invoices/string/collect_payment' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /invoices/{invoice-id}/collect_payment`

Collects a specified amount of payment for an invoice, via a specified online payment method.  

#### Offline payments

When there is no payment method available, and if you wish to record an offline payment, use the [Record an offline payment API](/docs/api/invoices/record-an-invoice-payment) instead.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* The invoice `status` must be `payment_due`, `posted`, or `not_paid`.
* The invoice `channel` must not be `app_store` or `play_store`.
* The invoice's [`amount_to_collect`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#amount_to_collect) must be greater than 0.
* A valid `payment_source` must be associated with the customer.  

### Impacts

**Invoice**  
* The invoice `status` changes to `paid` if the `amount_due` on the invoice becomes zero because of this payment. Otherwise, the `status` remains unchanged.  
**Payment Schedules**  
If a [`payment_schedule`](/docs/api/payment_schedules) exists for the invoice:

* For a successful payment, Chargebee reduces [`schedule_entries[].amount`](/docs/api/payment_schedules/payment_schedule-object#schedule_entries) for the entries the payment covers. An entry whose remaining amount reaches `0` is marked `paid`.
* Chargebee adds the payment to [`reference_transactions[]`](/docs/api/payment_schedules/payment_schedule-object#reference_transactions), including failed and in-progress attempts with `applied_amount` `0`.  

#### Related APIs

[Record an offline payment](/docs/api/invoices?prod_cat_ver=2#record_an_invoice_payment)

```yaml
null
```

## Refund an invoice

<a id="opIdrefund_an_invoice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/invoices/string/refund' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /invoices/{invoice-id}/refund`

Refunds online payments or online refundable credit notes applied to an invoice.

If multiple [transactions](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_payments) or [credit note allocations](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#applied_credits) are associated with the invoice, the refund can be processed only for one transaction or allocation at a time. The refund amount is returned to the customer through the [`payment_source`](/docs/api/payment_sources) associated with the transaction.

For recording offline refunds, including those for [`linked_taxes_withheld`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_taxes_withheld), use the [Record refund for an invoice](/docs/api/invoices/record-refund-for-an-invoice) API.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* The invoice must have a [refundable amount](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#refundable-amount) derived from online transactions.
* There must be no `linked_payments` with a status of `in-progress`.
* Partial refunds can be processed only if the associated payment gateway supports partial refund operations.
* Ensure that all parameter-level requirements are met.  

### Impacts

**Invoice**  
* The invoice status does **not** change after this operation.  
**Credit note**  
* A refundable [credit note](/docs/api/credit_notes) is created for the invoice to capture the refund details.  

### Implementation Notes

Before calling this API, ensure the following:

* The invoice must have a refundable amount derived from online transactions. The refundable amount is calculated as: `linked_payments[].amount` for online payments + `applied_credits[].applied_amount` - `issued_credit_notes[].cn_total`
* There must be no `linked_payments` with a status of `in-progress`.
* All parameter-level requirements are met.  

#### Related APIs

[Record refund for an invoice](/docs/api/invoices?prod_cat_ver=2#record_refund_for_an_invoice)


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|invoice-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» refund_amount|body|integer(int64)|false|The amount to be refunded.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* If multiple [transactions](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_payments) or [credit note allocations](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#applied_credits) are associated with the invoice, the refund can be processed only for one transaction or allocation at a time.<br>* Offline refunds, including those for [`linked_taxes_withheld`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_taxes_withheld), cannot be refunded via this operation. Use the [Record refund for an invoice](/docs/api/invoices/record-refund-for-an-invoice) API instead.  <br>**Default behavior**<br><br>* If not specified, the total refundable amount for this invoice derived from online transactions is implied. The refundable amount is calculated as: (the total amount paid on the invoice via online payments) + (allocations on the invoice from refundable credit notes that were created from online payments) - (any amount already refunded from the invoice).<br>|

The following reason codes are supported now\[Deprecated; use the [create_reason_code](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#create_reason_code)<br>parameter instead\]<br><br>* product_unsatisfactory - Product Unsatisfactory<br>* other - Can be set when none of the above reason codes are applicable<br>* waiver - Waiver<br>* order_cancellation - Order Cancellation<br>* order_change - Order Change<br>* service_unsatisfactory - Service Unsatisfactory<br>|
|» » create_reason_code|body|string|false|Reason code for creating the credit note. Must be one from a list of reason codes set in the Chargebee app in Settings \> Configure Chargebee \> Reason Codes \> Credit Notes \> Create Credit Note. The codes are case-sensitive<br>|

## Record refund for an invoice

<a id="opIdrecord_refund_for_an_invoice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/invoices/string/record_refund' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /invoices/{invoice-id}/record_refund`

Record a full or partial offline refund for an invoice.

Use this API to record refunds processed outside Chargebee (for example, directly through a payment gateway or via offline methods such as bank transfers or checks) so you can reconcile them in Chargebee.

**Important:** This API does not process actual refunds for online payments or return money to customers through the payment gateway. To process refunds for online payments and return money to customers, use the [Refund an invoice](/docs/api/invoices/refund-an-invoice) API instead.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

The invoice must have a [refundable amount](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#refundable-amount). (See Implementation Notes for details.)  

### Impacts

**Credit note**  
Chargebee creates a `refundable` [credit note](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit-note-object) with [`status`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#status) set to `refunded`.  
**Transactions**  
Chargebee records the refunds by creating transactions of [`type`](/docs/api/transactions/transaction-object#type) `refund` and links them to the credit note. The refund transactions are recorded in the following order:

1. [`linked_payments`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_payments) for offline transactions. This is recorded as [`linked_refunds[]`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#linked_refunds) in the credit note.
2. [`linked_taxes_withheld`](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_taxes_withheld) (if available). This is recorded as [`linked_tax_withheld_refunds[]`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#linked_tax_withheld_refunds) in the credit note.
3. `linked_payments` for online transactions (after offline payments and taxes withheld are exhausted). This is recorded as [`linked_refunds[]`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#linked_refunds) in the credit note.

**Example**

Consider an invoice with the following payments and tax withheld:

* Offline payments: $30
* Online payments: $20
* Tax withheld: $5

When you record a refund of $40, Chargebee allocates the refund as follows:

* Refund against offline payments: $30
* Refund against tax withheld: $5
* Refund against online payments: $5  

### Implementation Notes

Before calling this API, perform the following checks:

* The invoice must have a [refundable amount](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#refundable-amount).
* Ensure the `transaction[date]` is on or after the invoice date and not in the future.
* Include the `transaction[amount]` parameter to specify the refund amount. If you omit this parameter, the system records the entire refundable amount as refunded.
* If [reason codes](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/site-configuration/reason-codes#managing-reason-codes-for-credit-notes) are mandatory in Chargebee Billing, include the `credit_note[create_reason_code]` parameter with a value from the configured list of codes.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="record-refund-for-an-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|

## Retrieve invoice as PDF

<a id="opIdretrieve_invoice_as_pdf"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/invoices/string/pdf' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /invoices/{invoice-id}/pdf`

Gets the invoice as PDF. The returned URL is secure and allows download. The URL will expire in 60 minutes.

#### Related Tutorial

## Download e-invoice

<a id="opIddownload_e-invoice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/invoices/string/download_einvoice' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /invoices/{invoice-id}/download_einvoice`

Download the e-invoice in both XML and PDF formats. The response consists of a `download` object for each format. The XML format follows the [structure as per Peppol BIS Billing v3.0](https://docs.peppol.eu/poacc/billing/3.0/syntax/ubl-invoice/tree/).  
**Note**

* You can only download e-invoices when their `status` is `success`.
* There are some cases in which the PDF is not available for download. In such cases, you can obtain it from the XML by decoding the value for [cbc:EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject](https://docs.peppol.eu/poacc/billing/3.0/syntax/ubl-invoice/cac-AdditionalDocumentReference/cac-Attachment/cbc-EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject/), which is the Base64-encoded version of the PDF.


<h3 id="download-e-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|invoice-id|path|string|true|none|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-itemfamilies">item_families</h1>

If you're a company that sells multiple product lines then each product line or service is an item family in the Chargebee API.

## Delete an item family

<a id="opIddelete_an_item_family"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/item_families/string/delete' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /item_families/{item-family-id}/delete`

Deletes an item family, marking its `status`
as `deleted`
. This is not allowed if there are `active`
items under the item family. Once deleted, the `id`
and `name`
of the item family can be reused to create a new item family.

|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|item-family-id|path|string|true|none|

<h3 id="update-an-item-price-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|item-price-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|A unique display name for the item price in the Chargebee UI. If `external_name`<br>is not provided, this is also used in customer-facing pages and documents such as [invoices](/docs/api/invoices)<br>and [hosted pages](/docs/api/hosted_pages)<br>.<br>|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the item price.  <br>**Note**:<br><br>* The description field supports up to 2000 characters, including HTML tags. The inner text (excluding HTML tags) must not exceed 500 characters. For example: `- testing - desc `. Total with tags: 38 characters, inner text: 'testing desc' (12 characters).<br>* If your input includes characters requiring sanitization, such as incomplete HTML tags, the sanitization process may alter the input and increase its length. If the sanitized content exceeds the allowed limit, the request will be rejected.<br>|
|» proration_type|body|string|false|**Note**<br>Applicable only for item prices with:<br><br>* [item_type](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#item_type) = `addon`.<br>* [pricing_model](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#pricing_model) = `per_unit`.<br><br>Specifies how to manage charges or credits for the addon item price during a [subscription update](/docs/api/subscriptions/update-subscription-for-items)<br>or [estimating](/docs/api/estimates/estimate-for-updating-a-subscription)<br>a subscription update.<br><br>* full_term - Charge the full price of the addon item price or give the full credit. Don't apply any proration.<br>* site_default -<br>  Use the [site-wide proration setting](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/proration.html#proration-for-subscription-change)<br>  .<br>* partial_term - Prorate the charges or credits for the rest of the current term.<br>|
|» price_variant_id|body|string|false|An immutable unique identifier of a [price variant](/docs/api/price_variants).<br>|
|» status|body|string|false|The status of the item price.<br><br>* archived - The item price is no longer active and cannot be used in new subscriptions or added to existing ones. Existing subscriptions that already have this item price will continue to renew with the item price.<br>* active - The item price can be used in subscriptions.<br>|
|» external_name|body|string|false|The name of the item price used in customer-facing pages and documents. These include [invoices](/docs/api/invoices)<br>and [hosted pages](/docs/api/hosted_pages).<br>If not provided, then `name`<br>is used.<br>|
|» usage_accumulation_reset_frequency|body|string|false|Specifies the frequency at which the usage counter needs to be reset.  <br>**Prerequisites**<br><br>* Usage accumulation across the contract period must be enabled for the site before providing `usage_accumulation_reset_frequency`.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Applicable only to metered item prices that use the `tiered` pricing model.  <br>**Note:**<br>Changes to the `usage_accumulation_reset_frequency` parameter are not allowed when the item price is already linked to a subscription.<br><br>* never - Accumulates usage without ever resetting it.<br>* subscription_billing_frequency - Accumulates usage until the subscription's billing frequency ends.<br>|
|» currency_code|body|string|false|The currency code ([ISO 4217 format](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/supported-currencies.html)<br>) for the item price. If subscriptions, invoices or [differential prices](/docs/api/differential_prices)<br>exist for this item price, `currency_code`<br>cannot be changed.<br>|
|» invoice_notes|body|string|false|A customer-facing note added to all invoices associated with this API resource. This note becomes one among [all the notes](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#notes)<br>displayed on the invoice PDF.<br>|
|» is_taxable|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether taxes apply to this item price. This value is set and returned even if [Taxes](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/tax.html)<br>have been disabled in Chargebee. However, the value is effective only while Taxes are enabled.<br>|
|» free_quantity|body|integer(int32)|false|Free quantity the subscriptions of this **plan** `item_price` will have. Only the quantity exceeding this value will be charged in the subscription.  <br>**Note:**<br><br>* `free_quantity` is currently supported only for [plan](/docs/api/items/item-object#type) `item_price`.<br>* `free_quantity` is not supported for the [Usage-Based Billing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/understanding-usages.html) (UBB). All included or free quantities should be configured exclusively through [entitlements](/docs/api/entitlements) .<br>|
|» free_quantity_in_decimal|body|string|false|The quantity of the item that is available free-of-charge, represented in decimal. When a subscription is created for this plan or when the plan of a subscription is changed to this one, only the quantity above this number is charged for. Applicable for quantity-based plans and only when [multi-decimal pricing](/docs/api/currencies)<br>is enabled.<br>|
|» metadata|body|object|false|A collection of key-value pairs that provides extra information about the item price.  <br>**Note:**<br>There's a character limit of 65,535.<br><br>[Learn more](/docs/api/advanced-features#metadata)<br>.<br>|
|» pricing_model|body|string|false|The [pricing scheme](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/plans.html#pricing-models) for this item price. If subscriptions, invoices or [differential prices](/docs/api/differential_prices) exist for this item price, `pricing_model` cannot be changed.<br><br>* tiered - There are quantity tiers for which per unit prices are set. Quantities are purchased from successive tiers.<br>* per_unit - A fixed price per unit quantity.<br>* flat_fee - A fixed price that is not quantity-based.<br>* volume - The per unit price is based on the tier that the total quantity falls in.<br>* stairstep - A quantity-based pricing scheme. The item is charged a fixed price based on the tier that the total quantity falls in.<br>|
|» price|body|integer(int64)|false|The cost of the item price when the pricing model is `flat_fee`.<br>When the pricing model is `per_unit`<br>, it is the price per unit quantity of the item. Not applicable for the other pricing models. The value is in the [minor unit of the currency](/docs/api/currencies)<br>.<br>|

## Delete an item price

<a id="opIddelete_an_item_price"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/item_prices/string/delete' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /item_prices/{item-price-id}/delete`

Deletes an item price, marking its `status` as `deleted`. If it is part of a subscription or invoice, the item price `status` is marked `archived` instead. Once deleted, the `id` and `name` of the item price can be reused to create a new item price.


<h3 id="delete-an-item-price-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|item-price-id|path|string|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|chargebee-event-actions|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-webhook|all-disabled|

## List applicable item prices for a plan-item price

<a id="opIdlist_applicable_item_prices_for_a_plan-item_price"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/item_prices/string/applicable_item_prices' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /item_prices/{item-price-id}/applicable_item_prices`

Returns the set of all applicable [addon-item](/docs/api/item_prices)
prices for a specific plan-item price. This set consists of all the addon-item prices that can be applied to a subscription having the plan-item price. When determining this set, Chargebee considers the following:

* the [item_applicability](/docs/api/items/item-object#item_applicability) and [applicable_items](/docs/api/items/item-object#applicable_items) defined for the parent item of the plan-item price
* the [compatibility](/docs/api/subscriptions) of the addon-item prices to the plan-item price

**Note**

If an addon-item price has [differential pricing](/docs/api/differential_prices) defined against the parent item of the plan-item price, then the pricing information in the addon-item price object returned, reflects the differential pricing.


<h3 id="list-applicable-item-prices-for-a-plan-item-price-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|item-price-id|path|string|true|none|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset`<br>to the value of `next_offset`<br>obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|item_id|query|string|false|The id of the item that the item price belongs to.<br>|
|sort_by|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Sorts based on the specified attribute.<br>**Supported attributes :**<br>name, id, updated_at<br><br>**Supported sort-orders :**<br>asc, desc<br><br>**Example →**<br>*sort_by\[asc\] = "name"*<br><br>This will sort the result based on the 'name' attribute in ascending(earliest first) order.<br>|

## List applicable items for a plan-item price

<a id="opIdlist_applicable_items_for_a_plan-item_price"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/item_prices/string/applicable_items' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /item_prices/{item-price-id}/applicable_items`

Returns the set of all applicable [addon-items](/docs/api/items)
for a specific [plan-item price](/docs/api/item_prices)
. This set consists of all addon-items whose item prices can be applied to a subscription having the plan-item price in it. When determining this set, Chargebee considers the [item_applicability](/docs/api/items/item-object#item_applicability)
and [applicable_items](/docs/api/items/item-object#applicable_items)
defined for the parent item of the plan-item price.

## List item prices

<a id="opIdlist_item_prices"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/item_prices' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /item_prices`

Returns a list of item prices satisfying **all** the conditions specified in the filter parameters below. The list is sorted by the date of creation in descending order.  

### Use Cases

##### Filter by custom fields

**Note:** Custom field filters are turned off by default. To turn them on for your site, contact [Chargebee Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support).

You can filter the response by [custom fields](/docs/api/advanced-features#filtering-by-custom-field-values) configured on item prices. After they're turned on for your site, the filter parameters are visible on this page when you're logged in. For the supported operators and limits, see [Filtering by custom field values](/docs/api/advanced-features#filtering-by-custom-field-values).

Item prices inherit the type of their parent item (`plan`, `addon`, or `charge`), and each type can have its own custom fields. As a result, the filter parameter is scoped per item price type rather than shared across item prices.

Use one of the following forms, where `cf_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME` is the exact, case-sensitive API name of a custom field configured on the corresponding item price type:

```bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 font-medium border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 mx-1 text-sm font-mono whitespace-nowrap
plan_price[cf_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME][OPERATOR]=VALUE
addon_price[cf_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME][OPERATOR]=VALUE
charge_price[cf_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME][OPERATOR]=VALUE
```

For example, to filter plan item prices by the custom field `cf_region`, pass it as a query parameter:

```bash
curl https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/item_prices \
    -G -u {site_api_key}: \
    -d plan_price[cf_region][is]="APAC"
```



<h3 id="list-item-prices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset`<br>to the value of `next_offset`<br>obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their [id](/docs/api/item_prices)<br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*id\[is\] = "basic_USD"*<br>|
|name|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their `name`<br>s.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*name\[is\] = "basic USD"*<br>|
|pricing_model|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their `pricing_model`.<br>Possible values are : flat_fee, per_unit, tiered, volume, stairstep.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*pricing_model\[is\] = "flat_fee"*<br>|
|item_id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their `item_id`<br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*item_id\[is\] = "basic"*<br>|
|item_family_id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on `item_family_id`<br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*item_family_id\[is\] = "Acme"*<br>|
|item_type|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on `item_type`.<br>Possible values are : plan, addon, charge.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*item_type\[is_not\] = "plan"*<br>|
|currency_code|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their `currency_code`<br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*currency_code\[is_not\] = "USD"*<br>|
|price_variant_id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their `price_variant_id`<br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*price_variant_id\[is\] = "tamilNadu-India"*<br>|
|trial_period|query|object|false|optional, integer filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their `trial_period`<br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, lt, lte, gt, gte, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*trial_period\[is\] = "14"*<br>|
|trial_period_unit|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their `trial_period_unit`.<br>Possible values are : day, month.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*trial_period_unit\[is\] = "day"*<br>|
|status|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their `status`.<br>Possible values are : active, archived.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*status\[is\] = "active"*<br>|

To exclude site-level resources in [specific cases](), set this parameter to `false`.<br>Possible values are : *true, false*<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*include_site_level_resources\[is\] = "null"*<br>|
|period_unit|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Filter item prices based on their `period_unit`.<br>Possible values are : day, week, month, year.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*period_unit\[is\] = "month"*<br>|

Possible values are : web, app_store, play_store.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*channel\[is\] = "APP STORE"*<br>|

`POST /item_prices`

This API creates an item price (a price point) for an [item](/docs/api/items).


> Body parameter

null

|» show_description_in_invoices|body|boolean|false|Whether the item price's description should be shown on [invoice PDFs](/docs/api/invoices/retrieve-invoice-as-pdf).<br>If this Boolean is changed, only invoices generated (or [regenerated](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/invoice-operations.html#actions-for-payment-due-not-paid-invoices_regenerate-invoice)<br>) after the change are affected; past invoices are not.<br>|
|» show_description_in_quotes|body|boolean|false|Whether the item price's description should be shown on [quote PDFs](/docs/api/quotes/retrieve-quote-as-pdf).<br>If this Boolean is changed, only quotes created after the change are affected; past quotes are not.<br>|
|» usage_accumulation_reset_frequency|body|string|false|Specifies the frequency at which the usage counter needs to be reset.  <br>**Prerequisites**<br><br>* Usage accumulation across the contract period must be enabled for the site before providing `usage_accumulation_reset_frequency`.  <br>**Constraints**<br><br>* Applicable only to metered item prices that use the `tiered` pricing model.  <br>**Note:**<br>Changes to the `usage_accumulation_reset_frequency` parameter are not allowed when the item price is already linked to a subscription.<br><br>* never - Accumulates usage without ever resetting it.<br>* subscription_billing_frequency - Accumulates usage until the subscription's billing frequency ends.<br>|
|» business_entity_id|body|string|false|The unique ID of the [business entity](/docs/api/business_entities)<br>for this `item_price`.<br>This is applicable only when multiple business entities have been created for the site. When provided, the operation will read or write data associated with the specified business entity. Quantities are purchased from successive tiers.<br>* per_unit - A fixed price per unit quantity.<br>* flat_fee - A fixed price that is not quantity-based.<br>* volume - The per unit price is based on the tier that the total quantity falls in.<br>* stairstep - A quantity-based pricing scheme. The item is charged a fixed price based on the tier that the total quantity falls in.<br>|

Requests with non-configured combinations fail validation.<br><br>* Monthly: `period=1`, `period_unit=month` (available by default)<br>* Quarterly: `period=3`, `period_unit=month` (*enable 3-month frequency in settings*)<br>* Weekly: `period=1`, `period_unit=week` (available by default) See [how billing periods apply](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/subscriptions/addons-billingcycle) .<br><br>* month - A period of 1 calendar month.<br>* week - A period of 7 days.<br>* year - A period of 1 calendar year.<br>* day - A period of 24 hours.<br>|
|» period|body|integer(int32)|false|* When the item `type` is `plan`: The billing period of the plan in `period_unit`s. For example, create a 6 month plan by providing `period` as 6 and `period_unit` as month.<br>* When item `type` is `addon`: The period of the addon in `period_unit`s. For example, create an addon with a 2 month `period` by providing period as 2 and `period_unit` as `month`. The period of an addon is the duration for which its `price` applies. When attached to a plan, the addon is billed for the billing period of the plan. [Learn more.](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/addons-billingcycle.html)<br><br>If subscriptions or invoices exist for this item price, `period`<br>cannot be changed. The `period`<br>is mandatory when the item `type`<br>is `plan`<br>or `addon`.  <br>**Important:**<br>The `period` value, together with `period_unit`, must equal one of your site's *configured billing frequencies* . If the combination does not exist, the request fails with an invalid billing period configuration error. Configure the frequency in site settings and retry. See [Addons and billing cycle](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/subscriptions/addons-billingcycle).<br>|

## Create a differential price

<a id="opIdcreate_a_differential_price"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/item_prices/string/differential_prices' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /item_prices/{item-price-id}/differential_prices`

Create a differential price for addon item price, addon item price with tiered pricing, or charge item price.


> Body parameter

null

<h1 id="chargebee-api-items">items</h1>

When offering subscriptions of products or services, each entity that is made available for sale is represented by an "item" object.

## List items

<a id="opIdlist_items"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/items' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /items`

Returns a list of items satisfying **all**
the conditions specified in the filter parameters below. The list is sorted by date of creation, in descending order.  

### Use Cases

##### Filter by custom fields

**Note:** Custom field filters are turned off by default. To turn them on for your site, contact [Chargebee Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support).

You can filter the response by [custom fields](/docs/api/advanced-features#filtering-by-custom-field-values) configured on items. After they're turned on for your site, the filter parameters are visible on this page when you're logged in. For the supported operators and limits, see [Filtering by custom field values](/docs/api/advanced-features#filtering-by-custom-field-values).

Items can be one of three types: `plan`, `addon`, or `charge`. Each type can have its own custom fields, so the filter parameter is scoped per item type rather than shared across items.

Use one of the following forms, where `cf_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME` is the exact, case-sensitive API name of a custom field configured on the corresponding item type:

```bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 font-medium border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 mx-1 text-sm font-mono whitespace-nowrap
plan_item[cf_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME][OPERATOR]=VALUE
addon_item[cf_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME][OPERATOR]=VALUE
charge_item[cf_CUSTOM_FIELD_NAME][OPERATOR]=VALUE
```

For example, to filter plan items by the custom field `cf_package_id`, pass it as a query parameter:

```bash
curl https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/items \
    -G -u {site_api_key}: \
    -d plan_item[cf_package_id][is]="pkg-basic"
```



<h3 id="list-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset`<br>to the value of `next_offset`<br>obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter items based on item id.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*id\[is\] = "basic"*<br>|
|item_family_id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter items based on `item_family_id`<br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*item_family_id\[is\] = "acme"*<br>|
|type|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Filter items based on item `type`.<br>Possible values are : plan, addon, charge.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*type\[is\] = "plan"*<br>|
|name|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter items based on item `name`<br>.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with<br><br>**Example →**<br>*name\[is_not\] = "basic"*<br>|
|item_applicability|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Filter items based on `item_applicability`.<br>Possible values are : all, restricted.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*item_applicability\[is_not\] = "all"*<br>|
|status|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Filter items based on item `status`.<br>Possible values are : active, archived.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*status\[is\] = "active"*<br>|
|is_giftable|query|object|false|optional, boolean filter<br><br>Specifies if gift subscriptions can be created for this item. Possible values are : *true, false*<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*is_giftable\[is\] = "true"*<br>|
|updated_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>Filter items based on when the items were last updated.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*updated_at\[after\] = "1243545465"*<br>|
|enabled_for_checkout|query|object|false|optional, boolean filter<br><br>Allow the plan to subscribed to via Checkout. Applies only for plan-items.<br>**Note:**<br>Only the in-app layout of Checkout is supported. Possible values are : *true, false*<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*enabled_for_checkout\[is\] = "null"*<br>|
|enabled_in_portal|query|object|false|optional, boolean filter<br><br>Allow customers to change their subscription to this plan via the [Self-Serve Portal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/inapp-self-serve-portal.html).<br>Applies only for plan-items. This requires the Portal configuration to [allow changing subscriptions](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/inapp-self-serve-portal.html#allow-change-subscription).<br>Possible values are : *true, false*<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*enabled_in_portal\[is\] = "null"*<br>|
|metered|query|object|false|optional, boolean filter<br><br>Specifies whether the item undergoes metered billing. When `true`, the quantity is calculated from [usage records](/docs/api/usages). When `false`, the `quantity` is as determined while adding an item price to the subscription. Applicable only for items of `type` `plan` or `addon` and when [Metered Billing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/usage-based-billing/metered_billing) is enabled. The value of this attribute cannot be changed. Possible values are : *true, false*<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*metered\[is\] = "true"*<br>|
|usage_calculation|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>How the quantity is calculated from usage data for the item prices belonging to this item. Only applicable when the item is `metered`.<br>This value overrides the one [set at the site level](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/usage-based-billing/metered_billing#configuring-metered-billing).<br>Possible values are : sum_of_usages, last_usage, max_usage.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*usage_calculation\[is_not\] = "SUM_OF_USAGES"*<br>|
|channel|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>The subscription channel this object originated from and is maintained in. Possible values are : web, app_store, play_store.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*channel\[is\] = "APP STORE"*<br>|
|business_entity_id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>The unique ID of the<br>[business entity](/docs/api/business_entities)<br>of this `item`.<br>[Learn more](/docs/api/using_business_entity_filters_in_product_catalog_list_apis)<br>about all the scenarios before using this filter.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_present<br><br>**Example →**<br>*business_entity_id\[is_present\] = "true"*<br>|
|include_site_level_resources|query|object|false|optional, boolean filter<br><br>Default value is `true` . To exclude site-level resources in [specific cases](), set this parameter to `false`.<br>Possible values are : *true, false*<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*include_site_level_resources\[is\] = "null"*<br>|
|sort_by|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Sorts based on the specified attribute.<br>**Supported attributes :**<br>name, id, updated_at<br><br>**Supported sort-orders :**<br>asc, desc<br><br>**Example →**<br>*sort_by\[asc\] = "name"*<br><br>This will sort the result based on the 'name' attribute in ascending(earliest first) order.<br>|

## Create an item

<a id="opIdcreate_an_item"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/items' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /items`

Creates a new item.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» id|body|string|true|The identifier for the item. Must be unique and is immutable once set.<br>|
|» name|body|string|true|A unique display name for the item. Must be unique. This is visible only in Chargebee and not to customers.<br>|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of the item.<br><br>* plan - An essential component of a subscription. Every subscription has exactly one plan. It has a recurring charge and its period defines the billing period of the subscription.<br>* charge -<br>  A non-recurring component that can be added to a subscription in addition to its plan. An charge can also be applied to a customer [directly](/docs/api/v2/pcv-1/invoices/create-invoice-for-a-one-time-charge)<br>  without being applied to a subscription.<br>* addon - A recurring component that can be added to a subscription in addition to its plan.<br>|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the item. This is visible only in Chargebee and not to customers.<br>|
|» item_family_id|body|string|true|The `id`<br>of the [Item family](/docs/api/item_families)<br>that the item belongs to. Is mandatory when [Product Families](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/product-families.html)<br>have been enabled.<br>|
|» is_giftable|body|boolean|false|Specifies if gift subscriptions can be created for this item.<br>|
|» is_shippable|body|boolean|false|Indicates that the item is a physical product. If Orders are enabled in Chargebee, subscriptions created for this item will have orders associated with them.<br>|
|» external_name|body|string|false|A unique display name for the item.<br>|
|» enabled_in_portal|body|boolean|false|Allow customers to change their subscription to this plan via the [Self-Serve Portal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/inapp-self-serve-portal.html).<br>Applies only for plan-items. This requires the Portal configuration to [allow changing subscriptions](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/inapp-self-serve-portal.html#allow-change-subscription).<br>Only the in-app version of the Portal is supported for Product Catalog v2.<br>|
|» redirect_url|body|string|false|If `enabled_for_checkout`<br>, then the URL to be redirected to once the checkout is complete. This attribute is only available for plan-items.<br>|
|» enabled_for_checkout|body|boolean|false|Allow the plan to subscribed to via Checkout. Applies only for plan-items.<br>**Note:**<br>Only the in-app layout of Checkout is supported.<br>|
|» item_applicability|body|string|false|Indicates which addon-items and charge-items can be applied to the item. Only possible for plan-items. Other details of attaching items such as whether to attach as a mandatory item or to attach on a certain event, can be specified using the [Create](/docs/api/attached_items/create-an-attached-item)<br>or [Update an attached item](/docs/api/attached_items/update-an-attached-item)<br>API.<br><br>* all - all addon-items and charge-items are applicable to this plan-item.<br>* restricted -<br>  only the addon-items or charge-items provided in `applicable_items`<br>  can be applied to this plan-item.<br>|
|» applicable_items|body|[string]|false|The list of ids of addon-items and charge-items that can be applied to the plan-item. This parameter can be provided only for plan-items and that too when item_applicability is restricted. Other details of attaching items can be specified using the [Create](/docs/api/attached_items/create-an-attached-item)<br>or [Update an attached item](/docs/api/attached_items/update-an-attached-item)<br>API.<br>|
|» unit|body|string|false|The unit of measure for a quantity-based item. This is displayed on the Chargebee UI and on customer facing documents/pages. The latter includes [hosted pages](/docs/api/hosted_pages)<br>, [invoices](/docs/api/invoices)<br>and [quotes](/docs/api/quotes).<br>Examples follow:<br><br>* "user" for a cloud-collaboration platform.<br>* "GB" for a data service.<br>* "issue" for a magazine.<br>|
|» gift_claim_redirect_url|body|string|false|The URL to redirect to once the gift has been claimed by the receiver.<br>|
|» included_in_mrr|body|boolean|false|The item is included in MRR calculations for your site. This attribute is only applicable for items of `type = charge`<br>and when the feature is enabled in Chargebee. Note: If the site-level setting is to exclude charge-items from MRR calculations, this value is always returned `false`<br>.<br>|
|» metered|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether the item undergoes usage-based or metered billing. [Usage Based Billing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/usage-based-billing/understanding-usages) or [Metered Billing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/usage-based-billing/metered_billing) must be enabled on your site to set `metered` to `true`.<br><br>**Usage Based Billing**<br><br>When Usage Based Billing is enabled, `metered` is applicable only for items of `type` `addon`. When `true`, the quantity is calculated from [usage events](/docs/api/usage_events/create-a-usage-event). When `false`, you must provide the quantity when adding an [item price](/docs/api/item_prices) that belongs to this item to a subscription (for example, when [creating](/docs/api/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-items#subscription_items_quantity) or [updating](/docs/api/subscriptions/update-subscription-for-items#subscription_items_quantity) the subscription).<br><br>**Metered Billing**<br><br>When Metered Billing is enabled, `metered` is applicable only for items of `type` `plan` or `addon`. When `true`, the quantity is calculated from [usage records](/docs/api/usages). When `false`, you must provide the quantity when adding an [item price](/docs/api/item_prices) that belongs to this item to a subscription (for example, when [creating](/docs/api/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-items#subscription_items_quantity) or [updating](/docs/api/subscriptions/update-subscription-for-items#subscription_items_quantity) the subscription).<br>|
|» usage_calculation|body|string|false|How the quantity is calculated from usage data for the item prices belonging to this item. Only applicable when the item is `metered`.<br>This value overrides the one [set at the site level](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/usage-based-billing/metered_billing#configuring-metered-billing).<br>.<br><br>* sum_of_usages -<br>  the net quantity is the sum of the `quantity`<br>  of all usages for the current term.<br>* last_usage -<br>  from among the usage records for the [item price](/docs/api/subscriptions/subscription-object#subscription_items_item_price_id)<br>  with `usage_date`<br>  within the relevant billing period, the `quantity`<br>  of the usage record with the most recent `usage_date`<br>  is taken as the net quantity consumed.<br>* max_usage -<br>  from among the usage records for the [item price](/docs/api/subscriptions/subscription-object#subscription_items_item_price_id)<br>  with `usage_date`<br>  within the relevant billing period, the `quantity`<br>  of the usage record with the maximum value is taken as the net quantity consumed.<br>|
|» is_percentage_pricing|body|boolean|false|Indicates whether the pricing is percentage-based.<br>|
|» metadata|body|object|false|A collection of key-value pairs that provides extra information about the item.  <br>**Note:**<br>There's a character limit of 65,535.<br><br>[Learn more](/docs/api/advanced-features#metadata).<br>|
|» business_entity_id|body|string|false|The unique ID of the [business entity](/docs/api/business_entities)<br>for this `item`.<br>This is applicable only when multiple business entities have been created for the site. When provided, the operation will read or write data associated with the specified business entity. If not provided, the resource will be created at the site level, and the `business_entity_id`<br>will not be included in the API response.  <br>**Note**<br>An alternative way of passing this parameter is by means of a [custom HTTP header](/docs/api/advanced-features#mbe-header-main).<br>|
|» bundle_configuration|body|object|false|Parameters of `bundle_configuration`<br>|
|» » type|body|string|false|Type of the bundle<br><br>* fixed -<br>  Fixed `bundle_configuration.type`<br>  appears when you create a [bundle plan](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/product-bundling-overview.html)<br>  that cannot be updated during checkout or subscription creation.<br>|
|» bundle_items_to_add|body|object|false|Parameters for `bundle_items_to_add`<br>|
|» » item_id|body|[string]|false|[`item_id`](/docs/api/items/item-object#id)<br>that needs to be added to the bundle.<br>**Note:**<br>This parameter is only applicable when the [`item_type`](/docs/api/items/item-object#type)<br>is `plan`<br>.<br>|
|» » item_type|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » quantity|body|[integer(int32)]|false|Quantity of the item(plan, addon, and charge) associated with the bundle.<br>|
|» » price_allocation|body|[number(decimal)]|false|Price allocation of the item(plan, addon, and charge) associated with the bundle.<br>|

## Delete an item

<a id="opIddelete_an_item"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/items/string/delete' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /items/{item-id}/delete`

Deletes an item, marking its `status`
as deleted. This is not allowed if there are `active`
or `archived`
item prices under the item. Once deleted, the id and name of the item can be reused.


<h3 id="delete-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|item-id|path|string|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|

|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|

## Update an item

<a id="opIdupdate_an_item"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/items/string' \

  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /items/{item-id}`

Updates an item with the changes specified. Unspecified item parameters are not modified.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|item-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|The display name for the item. Must be unique. This is visible only in Chargebee and not to customers.<br>|

This is visible only in Chargebee and not to customers.  <br>**Note**:<br><br>* The description field supports up to 2000 characters, including HTML tags. If the sanitized content exceeds the allowed limit, the request will be rejected.<br>|

## List attached items

<a id="opIdlist_attached_items"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/items/string/attached_items' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /items/{item-id}/attached_items`

Returns a list of attached items satisfying **all**
the conditions specified in the filter parameters below. The list is sorted by the date of creation in descending order (latest first).


<h3 id="list-attached-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|item-id|path|string|true|none|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset`<br>to the value of `next_offset`<br>obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter attached items based on their id.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*id\[is\] = "bec0c324-adb6-44d3-ad4f-694f449be97c"*<br>|
|item_id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Filter attached items based on the `item_id`<br>of the item being attached.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*item_id\[is\] = "basic"*<br>|
|type|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Filter attached items based on the `type`<br>of attached item. Possible values are : `recommended`<br>, `mandatory`<br>, `optional`.<br>Possible values are : recommended, mandatory, optional.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*type\[is\] = "mandatory"*<br>|
|item_type|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>To filter based on the type of of the attached item. Possible values are : `addon`<br>, `charge`.<br>Possible values are : plan, addon, charge.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*item_type\[is_not\] = "plan"*<br>|
|charge_on_event|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Indicates when the item is charged. This attribute only applies to charge-items. Possible values are : subscription_creation, subscription_trial_start, plan_activation, subscription_activation, contract_termination, on_demand.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*charge_on_event\[is\] = "subscription_creation"*<br>|
|updated_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>Filter attached items based on when the attached items were last updated.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*updated_at\[after\] = "1243545465"*<br>|

## Create an attached item

<a id="opIdcreate_an_attached_item"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/items/string/attached_items' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /items/{item-id}/attached_items`

Creates an attached addon or a charge item for a plan.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-an-attached-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|item-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» item_id|body|string|true|The id of the addon or charge that is being attached to the plan-item.<br>|
|» type|body|string|false|The type of attachment for the addon. Only applicable for addon-items and is a required parameter as well for addon-items.<br><br>* recommended -<br>  The addon is recommended to go with the plan-item when using [Checkout](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/configure-inapp.html#fundamental-settings_recommending-addons-in-checkout)<br>  or [Portal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/inapp-self-serve-portal.html#allow-change-subscription)<br>  .<br>* optional -<br>  The addon is neither mandatory, nor recommended. This allows you to attach an addon so you can specify a `quantity`<br>  and `billing_cycles`<br>  for the addon, for when it is applied to subscriptions with the plan.<br>* mandatory -<br>  The addon is attached automatically to the subscription for the plan-item unless [explicitly removed](/docs/api/subscriptions)<br>  via API.<br>|
|» billing_cycles|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of subscription billing cycles for which this item is attached when applied to a subscription. Applicable only for items of type addon. Requires [addon billing cycles](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/addons-billingcycle.html)<br>to be enabled for the site.<br><br>The value set explicitly for `billing_cycles`<br>while [applying the addon to a subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/subscription-object#subscription_items)<br>takes precedence over this parameter. This parameter, in turn, has a higher precedence than [the value set for the addon-item price](/docs/api/item_prices)<br>.<br>|
|» quantity|body|integer(int32)|false|The default quantity of the addon to be attached when the quantity is not specified while [creating](/docs/api/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-items)<br>/[updating](/docs/api/subscriptions/update-subscription-for-items)<br>the subscription.<br>|
|» quantity_in_decimal|body|string|false|The decimal representation of the quantity of the addon. Returned for quantity-based addons when [multi-decimal pricing](/docs/api/getting-started)<br>is enabled.<br>|
|» charge_on_event|body|string|false|Indicates when the item is charged. This parameter only applies to charge-items.<br><br>* contract_termination -<br>  when a contract term is [terminated](/docs/api/subscriptions/cancel-subscription-for-items#contract_term_cancel_option)<br>  .<br>* subscription_creation - the time of creation of the subscription.<br>* subscription_trial_start - the time when the trial period of the subscription begins.<br>* on_demand - Item can be charged on demand<br>* plan_activation - same as subscription activation, but also includes the case when the plan-item of the subscription is changed.<br>* subscription_activation -<br>  the moment a subscription enters an `active`<br>  or `non-renewing`<br>  state. Also includes reactivations of canceled subscriptions.<br>|
|» charge_once|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the charge-item is to be charged only once or each time the `charge_on_event`<br>occurs. This parameter only applies to charge-items.<br>|
|» business_entity_id|body|string|false|The unique ID of the [business entity](/docs/api/business_entities) for this `attached_item`. This is applicable only when multiple business entities have been created for the site. When provided, the operation will read or write data associated with the specified business entity. If not provided, the resource will be created at the site level, and the `business_entity_id` will not be included in the API response.<br><br>**Note** : An alternative way of passing this parameter is by using a [custom HTTP header](/docs/api/advanced-features) or [query string parameter](/docs/api/advanced-features#mbe-alternative).<br>|

<a id="opIdupsert_or_remove_item_entitlements_for_an_item"></a>

`POST /items/{item-id}/item_entitlements`

**Deprecated**
This operation is deprecated and no longer maintained. Migrate your integration to [Manage entitlements](/docs/api/entitlements/upsert-or-remove-entitlements-for-a-feature).  
**Warning**
This operation is not supported when [grandfathering](/docs/api/entitlements) is enabled.

Upserts or removes a set of `item_entitlements` for an [item](/docs/api/items) depending on the `action` specified. The API returns the upserted or deleted `item_entitlements` after successfully completing the operation. The operation returns an error when the first `item_entitlement` fails to be processed. Either all the `item_entitlement`s provided in the request are processed or none.
