## Create a payment schedule scheme

<a id="opIdcreate_a_payment_schedule_scheme"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_schedule_schemes' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_schedule_schemes`

Creates a payment schedule scheme. After creating a payment schedule scheme, you can use it to generate payment schedules for multiple invoices.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-a-payment-schedule-scheme-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» number_of_schedules|body|integer(int32)|true|Specifies the total number of payment schedules for the invoice. The maximum `number_of_schedules`<br>varies based on the `period_unit`<br>: - **Day**: Up to 30 schedules<br><br>* **Week**: Up to 52 schedules<br>* **Month**: Up to 12 schedules<br>|
|» period_unit|body|string|true|Defines the time unit for intervals between payment schedules. Possible values are: day, week, and month.<br><br>* month - When the time unit for intervals between payment schedules is set as month<br>* week - When the time unit for intervals between payment schedules is set as week<br>* day - When the time unit for intervals between payment schedules is set as day<br>|
|» period|body|integer(int32)|false|The time period between the effective dates of two consecutive payment schedules, expressed in period_units. Use this parameter to have fixed intervals between payment schedules. The maximum `period`<br>varies based on the `period_unit`<br>: - **Day**: Up to 30 days<br><br>* **Week**: Up to 6 weeks<br>* **Month**: Up to 6 months<br>|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of a payment schedule scheme.<br>|
|» flexible_schedules|body|object|false|Parameters for flexible_schedules<br>|
|» » period|body|[integer(int32)]|false|The interval after which this payment schedule should be collected.<br>|
|» » amount_percentage|body|[number(decimal)]|false|The percentage amount that this specific payment schedule should collect.<br>|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-paymentschedules">payment_schedules</h1>

Payment schedules for an invoice refer to a payment structure where the `amount_due` on an invoice is divided into smaller, more manageable parts, each of which is paid over a specified period.

## List payment schedules

<a id="opIdlist_payment_schedules"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_schedules' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /payment_schedules`

Returns a list of payment schedules that match **all** the specified filter conditions. The list is sorted by `updated_at` in descending order. Use `limit` and `offset` to paginate through the results.

Use `invoice_id` to restrict results to one or more invoices. To fetch schedules for a single invoice by path, use the [Retrieve payment schedules for an invoice](/docs/api/invoices/retrieve-payment-schedules-for-an-invoice) API.


<h3 id="list-payment-schedules-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset`<br>to the value of `next_offset`<br>obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|invoice_id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>The invoice number of the invoice this payment schedule belongs to.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*invoice_id\[is\] = "INV-001"*<br>|
|id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>An auto-generated unique identifier for the payment schedule.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*id\[is\] = "ps_123"*<br>|
|updated_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>To filter based on `updated_at`.<br>This attribute will be present only if the resource has been updated after 2016-09-28.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*updated_at\[after\] = "1435054328"*<br>|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-paymentsources">payment_sources</h1>

**Updates** This API obsoletes the [Cards API](/docs/api/cards) in Chargebee.

## Create using permanent token

<a id="opIdcreate_using_permanent_token"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/create_using_permanent_token' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/create_using_permanent_token`

Creates a payment source for a [customer](/docs/api/customers) using a permanent token obtained from the [payment gateway](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/gateway_settings).

Use this API to add a payment method that has already been vaulted in your gateway account. The permanent token enables Chargebee to securely link the payment method to the customer. This enables payment collection for future charges (both recurring and one-time) without requiring the customer to re-enter their payment details.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* The permanent token must belong to a gateway account configured in Chargebee.
* The token should be a **permanent/vault token**, not a single-use token.
* When multiple gateway accounts are configured in [Chargebee Billing](https://app.chargebee.com), you must pass the `gateway_account_id` parameter if:
  * [Smart Routing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/gateway_settings#smart-routing) is not configured for the payment method.
* Smart Routing is configured for the payment method, but the selected gateway account does not match the provided token.  

### Impacts

**Customer**  
Pass the [`replace_primary_payment_source`](/docs/api/payment_sources/create-using-permanent-token#replace_primary_payment_source) parameter as `true` to update the customer's [`primary_payment_source_id`](/docs/api/payment_sources/export-payment-source). Otherwise, the existing primary payment source will remain unchanged.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-using-permanent-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|

|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

## Delete a payment source

<a id="opIddelete_a_payment_source"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/string/delete' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/{cust-payment-source-id}/delete`

Deletes a payment source. Once the payment source is deleted, if

* **Deleted payment source is Primary, and Backup is available**
  * The Backup payment source will become the Primary payment source.
* **Deleted payment source is Primary, and no Backup is available**
  * The other payment source available, but not assigned to any subscription, will become the Primary payment source.

    **Note** : *When multiple payment sources exist, the payment method added most recently will be considered*.
  * If other payment sources available are assigned to subscriptions, the auto collection attribute for the customer will be set to Off, and the events *card_deleted* and *payment_source_deleted* will be triggered.

* **Deleted payment source is attached to subscriptions**
  * Dunning will be initiated for subscriptions attached to this payment source if auto collection is set to On, and when no customer default is present.

If there is no such payment source present in the gateway for the customer, this API will return successfully without throwing any error.  
**Note**
:

If you delete the only available payment method of a customer in Chargebee, it also deletes the customer's record at the gateway. To delete the payment method locally(delete only in Chargebee), use [Local Delete a Payment Source API](/docs/api/payment_sources/local-delete-a-payment-source)
.


<h3 id="delete-a-payment-source-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|cust-payment-source-id|path|string|true|none|

|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|

## Verify bank account payment source

<a id="opIdverify_bank_account_payment_source"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/string/verify_bank_account' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/{cust-payment-source-id}/verify_bank_account`

This API can be used to verify bank accounts which have been added as payment source. This is applicable for **Stripe ACH with micro-deposit mode bank accounts** only. Stripe handles verification in two ways - via Plaid, and micro-deposit.

For verifying bank accounts via **micro-deposit**, Stripe deposits two small amounts to the bank account being added. These deposits will take 1-2 business days to appear on the customer's bank statement. The bank statement description for the two micro-deposits contains the amount and the values deposited. Your customer will need to relay the value of the two deposits to you, after which you can verify the bank account. Once the bank account has been verified, the payment source will be marked as "Valid".  
A maximum of 10 failed verification attempts are allowed. Once this limit has been crossed, the bank account can no longer be verified, and will be marked as "Invalid" in Chargebee.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

`GET /payment_sources`

Lists all the payment sources

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset`<br>to the value of `next_offset`<br>obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|subscription_id|query|string|false|Unique subscription identifier that helps to retrieve the payment source of a subscription which has `mandate`<br>associated to it.<br>|
|include_deleted|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether to include deleted objects in the list. The deleted objects have the attribute '`deleted`<br>' as '`true`<br>'.<br>|
|customer_id|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>To filter based on Customer Id.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*customer_id\[is\] = "3bdjnDnsdQn"*<br>|
|type|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Type of payment source. Possible values are : card, paypal_express_checkout, amazon_payments, direct_debit, generic, alipay, alipay_hk, gcash, ovo, momo, mercado_pago, nequi, nupay, picpay, thai_qr, blik, fpx, wero, p24, affirm_pay, rakuten_pay, dana, touch_n_go, tamara, qpay, unionpay, apple_pay, wechat_pay, ideal, google_pay, sofort, bancontact, giropay, dotpay, upi, netbanking_emandates.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*type\[is\] = "card"*<br>|
|status|query|object|false|optional, enumerated string filter<br><br>Current status of the payment source. Possible values are : valid, expiring, expired, invalid, pending_verification.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, in, not_in<br><br>**Example →**<br>*status\[is\] = "valid"*<br>|
|updated_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>Timestamp indicating when this payment source resource was last updated.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*updated_at\[on\] = "1435054328"*<br>|
|created_at|query|object|false|optional, timestamp(UTC) in seconds filter<br><br>Timestamp indicating when this payment source resource is created.<br>**Supported operators :**<br>after, before, on, between<br><br>**Example →**<br>*created_at\[on\] = "1435054328"*<br>|
|sort_by|query|object|false|optional, string filter<br><br>Sorts based on the specified attribute.<br>**Supported attributes :**<br>created_at, updated_at<br><br>**Supported sort-orders :**<br>asc, desc<br><br>**Example →**<br>*sort_by\[asc\] = "created_at"*<br><br>This will sort the result based on the 'created_at' attribute in ascending(earliest first) order.<br>|

## Export payment source

<a id="opIdexport_payment_source"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/string/export_payment_source' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/{cust-payment-source-id}/export_payment_source`

Copies this payment source information to the gateway specified in the API.

This is useful if you want to port your customer's card details into another gateway.  
This operation does not support copying of cards from Stripe and Braintree gateways. If you need help using this API, contact [Chargebee Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support).


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|---|---|---|---|---|

|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|

|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|cust-payment-source-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» gateway_account_id|body|string|true|The gateway account you want to copy the card.<br>|

information.<br>    * `fraud_session_id`: Your Chargebee Payments fraud session ID required to perform anti-fraud validation.<br>* `bank_of_america`: While passing raw card details to Bank of America, your user's `device_session_id` can be added to perform additional validation and avoid fraudulent transactions.<br><br>  * `fraud`: Fraud identification related information.<br>    * `device_session_id`: Session ID associated with the user's device.<br>* `ecentric`: This parameter is used to verify and process payment method details in Ecentric. If the `merchant_id` parameter is included, Chargebee will vault it / perform a lookup and verification against this `merchant_id`, overriding the one configured in Chargebee. ## Create using gateway temporary token

<a id="opIdcreate_using_gateway_temporary_token"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/create_using_temp_token' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/create_using_temp_token`

This API offers an alternative way to create a payment source using a single-use gateway temporary token, which is generally provided by your payment gateway. In the case of Stripe, this temporary token is generated according to the instruction detailed in [Stripe documentation](https://stripe.com/docs/api/tokens/create_card).  
Storing card after successful 3DS completion is not supported in this API. Use [create using Payment Intent API](/docs/api/payment_sources/create-using-payment-intent)
under Payment source to store the card after successful 3DS flow completion.

null
```

## Update a card payment source

<a id="opIdupdate_a_card_payment_source"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/string/update_card' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/{cust-payment-source-id}/update_card`

Merchants look to update card details when:

* The billing address of a customer has changed. In such a case, modify the billing address in the Chargebee and the payment gateway.
* The expiration date of the card has been extended by the bank. (This usually happens when the date of card expiry is in near future).

Multiple parameters such as address, expiry date, month, and so on, can be updated through this API.

You can also pass `network_transaction_reference` to store or replace the original network transaction identifier on the payment source. When it is sent with other card fields, Chargebee calls the gateway first and persists the identifier only after a successful update. When it is the only parameter in the request, Chargebee updates it locally, does not call the gateway, and does not apply the gateway-support restriction in the note below.

Meta data can also be added additionally(supported in Stripe only). Metadata is a JSON object. It is used to store additional information about customers.

In **Stripe** and **Braintree** payment gateways, changes in card details are auto-updated. This feature can also be used for other payment gateways in which auto-update is not enabled or is not supported by Chargebee.  
**Note**
: This endpoint supports Chargebee Test Gateway, [Stripe](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/stripe.html)
, [Braintree](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/braintree.html)
, [Authorize.net](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/authorize-index.html)
, [Worldpay US eCom](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/vantiv_worldpay.html)
, and [WorldPay Direct Integration](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/worldpay-direct.html)
. For all other gateways, your customers must re-enter the full [card details](/docs/api/payment_sources/update-a-card-payment-source#card_first_name)
to update existing card details. For example, consider a customer not using the gateways mentioned above and wants to update the [card\[billing_addr1\]](/docs/api/payment_sources/update-a-card-payment-source#card_billing_addr1)
parameter. In such a case, the customer must re-enter the value of all the parameters present in the [card](/docs/api/payment_sources/update-a-card-payment-source#card_first_name)
object.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="update-a-card-payment-source-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|

## Switch gateway account

<a id="opIdswitch_gateway_account"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/string/switch_gateway_account' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/{cust-payment-source-id}/switch_gateway_account`

Moves a card payment source from one gateway account to another.

Use this operation to migrate payment methods between gateway accounts, such as when:

* consolidating gateway accounts
* switching from Spreedly to direct gateway integration
* aligning payment sources with regional/business unit gateway configurations

#### Supported gateways

See the **Use Cases** section for the list of supported source-destination gateway combinations.  

#### Impact on `reference_id`

This operation updates the [`reference_id`](/docs/api/payment_sources/payment_source-object#reference_id) attribute of the payment source. In case you are using this value for any downstream system integrations, you will need to update the `reference_id` for the payment source in the downstream system to the new value.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* The [`payment_source.type`](/docs/api/payment_sources/payment_source-object#type) must be `card`.
* The destination payment gateway account must be active and not [archived](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/kb/billing/archiving-gateways).  

### Impacts

**Payment source**  
* The following attributes are updated:
* [`gateway_account_id`](/docs/api/payment_sources/payment_source-object#gateway_account_id)
* [`gateway`](/docs/api/payment_sources/payment_source-object#gateway)
* [`reference_id`](/docs/api/payment_sources/payment_source-object#reference_id)
* The role ([primary](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#primary_payment_source_id) or [backup](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#backup_payment_source_id)) of the payment source is not changed.  

### Use Cases

#### Supported source-destination gateway combinations

The API supports only the following source-destination gateway combinations:  

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Destination                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Any of the gateways via Spreedly. These include [Authorize.net](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/authorize), [Bambora](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/bambora), [BlueSnap](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/bluesnap-spreedly), [Moneris](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/moneris), [Orbital (Chase Paymentech)](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/orbital), [Paymill](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/paymill), [PayPal Payments Pro](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/paypal_payments_pro), [PayPal Payflow Pro](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/paypal_payflow_pro), [SagePay](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/sagepay), [Worldline Online Payments](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/ingenico), [Worldpay](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/worldpay). | * Any of the gateways via Spreedly. OR * Any of the following gateways: [Stripe](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/stripe), [Authorize.net (direct integration)](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/authorize-direct), [Braintree](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/braintree), [BlueSnap (direct integration)](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/bluesnap), and [Worldpay (direct integration)](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/worldpay-direct). |
| [PayPal Express Checkout](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/paypal_express_checkout)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | [PayPal Commerce](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/1.0/payment-gateways-and-configuration/paypal-commerce)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

## Local delete a payment source

<a id="opIdlocal_delete_a_payment_source"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/string/delete_local' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/{cust-payment-source-id}/delete_local`

Delete a **payment source** reference from a Chargebee customer without deleting or altering payment source data stored at the payment gateway.  

### Impacts

**Payment Source**  
Sets `deleted` = `true` on the specified `payment_source` and detaches it from the customer. The payment source is no longer accessible through the API or the UI.  
**Customer**  
If the deleted `payment_source` is the customer's only payment method and [`auto_collection`](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#auto_collection) is `on`, [automatic payment collection](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/customers/customers#auto-collection-status) for future invoices fails.

If the deleted payment source was the [primary](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#primary_payment_source_id) payment method for the customer, and a [backup](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#backup_payment_source_id) exists, Chargebee promotes the backup to primary.

If no backup is set but other `payment_source` objects exist for the [customer](/docs/api/payment_sources/payment_source-object#customer_id), Chargebee promotes one of them to primary.  
**Subscription**  
When you delete a payment source [linked](/docs/api/subscriptions/subscription-object#payment_source_id) to an active [subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions), Chargebee immediately clears the `payment_source_id` on that subscription. Future charges use the customer's `primary_payment_source_id`.  

#### Related APIs

[Delete a payment source](/docs/api/payment_sources?prod_cat_ver=2#delete_a_payment_source)[List payment sources](/docs/api/payment_sources?prod_cat_ver=2#list_payment_sources)

|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|

## Create a bank account payment source

<a id="opIdcreate_a_bank_account_payment_source"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/create_bank_account' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/create_bank_account`

This API adds a Direct Debit payment source for a customer. The bank account details collected from your customer are passed as input to this API.

#### [Automated Clearing House (ACH) Network](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/direct-debit-payments.html#direct-debit-payments-in-the-united-states)

ACH is an electronic network for passing financial transactions in the US. Chargebee currently supports ACH via [Stripe](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/ach-payments-stripe.html) , [Authorize.Net](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/ach-payments-authorize_net.html), and [GoCardless](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/gocardless.html).  
**Note:**

* For ACH via Stripe, it is mandatory to pass [user details](/docs/api/advanced-features) such as IP address(`chargebee-request-origin-ip`) and the device information(`chargebee-request-origin-device`).

##### Bank account verification

Once the bank account has been added, it needs to be verified.

* For Stripe, perform this verification using the [Verify bank account payment source API](/docs/api/payment_sources/verify-bank-account-payment-source).
* For [Authorize.net](https://www.authorize.net/), the verification is done by them in 2-3 days after the account is added. No intervention is needed from your side or your customer.

#### Single Euro Payment Area (SEPA)

SEPA is an initiative that integrates bank transfer payments denominated in euro. It is supported via [GoCardless](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/gocardless.html), [Stripe](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/sepa-stripe.html) and [Adyen](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/adyen-sepa.html).  
**Note:**

* For SEPA via Stripe, it is mandatory to pass [user details](/docs/api/advanced-features) such as IP address and device information.
* For GoCardless, [local bank details](https://developer.gocardless.com/api-reference/#appendix-local-bank-details) can be passed instead of IBAN.

#### Bacs Payment Schemes Limited (BACS) and Bg Autogiro

Bacs is an organization that manages the Direct Debit and Direct Credit payment methods in the UK. Bg Autogiro is a Direct Debit scheme for krona denominated payments in Sweden. Both Bacs and Bg Autogiro are supported via [GoCardless](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/gocardless.html).  
**Note:**

* For BACS via Stripe, it is mandatory to pass [user details](/docs/api/advanced-features) such as IP address(`chargebee-request-origin-ip`) and the device information(`chargebee-request-origin-device`).

#### Bulk Electronic Clearing System (BECS) and Pre-Authorized Debit (PAD)

BECS is an automated payment method for Direct Debit in Australia and New Zealand while PAD does the same for Canada. [GoCardless](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/gocardless.html) supports both.

For Direct Debit, the customer needs to accept a mandate that allows the merchant to debit their bank account. This agreement PDF can be obtained using the [Retrieve direct debit agreement PDF API](/docs/api/hosted_pages/retrieve-direct-debit-agreement-pdf).

If the customer has already reached the payment source limit allowed for the site, pass `replace_primary_payment_source` as `true`. Alternatively, [delete](/docs/api/payment_sources/delete-a-payment-source) one of the payment sources first and then add the bank account payment source for the customer.  
**Note:**

* For BECS via Stripe, it is mandatory to pass [user details](/docs/api/advanced-features) such as IP address(`chargebee-request-origin-ip`) and the device information(`chargebee-request-origin-device`).


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

If not passed, account type is taken as null.<br><br>* current - Current Account<br>* savings - Savings Account<br>* checking - Checking Account<br>* business_checking - Business Checking Account<br>|

The value is a JSON object with the following keys and their values:- `first_name`:(string, max chars=150) The first name of the contact.<br><br>* `last_name`:(string, max chars=150) The last name of the contact.<br>* `company_name`:(string, max chars=250) The company name for the address.<br>* `line1`:(string, max chars=180) The first line of the address.<br>* `line2`:(string, max chars=180) The second line of the address.<br>* `country`:(string) The name of the country for the address.<br>* `country_code`:(string, max chars=50) The two-letter, [ISO 3166 alpha-2](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html) country code for the address.<br>* `state`:(string, max chars=50) The name of the state or province for the address. When not provided, this is set automatically for US, Canada, India, and UAE.<br>* `state_code`:(string, max chars=50) The [ISO 3166-2 state/province code](https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search/code/) without the country prefix. This is supported for USA, Canada, India, and UAE. For instance, for Arizona (USA), set state_code as `AZ` (not `US-AZ`). For Tamil Nadu (India), set as `TN` (not `IN-TN`). For British Columbia (Canada), set as `BC` (not `CA-BC`). For Dubai (UAE), set as `DU` (not `AE-DU`).<br>* `city`:(string, max chars=50) The city name for the address.<br>* `postal_code`:(string, max chars=20) The postal or ZIP code for the address.<br>* `phone`:(string, max chars=50) The contact phone number for the address.<br>* `email`:(string, max chars=70) The contact email address for the address.<br>|

## Update a bank account payment source

<a id="opIdupdate_a_bank_account_payment_source"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/payment_sources/string/update_bank_account' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /payment_sources/{cust-payment-source-id}/update_bank_account`

This API is used to update the payment source details of a customer. Information related to bank account payment source such as email, first name, and last name can be updated.

* For GoCardless, Chargebee supports (ACH,BACS,SEPA,AUTOGIRO,BECS,BECS_NZ,PAD).
* For Stripe, Chargebee only supports SEPA.

The API is only supported for the `payment_method` of type `direct_debit`.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|cust-payment-source-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» bank_account|body|object|false|Parameters for bank_account<br>|

|» » last_name|body|string|false|Account holder's last name as per bank account.<br>|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-personalizedoffers">personalized_offers</h1>

A Personalized Offer represents the best possible offer for a subscriber at a given moment in their lifecycle.

## List personalized offers

<a id="opIdlist_personalized_offers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/personalized_offers' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /personalized_offers`

This API is used to retrieve a list of personalized offer(s) for a customer based on the context (such as customer or subscription details and end-user attributes). This allows you to retrieve any active offers targeted to the user.
You can pre-call this API as soon as you have the user context at the point of login, or can call this API at any other point in the user journey when an offer is to be shown.

System evaluates eligibility and mapping to the right offer based on:

* Customer profile and subscription information.
* Device and browsing context.
* Custom fields.
* Play configurations.

**Note**

* Although the response is modeled as a list, the API currently returns at most one personalized offer (the best-matched offer for the user).
* If no offers are available, the list will be empty. No error is thrown in this case; an empty result is a valid response.

**Features of this API**

The List Personalized Offers endpoint allows you to:

* Retrieve context-aware offers targeted to customers or end users.
* Leverage multiple signals (profile, subscription, device/browser context, custom fields, and plays).
* Call flexibly at login, checkout, renewal, or any point in the user journey.Handle gracefully when no offers are available (returns an empty list, not an error).
* Support both B2C (single user per customer) and B2B (multiple end users per customer) scenarios.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="list-personalized-offers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» first_name|body|string|false|First name of the customer.  <br>**Note**<br><br>This parameter is ignored if it is not mapped to any field in the [settings](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/retention/chargebee-billing-integration.html#syncing-and-mapping-chargebee-fields-into-chargebee-retention).<br>|
|» last_name|body|string|false|Last name of the customer.  <br>**Note**<br><br>This parameter is ignored if it is not mapped to any field in the [settings](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/retention/chargebee-billing-integration.html#syncing-and-mapping-chargebee-fields-into-chargebee-retention).<br>|
|» email|body|string(email)|false|Customer's email address.  <br>**Note**<br><br>This parameter is ignored if it is not mapped to any field in the [settings](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/retention/chargebee-billing-integration.html#syncing-and-mapping-chargebee-fields-into-chargebee-retention).<br>|
|» roles|body|[string]|false|Roles or user types associated with the end user. (Useful in offer targeting for B2B scenarios with multiple user roles.).  <br>**Note**<br><br>This parameter is ignored if it is not mapped to any field in the [settings](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/retention/chargebee-billing-integration.html#syncing-and-mapping-chargebee-fields-into-chargebee-retention).<br>|
|» external_user_id|body|string|false|The unique identifier of the user in the your system. This is used to identify the user for whom the offer is being created.  <br>**Note**<br><br>This parameter is ignored if it is not mapped to any field in the [settings](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/retention/chargebee-billing-integration.html#syncing-and-mapping-chargebee-fields-into-chargebee-retention).<br>|
|» subscription_id|body|string|false|The unique identifier of the subscription for which the offer should be retrieved.<br>**Notes:**<br><br>* **Required** if multiple brands are configured in your Growth application.<br>* **Recommended** to always provide.<br>* If omitted and the customer has multiple subscriptions, the system attempts to retrieve the offer associated with one of their subscriptions.<br>|
|» customer_id|body|string|true|The ID of the customer in the billing system (Chargebee customer ID).<br>|
|» custom|body|object|false|JSON object of custom attributes (key-value pairs) used for offer targeting or content. [Configure](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/retention/settings-and-installation/chargebee-retention-field-mappings) custom attributes in the dashboard.  <br>**Note**<br><br>This parameter is ignored if it is not mapped to any field in the [settings](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/retention/chargebee-billing-integration.html#syncing-and-mapping-chargebee-fields-into-chargebee-retention).<br>|
|» request_context|body|object|false|A JSON object with standard context attributes (browser, device, locale, etc.) of the end user's session. This can help in offer targeting based on user environment.<br>|
|» » user_agent|body|string|false|The user's browser or device user agent string. Helps determine browser and platform details.<br>For example, chrome/7.10<br>|
|» » locale|body|string|false|The user's locale setting (e.g., en-US, fr-FR). Useful for regional offer targeting.<br>|
|» » timezone|body|string|false|The user's timezone identifier (e.g., America/New_York). Used for contextual targeting based on time.<br>|
|» » url|body|string|false|The current page URL where the offer is being displayed. Useful for context-sensitive offers.<br>|
|» » referrer_url|body|string|false|The referring page URL, i.e., the previous page that navigated the user to the current one. Can help with attribution analysis.<br>|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-portalsessions">portal_sessions</h1>

Customer Portal lets your customers to manage their account and billing themselves.

## Create a portal session

<a id="opIdcreate_a_portal_session"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/portal_sessions' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /portal_sessions`

Creates a portal session for a customer. The session resource in the response contains the access URL. Forward the customer to that access URL. If you would like to logout the customer later via API call, you need to store the id of the portal session resource returned by this API. While creating a session, you also need to pass the redirect URL to which your customers will be sent to upon logout from the portal UI.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» redirect_url|body|string|false|URL to redirect when the user logs out from the portal.<br>|
|» forward_url|body|string|false|By default access_url redirects the customer to the portal home page. If you would like to redirect the customer to a different URL, you can use this parameter to do so.<br><br>**Note:**<br>This parameter is not applicable for [in-app](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/v3-self-serve-portal.html)<br>portal.<br>|

## Activate a portal session

<a id="opIdactivate_a_portal_session"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/portal_sessions/string/activate' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /portal_sessions/{portal-session-id}/activate`

When an user is sent back to your return URL with session details, you should validate that information by calling this API. The details passed to the **return_url** should be sent as below:

* **auth_session_id** - this should be sent as part of the endpoint.
* **auth_session_token** - this should be sent as value for the input parameter **token**.

**Note:** This API is not applicable for [in-app](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/v3-self-serve-portal.html) portal.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

## Logout a portal session

<a id="opIdlogout_a_portal_session"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/portal_sessions/string/logout' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /portal_sessions/{portal-session-id}/logout`

Logs out the portal session. Typically this should be called when customers logout of your application.

If this API is called for a Portal Session that currently is in :

* "created" status, the session status will be marked as "logged_out" and the access URL will become invalid.
* "logged_in" status, the session status will be marked as "logged_out" and customer will not be able to use that session.
* "logged_out" status, this will return normally without changing any attribute of this resource.

<h1 id="chargebee-api-priceramps">price_ramps</h1>

Price ramp resource lets you define a stepped pricing schedule on an [item price](/docs/api/item_prices) in the Product Catalog.

## List price ramps

<a id="opIdlist_price_ramps"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/price_ramps' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /price_ramps`

Retrieves a list of price ramps for your site. You can filter the results by attributes such as `id`, `item_price_id`, `status`, and `updated_at`, and sort them using `sort_by`.  
Only `active` and `archived` price ramps are returned by this operation. `deleted` price ramps are not listed.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* [Price Ramps](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/product-catalog/price-ramps) must be enabled for the site. Contact [Chargebee Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support) to enable them. Until they are enabled, this operation returns `API_RESTRICTED`.


<h3 id="list-price-ramps-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of resources to be returned.<br>|
|offset|query|string|false|Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set `offset` to the value of `next_offset` obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.<br>|
|id|query|object|false|Filter price ramps based on their unique ID.<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is, is_not, starts_with, in, not_in<br>|

To exclude site-level resources in [specific cases](/docs/api/using_business_entity_filters_in_product_catalog_list_apis), set this parameter to `false`.<br>Possible values are : *true, false*<br><br>**Supported operators :**<br>is<br><br>**Example →**<br>*include_site_level_resources\[is\] = "false"*<br>|

## Create a price ramp

<a id="opIdcreate_a_price_ramp"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/price_ramps' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /price_ramps`

Creates a price ramp for an [item price](/docs/api/item_prices). Use this operation to schedule how the item price changes across a subscription's billing cycles by defining an ordered set of `ramp_intervals`.

Pass an overridden price for an interval using `price` (or `price_in_decimal` when [multi-decimal pricing](/docs/api/currencies) is enabled), or set `apply_catalog_price` to `true` to reuse the item price's catalog price for that interval.  
Chargebee merges adjacent `ramp_intervals` that have the same pricing before saving. Intervals are merged when they have the same `price`, or when consecutive intervals have `apply_catalog_price` set to `true`. Intervals with different prices, a mix of catalog and fixed pricing, or gaps in billing cycles aren't merged.

The ramp must contain at least two intervals after merging. If the submitted intervals merge into a single interval, the request is rejected.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* [Price Ramps](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/product-catalog/price-ramps) must be enabled for the site. Contact [Chargebee Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support) to enable them. Until they are enabled, this operation returns `API_RESTRICTED`.
* The `item_price_id` must not already be linked to a price ramp. An item price can have at most one price ramp.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-a-price-ramp-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» item_price_id|body|string|true|The ID of the [item price](/docs/api/item_prices) for which the price ramp is created. The price defined by the ramp intervals overrides the catalog price of this item price for the applicable billing cycles.<br>|
|» business_entity_id|body|string|false|The unique ID of the [business entity](/docs/api/business_entities) for this `price_ramp`. This is applicable only when multiple business entities have been created for the site. When provided, the operation will read or write data associated with the specified business entity. If not provided, the resource will be created at the site level, and the business_entity_id will not be included in the API response.<br><br>**Note** : An alternative way of passing this parameter is by using a [custom HTTP header](/docs/api/advanced-features) or [query string parameter](/docs/api/advanced-features#mbe-alternative).<br>|
|» ramp_intervals|body|object|false|The ordered list of intervals that make up the price ramp. Each interval defines the price that applies for a contiguous range of billing cycles. Intervals must be contiguous and ordered by `starting_billing_cycle`, with the first interval starting at billing cycle `1`. Adjacent intervals with the same pricing are merged before the ramp is saved. At least 2 intervals must remain after the merge. Up to 3 intervals.<br>|
|» » starting_billing_cycle|body|[integer(int32)]|true|The billing cycle at which this interval begins. The first interval must start at billing cycle `1`, and each subsequent interval must begin at the billing cycle immediately after the previous interval's `ending_billing_cycle`.<br>|
|» » ending_billing_cycle|body|[integer(int32)]|false|The billing cycle at which this interval ends. Omit this for the final interval so that its price applies to all remaining billing cycles.<br>|
|» » apply_catalog_price|body|[boolean]|false|Set to `true` to apply the item price's catalog price for this interval instead of an overridden ramp price. When `true`, do not pass `price` or `price_in_decimal` for the interval.<br>|
|» » price|body|[integer(int64)]|false|The price that applies for this interval, in the [minor unit of the currency](/docs/api/currencies). Do not pass this when `apply_catalog_price` is `true`.<br>|
|» » price_in_decimal|body|[string]|false|The price that applies for this interval, in the major (decimal) unit of the currency. Applicable only when [multi-decimal pricing](/docs/api/currencies) is enabled. Do not pass this when `apply_catalog_price` is `true`.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|chargebee-event-actions|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-webhook|all-disabled|

## Delete a price ramp

<a id="opIddelete_a_price_ramp"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/price_ramps/string/delete' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /price_ramps/{price-ramp-id}/delete`

Deletes a price ramp. Its `status` is set to `deleted` and the linked item price's `price_ramp_id` is cleared, so new subscriptions no longer inherit the ramp and a new ramp can be created for the item price. Subscriptions that already captured the ramp keep that schedule.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* [Price Ramps](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/product-catalog/price-ramps) must be enabled for the site. Contact [Chargebee Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support) to enable them. Until they are enabled, this operation returns `API_RESTRICTED`.

## Update a price ramp

<a id="opIdupdate_a_price_ramp"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/price_ramps/string' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /price_ramps/{price-ramp-id}`

Updates a price ramp. You can either change its `status` (to activate or archive it) or replace its `ramp_intervals`. These two changes are mutually exclusive within a single request.

When `ramp_intervals` is provided, the existing intervals are replaced in full with the new ordered set. Each interval in that set must include `starting_billing_cycle`.  
Chargebee merges adjacent `ramp_intervals` that have the same pricing before saving. Intervals are merged when they have the same `price`, or when consecutive intervals have `apply_catalog_price` set to `true`. Intervals with different prices, a mix of catalog and fixed pricing, or gaps in billing cycles aren't merged.

The ramp must contain at least two intervals after merging. If the submitted intervals merge into a single interval, the request is rejected.

Changes apply to **new subscriptions only**. Existing subscribers keep the ramp schedule captured when their subscription was created.  

### Prerequisites \& Constraints

* [Price Ramps](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/product-catalog/price-ramps) must be enabled for the site. Contact [Chargebee Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support) to enable them. Until they are enabled, this operation returns `API_RESTRICTED`.
* The price ramp's `status` must not be `archived` when replacing `ramp_intervals`.
* The linked item price must not be archived.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="update-a-price-ramp-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|price-ramp-id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» status|body|string|false|The status to set for the price ramp. Use this to activate a ramp or archive it so that it no longer applies to the linked item price. `status` and `ramp_intervals` are mutually exclusive in a single request.<br><br>* active - Activates the price ramp so that its ramp intervals apply to the linked item price.<br>* archived - Archives the price ramp so that it no longer applies to the linked item price.<br>|
|» ramp_intervals|body|object|false|The new ordered list of intervals for the price ramp. When provided, this **replaces** the existing set of ramp intervals in full. Each interval must include `starting_billing_cycle`. Intervals must be contiguous and ordered by `starting_billing_cycle`, with the first interval starting at billing cycle `1`. Adjacent intervals with the same pricing are merged before the ramp is saved. At least 2 intervals must remain after the merge. Up to 3 intervals. `ramp_intervals` and `status` are mutually exclusive in a single request.<br>|
|» » starting_billing_cycle|body|[integer(int32)]|true|The billing cycle at which this interval begins. The first interval must start at billing cycle `1`, and each subsequent interval must begin at the billing cycle immediately after the previous interval's `ending_billing_cycle`. Required for each interval when `ramp_intervals` is provided.<br>|
|» » ending_billing_cycle|body|[integer(int32)]|false|The billing cycle at which this interval ends. Omit this for the final interval so that its price applies to all remaining billing cycles.<br>|
|» » apply_catalog_price|body|[boolean]|false|Set to `true` to apply the item price's catalog price for this interval instead of an overridden ramp price. When `true`, do not pass `price` or `price_in_decimal` for the interval.<br>|
|» » price|body|[integer(int64)]|false|The price that applies for this interval, in the [minor unit of the currency](/docs/api/currencies). Do not pass this when `apply_catalog_price` is `true`.<br>|
|» » price_in_decimal|body|[string]|false|The price that applies for this interval, in the major (decimal) unit of the currency. Applicable only when [multi-decimal pricing](/docs/api/currencies) is enabled. Do not pass this when `apply_catalog_price` is `true`.<br>|

|chargebee-event-email|all-disabled|
|chargebee-event-webhook|all-disabled|
|» status|active|
|» status|archived|

<h1 id="chargebee-api-pricingpagesessions">pricing_page_sessions</h1>

The `pricing_page_session` resource allows you to create a pricing page that incorporates customer and subscription details.

## Create pricing page for existing subscription

<a id="opIdcreate_pricing_page_for_existing_subscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{site}.chargebee.com/api/v2/pricing_page_sessions/create_for_existing_subscription' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`POST /pricing_page_sessions/create_for_existing_subscription`

This endpoint streamlines the generation of a pricing page session to enable subscription [upgrade](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/proration.html#introduction_proration)
, and [downgrade](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/proration.html#introduction_proration)
workflows using Chargebee's hosted pricing pages ([Atomic Pricing](https://www.atomicpricing.com/)
). By providing a subscription ID as a parameter, you will obtain a hosted pricing page session URL.  
Note: [Full access key](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/api_keys.html#types-of-api-keys_full-access-key)
authentication is needed for this API request.


> Body parameter

```yaml
null
```

<h3 id="create-pricing-page-for-existing-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chargebee-request-origin-device|header|string|false|The device from which the customer has made the request|
|chargebee-request-origin-user|header|string(email)|false|The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.|
|chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded|header|string(email)|false|The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header chargebee-request-origin-user is ignored.|
|chargebee-request-origin-ip|header|string|false|The IP address of the customer where the request originated|
|chargebee-event-actions|header|string|false|skip all actions to be done on the events|
|chargebee-event-email|header|string|false|skip only emails|
|chargebee-event-webhook|header|string|false| skip only webhooks|
|chargebee-business-entity-id|header|string|false|If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» redirect_url|body|string|false|The customers will be redirected to this URL upon successful checkout.<br>|
|» custom|body|object|false|JSON object of custom attributes (key-value pairs) used for pricing page targeting or content. [Configure](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/retention/settings-and-installation/chargebee-retention-field-mappings) custom attributes in the dashboard.<br>|
|» pricing_page|body|object|false|Parameters for pricing page<br>|
|» » id|body|string|false|The unique identifier of the pricing table for which the hosted page is created. See [documentation](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/growth/offers/customize-pricing-table#obtain-the-pricing-table-id) to obtain the pricing table id from Chargebee Growth. If you want the pricing table to be auto-selected based on your [Play configuration](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/growth/plays/plays-overview) in Chargebee Growth, do not pass this parameter.  <br><br>**Required if**<br>You are on the legacy version of Pricing Tables (i.e. Atomic Pricing). See [documentation](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/hosted-capabilities/customize-pricing-table#obtain-the-site-id-and-pricing-table-id) to obtain the pricing table id.<br><br><br>|
|» subscription|body|object|false|Parameters for subscription<br>|
|» » id|body|string|true|The unique identifier of an existing subscription for which the hosted pricing page is created.<br>|
|» contract_term|body|object|false|Parameters for contract_term<br>|
|» » action_at_term_end|body|string|false|Action to be taken when the contract term completes.<br><br>* evergreen - Contract term completes and the subscription renews.<br>* cancel - Contract term completes and subscription is canceled.<br>* renew -<br>  * Contract term completes and a new contract term is started for the default number of billing cycles.<br>  * The `action_at_term_end` for the new contract term is set to `renew`.<br>* renew_once -<br>  Used when you want to renew the contract term just once. Does the following:<br><br>  * Contract term completes and a new contract term is started for the number of billing cycles specified in [`contract_term_billing_cycle_on_renewal`](/docs/api/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-items#contract_term_billing_cycle_on_renewal).<br>  * The `action_at_term_end` for the new contract term is set to `cancel`.<br>|
|» » cancellation_cutoff_period|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of days before [`contract_end`](/docs/api/contract_terms/contract_term-object#contract_end)<br>, during which the customer is barred from canceling the contract term. The customer is allowed to cancel the contract term via the Self-Serve Portal only before this period. This allows you to have sufficient time for processing the contract term closure.<br>|
|» discounts|body|object|false|Parameters for discounts<br>|
|» » apply_on|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » duration_type|body|[string]|true|none|
|» » percentage|body|[number(double)]|false|The percentage of the original amount that should be deducted from it.<br>|
|» » amount|body|[integer(int64)]|false|The value of the discount. The format of this value depends on the kind of [currency](/docs/api/currencies)<br>you want to use for a discount. This is only applicable when [`type`](/docs/api/discounts/discount-object#type)<br>is `fixed_amount`<br>.<br>|
|» » period|body|[integer(int32)]|false|The duration of time for which the discount is attached to the subscription, in `period_units`.<br>Applicable only when `duration_type`<br>is `limited_period`<br>.<br>|
|» » period_unit|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » included_in_mrr|body|[boolean]|false|The discount is included in MRR calculations for your site. This attribute is only applicable when `duration_type`<br>is `one_time`<br>and when the [feature is enabled](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/reporting.html#dashboards_flexible-mrr-calculation)<br>in Chargebee. Also, If the [site-level setting](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/reporting.html#chart_flexible-mrr-calculation)<br>is to exclude one-time discounts from MRR calculations, this value is always returned `false`<br>.<br>|
|» » item_price_id|body|[string]|false|The [id of the item price](/docs/api/subscriptions/subscription-object#subscription_items_item_price_id)<br>in the subscription to which the discount is to be applied. Relevant only when `apply_on`<br>= `specific_item_price`<br>.<br>|
|» » quantity|body|[integer(int32)]|false|Specifies the number of free units provided for the item, without affecting the total quantity sold<br>|
|» » label|body|[string]|false|Label for the discount<br>|

`POST /pricing_page_sessions/create_for_new_subscription`

). By providing a subscription ID and/or customer ID as a parameter, you'll obtain a pricing page session URL.  
Note: [Full access key](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/api_keys.html#types-of-api-keys_full-access-key)
authentication is needed for this API request.

null

For instance, for Arizona (USA), set `state_code`<br>as `AZ`<br>(not `US-AZ`<br>). For Tamil Nadu (India), set as `TN`<br>(not `IN-TN`<br>). For British Columbia (Canada), set as `BC`<br>(not `CA-BC`<br>).<br>|
|» » state|body|string|false|The state/province name. Is set by Chargebee automatically for US, Canada and India If `state_code`<br>is provided.<br>|
|» » zip|body|string|false|Zip or postal code. The number of characters is validated according to the rules [specified here](https://chromium-i18n.appspot.com/ssl-address)<br>.<br>|

Must be one of [ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html)<br>.<br><br>**Note**:<br>If you enter an invalid country code, the system will return an error.  <br>**Brexit**<br><br>If you have enabled [EU VAT](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/eu-vat.html) in 2021 or later, or have [manually enable](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/brexit.html#what-needs-to-be-done-in-chargebee) the Brexit configuration, then `XI` (the code for **United Kingdom - Northern Ireland**) is available as an option.<br>|
|» » validation_status|body|string|false|The address verification status.<br><br>* partially_valid - The address is valid for taxability but has not been validated for shipping.<br>* invalid - Address is invalid.<br>* not_validated - Address is not yet validated.<br>* valid - Address was validated successfully.<br>|
|» contract_term|body|object|false|Parameters for contract_term<br>|
|» » action_at_term_end|body|string|false|Action to be taken when the contract term completes.<br><br>* evergreen - Contract term completes and the subscription renews.<br>* renew -<br>  * Contract term completes and a new contract term is started for the default number of billing cycles.<br>  * The `action_at_term_end` for the new contract term is set to `renew`.<br>* renew_once -<br>  Used when you want to renew the contract term just once. Does the following:<br><br>  * Contract term completes and a new contract term is started for the number of billing cycles specified in [`contract_term_billing_cycle_on_renewal`](/docs/api/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-items#contract_term_billing_cycle_on_renewal).<br>  * The `action_at_term_end` for the new contract term is set to `cancel`.<br>* cancel - Contract term completes and subscription is canceled.<br>|
|» » cancellation_cutoff_period|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of days before [`contract_end`](/docs/api/contract_terms/contract_term-object#contract_end)<br>, during which the customer is barred from canceling the contract term. The customer is allowed to cancel the contract term via the Self-Serve Portal only before this period. This allows you to have sufficient time for processing the contract term closure.<br>|
|» discounts|body|object|false|Parameters for discounts<br>|
|» » apply_on|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » duration_type|body|[string]|true|none|
|» » percentage|body|[number(double)]|false|The percentage of the original amount that should be deducted from it.<br>|
|» » amount|body|[integer(int64)]|false|The value of the discount. The format of this value depends on the kind of [currency](/docs/api/currencies)<br>you want to use for a discount. This is only applicable when [`type`](/docs/api/discounts/discount-object#type)<br>is `fixed_amount`<br>.<br>|
|» » period|body|[integer(int32)]|false|The duration of time for which the discount is attached to the subscription, in `period_units`.<br>Applicable only when `duration_type`<br>is `limited_period`<br>.<br>|
|» » period_unit|body|[string]|false|none|
