<h2 id="tocS_ContractTerm">ContractTerm</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacontractterm"></a>
<a id="schema_ContractTerm"></a>
<a id="tocScontractterm"></a>
<a id="tocscontractterm"></a>

```json
null
```

Subscriptions can run indefinitely or they may run for a fixed number of billing cycles. Subscription can have "contract terms", which define a lock-in period on the subscription for a certain number of billing cycles. This prevents the subscription from being canceled by the customer when it is within the contract term.

The **contract term** resource described below defines the properties of this lock-in period. This includes the [number of billing cycles](/docs/api/contract_terms/contract_term-object#remaining_billing_cycles), the [total contract value](/docs/api/contract_terms/contract_term-object#total_contract_value), the [action to be taken](/docs/api/contract_terms/contract_term-object#action_at_term_end) at the end of the contract term, and so on. To allow for exceptions, you also have the option of terminating an [`active`](/docs/api/contract_terms/contract_term-object#status) contract term and charging a [termination fee](/docs/api/contract_terms).

A contract term starts in the `active` state and ends in the `completed` state. If the contract was canceled due to non-payment or other reasons, it can end in the `canceled` or `terminated` state. A given contract term is always associated with one, and only one subscription. A subscription, however, can be associated with only one `active` contract term. Over time, a subscription can be associated with several non-`active` contract terms. The `active` contract term for a subscription is available as an [object](/docs/api/subscriptions/subscription-object#contract_term) within the subscription.

To enable and configure contract terms, follow these steps in the Chargebee UI:

1. Click **Settings** on the left navigation.
2. Click **Configure Chargebee**.
3. Under **Billing** , click **Contract Terms**.
4. Enable and configure the feature as needed.

Once contract terms have been configured, the following actions can be performed using the API:

* **Define a contract term** for a subscription and **set renewal options** for the contract term. The following endpoints support this:

* [Create a subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-items)
* [Update a subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/update-subscription-for-items)
* [Reactivate a subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/reactivate-a-subscription)
* [Create a subscription ramp](/docs/api/ramps/create-a-ramp)
* [Update a subscription ramp](/docs/api/ramps/update-a-subscription-ramp)
* **Retrieving** a historical record of all contract terms for a subscription can be done via the following endpoint:

* [List contract terms for a subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/list-contract-terms-for-a-subscription)
* **Canceling a contract term** can be done via the following endpoints:

* [Update a subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/update-subscription-for-items)
* [Cancel a subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/cancel-subscription-for-items)
* [Update a subscription ramp](/docs/api/ramps/update-a-subscription-ramp)

#### Including a termination fee

When a contract is canceled mid-term, you can set a termination fee to be levied. Here's how:

1. [Create](/docs/api/item_prices/create-an-item-price) an item price for an item of [type](/docs/api/items/item-object#type) `charge` with [price](/docs/api/item_prices/create-an-item-price#price) set to the termination fee.
2. Do one of the following:

* [Attach the charge-item to a plan](/docs/api/attached_items/create-an-attached-item), setting the `charge_on_event` parameter to `contract_termination`. OR
* [Include the charge-item price on a subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-items), setting the `subscription_items[charge_on_event][i]` parameter to `contract_termination`.

Once the above steps are done, the termination fee will be charged automatically if you [terminate the contract in the middle of its term](/docs/api/subscriptions/cancel-subscription-for-items#contract_term_cancel_option).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|Id that uniquely identifies the contract term in the site.<br>|
|status|string|true|none|Current status of contract<br><br>* active - An actively running contract term.<br>* cancelled -<br>  The contract term was ended because: - a change in the subscription caused a [subscription term reset](/docs/api/v2/pcv-1/subscriptions/update-a-subscription#force_term_reset).<br><br>  * the subscription was cancelled due to non-payment.<br>* terminated - The contract term was terminated ahead of completion.<br>* completed - The contract term has run its full duration.<br>|
|contract_start|integer(unix-time)|true|none|The start date of the contract term<br>|
|contract_end|integer(unix-time)|true|none|The end date of the contract term<br>|
|billing_cycle|integer(int32)|true|none|The number of billing cycles of the subscription that the contract term is for.<br>|
|action_at_term_end|string|true|none|Action to be taken when the contract term completes.<br><br>* renew -<br>  * Contract term completes and a new contract term is started for the number of billing cycles specified in [`contract_billing_cycle_on_renewal`](/docs/api/v2/pcv-1/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-customer#contract_term_billing_cycle_on_renewal).<br>  * The `action_at_term_end` for the new contract term is set to `renew`.<br>* evergreen - Contract term completes and the subscription renews.<br>* renew_once -<br>  Used when you want to renew the contract term just once. Does the following: - Contract term completes and a new contract term is started for the number of billing cycles specified in [`contract_billing_cycle_on_renewal`](/docs/api/v2/pcv-1/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-customer#contract_term_billing_cycle_on_renewal).<br><br>  * The `action_at_term_end` for the new contract term is set to `cancel`.<br>* cancel - Contract term completes and subscription is canceled.<br>|
|total_contract_value|integer(int64)|true|none|The sum of the [totals](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#total)<br>of all the invoices raised as part of the contract term. For `active`<br>contract terms, this is a predicted value. The value depends on the [type of currency](/docs/api/contract_terms).<br>If the subscription was [imported](/docs/api/contract_terms)<br>with the contract term, then this value includes the value passed for `total_amount_raised`<br>.<br>|
|total_contract_value_before_tax|integer(int64)|true|none|It refers to the total amount of revenue that is expected to be generated from a specific contract term, calculated as the sum of all invoices raised during the term, regardless of payment status. It is based on past performance and the specified currency in the contract. If the subscription was imported, the value for `total_amount_raised_before_tax`<br>is included in the calculation of the total contract value before tax. It's important to note that this value excludes any applicable taxes.<br>|
|cancellation_cutoff_period|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of days before [`contract_end`](/docs/api/contract_terms/contract_term-object#contract_end)<br>, during which the customer is barred from canceling the contract term. The customer is allowed to cancel the contract term via the Self-Serve Portal only before this period. This allows you to have sufficient time for processing the contract term closure.<br>|
|created_at|integer(unix-time)|true|none|The date when the contract term was created.<br>|
|subscription_id|string|true|none|The [Id](/docs/api/subscriptions/subscription-object#id)<br>of the subscription that this contract term is for.<br>|
|remaining_billing_cycles|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of subscription billing cycles remaining after the current one for the contract term. This attribute is only returned for `active`<br>contract terms.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|status|completed|
|status|cancelled|
|status|terminated|
|action_at_term_end|renew|
|action_at_term_end|evergreen|
|action_at_term_end|cancel|
|action_at_term_end|renew_once|

<h2 id="tocS_Coupon">Coupon</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacoupon"></a>
<a id="schema_Coupon"></a>
<a id="tocScoupon"></a>
<a id="tocscoupon"></a>

```json
null
```

Overview
--------

Coupons are deductions applied to invoices or invoice line items. They're designed to be consumed by your customers directly. A coupon deduction can either be for a fixed amount or for a percentage of the amount of the invoice or line item.  
**Note:**

If you wish to provide discounts to your customers via API or the Chargebee app, see [Discounts API](/docs/api/discounts)

Order of application of coupons and discounts
---------------------------------------------

When both [coupons](/docs/api/coupons) and [discounts](/docs/api/discounts) are applied simultaneously to a [subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions) or [one-time invoice](/docs/api/invoices/create-invoice-for-items-and-one-time-charges), they're applied in the following order:  

|---|---------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|   | **Summary**                           | **Description**                                                                     |
| 1 | Line-level, fixed amount coupons      | `coupon` with `apply_on` = `each_specified_item` and `discount_type` = `flat`       |
| 2 | Line-level, fixed amount discounts    | `discount` with `apply_on` = `specific_item_price` and `type` = `fixed_amount`      |
| 3 | Line-level, percentage coupons        | `coupon` with `apply_on` = `each_specified_item` and `discount_type` = `percentage` |
| 4 | Line-level, percentage discounts      | `discount` with `apply_on` = `specific_item_price` and `type` = `percentage`        |
| 5 | Invoice-level, fixed amount coupons   | `coupon` with `apply_on` = `invoice_amount` and `discount_type` = `flat`            |
| 6 | Invoice-level, fixed amount discounts | `discount` with `apply_on` = `invoice_amount` and `type` = `fixed_amount`           |
| 7 | Invoice-level, percentage coupons     | `coupon` with `apply_on` = `invoice_amount` and `discount_type` = `percentage`      |
| 8 | Invoice-level, percentage discounts   | `discount` with `apply_on` = `invoice_amount` and `type` = `percentage`             |

For example, consider the following scenario:

A subscription is created with:

* a plan price of $200 per month
* an addon price of $20 per month
* a flat $5 invoice discount
* a 1% off coupon on the addon
* a flat $2 coupon on the invoice

The above coupons and discount are applied in the following order:  

|---|---------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|   | **Discount or coupon applied**              | **Subtotal at each step**                     |
| 1 | Initial subtotal (plan price + addon price) | $200 + $20 = $220                             |
| 2 | 1% off coupon on the addon                  | $200 + $(20 - 0.02) = $200 + $19.98 = $219.98 |
| 3 | Flat $2 coupon on the invoice               | $219.98 - $2 = $217.98                        |
| 4 | Flat $5 invoice discount                    | $217.98 - $5 = **$212.98**                    |

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|Used to uniquely identify the coupon in your website/application and to integrate with Chargebee.  <br>**Note:**<br><br>When the coupon ID contains a special character; for example: `#`, the API returns an error. Make sure that you [encode](https://www.urlencoder.org/) the coupon ID in the path parameter before making an API call.<br>|
|name|string|true|none|The display name used in web interface for identifying the coupon.  <br>**Note:**<br><br>When the name of the coupon set contains a special character; for example: `#`, the API returns an error. Make sure that you [encode](https://www.urlencoder.org/) the name of the coupon set in the path parameter before making an API call.<br>|
|invoice_name|string|false|none|Display name used in invoice. If it is not configured then name is used in invoice.<br>|
|discount_type|string|true|none|Specifies the type of discount to be applied.<br><br>* percentage -<br>  A percentage of the original price is deducted as a discount. The discount percentage is specified in [discount_percentage](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#discount_percentage).  <br>  [Learn more](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/coupons.html#percentage-coupons)<br>  about `percentage`<br>  coupons.<br>* fixed_amount -<br>  A fixed amount is deducted as a discount. The discount amount is specified in [discount_amount](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#discount_amount).  <br>  [Learn more](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/coupons.html#fixed-amount-coupons)<br>  about `fixed_amount`<br>  coupons.<br>* offer_quantity -<br>  A specified number of units of the item price are offered for free. The number of free units is specified in [discount_quantity](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#discount_quantity).<br>  The `offer_quantity`<br>  option is valid only when [apply_on](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#apply_on)<br>  is set to `each_specified_item`<br>  and the [pricing_model](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#pricing_model)<br>  of the item price is `per_unit`.  <br>  [Learn more](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/coupons.html#offer-quantity-coupons)<br>  about `offer_quantity`<br>  coupons.<br>|
|discount_percentage|number(double)|false|none|The percentage of the original amount that should be deducted from it.<br>|
|discount_amount|integer(int64)|false|none|The value of the deduction. The format of this value depends on the [kind of currency](/docs/api/currencies)<br>.<br>|
|discount_quantity|integer(int32)|false|none|Specifies the number of free units provided for the [item price](/docs/api/item_prices)<br>, without affecting the total quantity sold. This parameter is applicable only when the [discount_type](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#discount_type)<br>is set to `offer_quantity`<br>.<br>|
|currency_code|string|false|none|The currency code ([ISO 4217 format](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/supported-currencies.html)<br>) of the coupon. Applicable for *fixed_amount*<br>coupons alone.<br>|
|duration_type|string|true|none|Specifies the time duration for which this coupon is attached to the subscription.<br><br>* forever - The coupon is attached to the subscription and applied on the invoices until explicitly removed.<br>* one_time -<br>  The coupon stays attached to the subscription till it is applied on an invoice **once**.<br>  It is removed after that from the subscription.<br>* limited_period -<br>  The discount is attached to the subscription and applied on the invoices for a limited duration. This duration starts from the point it is applied to an invoice for the first time and expires after a period specified by `period`<br>  and `period_unit`<br>  .<br>|
|valid_from|integer(unix-time)|false|none|The date from which the coupon can be applied to subscriptions.<br>|
|valid_till|integer(unix-time)|false|none|Date upto which the coupon can be applied to new subscriptions.<br>|
|max_redemptions|integer(int32)|false|none|Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed.  <br>**Note:**<br><br>If not specified, the coupon can be redeemed an indefinite number of times.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|Status of the coupon.<br><br>* future - The coupon is scheduled to start at a future date and cannot be applied to a subscription. From the valid_from date, the status changes to active.<br>* expired -<br>  Cannot be applied to a subscription. A coupon may expire due to exceeding [max_redemptions](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#max_redemptions)<br>  or [valid_till](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#valid_till)<br>  date is past. Existing associations remain unaffected.<br>* archived - Cannot be applied to a subscription. Existing associations remain unaffected.<br>* active - Can be applied to a subscription.<br>* deleted - Indicates the coupon has been deleted.<br>|
|apply_on|string|true|none|The amount on the invoice to which the coupon is applied.<br><br>* invoice_amount -<br>  The coupon is applied to the invoice `sub_total`<br>  .<br>* each_specified_item -<br>  Applies the coupon to specified items (plans, addons, or charges), with the discount applied to each matching `invoice.line_item.amount`.<br><br>  Requires applicability to be configured using [`item_constraints`](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#item_constraints)---for example `all`, `criteria`, or `specific` with `item_price_ids`.<br><br>  When you attach this coupon to a subscription, at least one of that subscription's plans, addons, or charges must match those rules. If none do, the request fails.<br>|
|created_at|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Timestamp indicating when this coupon is created.<br>|
|archived_at|integer(unix-time)|false|none|Timestamp indicating when this coupon was archived.<br>|
|resource_version|integer(int64)|false|none|The version number of this resource. For every change made to the resource, `resource_version`<br>is updated with a new timestamp in milliseconds.<br>|
|updated_at|integer(unix-time)|false|none|Timestamp indicating when this coupon was last updated.<br>Note that this does not change when the [redemptions](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#redemptions)<br>attribute is changed. This attribute will be present only if the resource has been updated after 2016-11-09.<br>|
|period|integer(int32)|false|none|The duration of time for which the coupon is attached to the subscription, in `period_units`.<br>Applicable only when [duration_type](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#duration_type)<br>is [limited_period](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#duration_type)<br>.<br>|
|period_unit|string|false|none|The unit of time for period. Applicable only when [duration_type](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#duration_type)<br>is [limited_period](/docs/api/coupons/coupon-object#duration_type)<br>.<br><br>* month - A period of 1 calendar month.<br>* week - A period of 7 days.<br>* year - A period of 1 calendar year.<br>* day - A period of 24 hours.<br>|
|redemptions|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of times this coupon has been redeemed.<br>|
|invoice_notes|string|false|none|A customer-facing note added to all invoices associated with this API resource. This note becomes one among [all the notes](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#notes)<br>displayed on the invoice PDF.<br>|
|meta_data|object|false|none|A collection of key-value pairs that provides extra information about the coupon.  <br>**Note:**<br>There's a character limit of 65,535.<br><br>[Learn more](/docs/api/advanced-features)<br>.<br>|
|deleted|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether the coupon has been deleted or not.<br>|
|item_constraints|[object]|false|none|The list of item constraints.<br>|
|item_constraint_criteria|[object]|false|none|The list of item constraint criteria.<br>|
|coupon_constraints|[object]|false|none|List of constraints applicable on the redemption of this coupon.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_CouponCode">CouponCode</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacouponcode"></a>
<a id="schema_CouponCode"></a>
<a id="tocScouponcode"></a>
<a id="tocscouponcode"></a>

```json
null
```

Coupon codes are used along with existing coupons in Chargebee. You can create a coupon set using a bunch of coupon codes and this coupon set will be associated with an existing coupon. A coupon code can only be applied to a single subscription and cannot be re-used.

Using coupon codes you can distribute several unique codes for a single main coupon, when you are running promotions.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|string|true|none|Unique coupon code that can be redeemed only once.<br>|
|status|string|true|none|Status of the coupon code.<br><br>* not_redeemed - Can be applied to a subscription.<br>* redeemed - Cannot be applied to a subscription as the coupon code has been already used.<br>* archived - Cannot be applied to a subscription as it has been made inactive.<br>|
|coupon_id|string|true|none|Id of the main coupon resource.<br>|
|coupon_set_id|string|true|none|Uniquely identifies a coupon_set<br>|
|coupon_set_name|string|true|none|Coupon set name to which this coupon code would be grouped under. If the coupon set with the passed name is not present, a new coupon set will be created.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|not_redeemed|
|status|redeemed|
|status|archived|

<h2 id="tocS_CouponSet">CouponSet</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacouponset"></a>
<a id="schema_CouponSet"></a>
<a id="tocScouponset"></a>
<a id="tocscouponset"></a>

```json
null
```

A coupon set contains a bunch of coupon codes that can be redeemed by your customers when they are checking out. It belongs to an existing coupon and will usually be combined with other coupons that share similar promotion or discount offers. Using this resource, you can create, update, retrieve, delete coupon sets and add coupon codes to a coupon set.

### Properties

|id|string|true|none|Uniquely identifies a coupon_set<br>|
|coupon_id|string|true|none|Coupon id linked to coupon set<br>|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the coupon set<br>|
|total_count|integer(int32)|false|none|No of coupon codes present in coupon set<br>|
|redeemed_count|integer(int32)|false|none|No of redeemed codes<br>|
|archived_count|integer(int32)|false|none|No of archived codes<br>|
|meta_data|object|false|none|A collection of key-value pairs that provides extra information about the coupon set.  <br>**Note:**<br>There's a character limit of 65,535.<br><br>[Learn more](/docs/api/advanced-features)<br>.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_CreditNote">CreditNote</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacreditnote"></a>
<a id="schema_CreditNote"></a>
<a id="tocScreditnote"></a>
<a id="tocscreditnote"></a>

```json
null
```

A [Credit Note](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/credit-notes.html) is a document that specifies the money owed by a business to its customer. The seller usually issues a Credit Note for the same or lower amount than the invoice, and then repays the money to the customer or set it off against other 'due' invoices.

### Credit Note Types

Credit notes in Chargebee are categorized into three types:
1. `adjustment`: Adjustment credit notes are used to adjust the amount of an existing invoice in the `payment_due` or `not_paid` [status](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#status). Use this type of credit note to reduce the invoice amount, typically as a discount to the customer.

Adjustment credit notes are automatically created in the following cases:

* When an invoice is written off.
* When a subscription is modified with proration enabled, and the invoice for the current term is in the `payment_due` or `not_paid` [status](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#status). 2. `refundable`: Refundable credit notes allow you to return a certain amount to the customer. These credits can be:
* Retained for automatic application on future invoices.
* Applied to existing unpaid invoices.
* Refunded to the customer. Refundable credit notes are automatically created in the following cases:
* When an invoice is refunded.
* When a subscription is changed or canceled with proration enabled, the invoice for the current term is in the `paid` [status](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#status). Refundable credits are applied to future invoices or can be refunded to the original payment method. 3. `store`: Store credit notes are created for `paid` or `partially_paid` invoice [status](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#status) during subscription changes, such as upgrades, downgrades, or cancellations. Key characteristics of store credits:
* No tax component is included at the time of creation.
* A credit note document is generated, similar to refundable credits.
* Store credits are applied before tax calculations on future invoices.

**Note:**
If you have enabled *consolidated invoicing*
, to know the subscriptions attached with a credit note you have to refer [line_item's](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#line_items)
*subscription_id*
. The credit note's *subscription_id*
should **not**
be used (which will be *null*
if the credit note has lines from multiple subscriptions).  
Impact on reference invoice  
The following updates are made to the reference invoice when a credit note is created/imported:

* If the credit note `type` is `adjustment`:
  * The adjustment credit note details are added to the `adjustment_credit_notes[]` attribute of the invoice.
  * The invoice `amount_due` is reduced by the credit note `total`.
  * The invoice `status` is updated to `paid` if the invoice `amount_due` equals the credit note `total`.
  * The invoice `status` does not change if the invoice `amount_due` is greater than credit note `total`.
* If the credit note `type` is `refundable`:
  * The refundable credit note details are added to the `issued_credit_notes[]` attribute of the invoice.
  * The invoice `status` does not change.
* If the credit note `type` is `store`:
  * The store credit note details are added to the `issued_credit_notes[]` attribute of the invoice.
  * The invoice `status` does not change.

|customer_id|string|true|none|The identifier of the customer this credit note belongs to.<br>|
|subscription_id|string|false|none|The identifier of the subscription this Credit Note belongs to.<br>**Note:**<br>If *consolidated invoicing*<br>is enabled, to know the subscriptions attached with this Credit Note you have to refer [line_item's](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#line_items)<br>*subscription_id* .<br>This attribute should **not**<br>be used (which will be *null*<br>if this credit note has lines from multiple subscriptions).<br>|
|reference_invoice_id|string|false|none|The identifier of the invoice against which this Credit Note is issued<br>|
|type|string|true|none|The credit note type. [Learn more](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit-note-object)<br>about credit note types.<br><br>* store - Store Credit Note<br>* refundable - Refundable Credit Note<br>* adjustment - Adjustment Credit Note<br>|
|reason_code|string|false|none|The reason for issuing this credit note. |status|string|true|none|The credit note status.<br><br>* voided - When the Credit Note has been cancelled.<br>* refund_due - When the credits are yet to be used, or have been partially used.<br>* refunded - When the entire credits (Credit Note amount) have been used (i.e either allocated to invoices or refunded).<br>* adjusted - When the Credit Note has been adjusted against an invoice.<br>|
|vat_number|string|false|none|VAT number of the customer for whom this credit note is raised.<br>|

|amount_allocated|integer(int64)|false|none|The amount allocated to invoices from the credit note.<br>|
|amount_refunded|integer(int64)|false|none|The refunds issued from this credit note.<br>|
|amount_available|integer(int64)|false|none|The yet to be used credits of this credit note.<br>|
|refunded_at|integer(unix-time)|false|none|The time this credit note gets fully used. Please note that this field is not present when partial refunds are issued.<br>|
|voided_at|integer(unix-time)|false|none|Timestamp indicating the date and time this credit note gets voided.<br>|
|generated_at|integer(unix-time)|false|none|The date/time when the credit note was raised. This date/time can be backdated, which means that the date/time can be earlier than the date/time the credit note was created.<br>|

Contact [eap@chargebee.com](mailto:eap@chargebee.com)<br>  for more information.<br>* web - The object was created (and is maintained) for the web channel directly in Chargebee via API or UI.<br>* app_store -<br>  The object data is synchronized with data from [in-app subscription(s)](/docs/api/in_app_subscriptions)<br>  created in Apple App Store. Direct manipulation of this object via UI or API is disallowed.<br>|

Please reach out to [Chargebee Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support) to enable this feature.<br>|
|sub_total|integer(int64)|true|none|The Credit Note sub-total<br>|
|sub_total_in_local_currency|integer(int64)|false|none|Invoice subtotal in the currency of the place of supply.<br>|
|total_in_local_currency|integer(int64)|false|none|Total invoice amount in the currency of the place of supply.<br>|
|local_currency_code|string|false|none|The currency code (ISO 4217 format) of the place of supply in which VAT needs to be converted and displayed.<br>|
|round_off_amount|integer(int64)|false|none|Indicates the rounded-off amount. |fractional_correction|integer(int64)|false|none|Indicates the fractional correction amount.<br>|
|notes|[string]|false|none|The list of notes attached to this credit note. |deleted|boolean|true|none|Indicates that this resource has been deleted.<br>|
|tax_category|string|false|none|Specifies the customer's category for the Goods and Services Tax (GST). This field is returned only if you've configured GST for the India region.<br>|
|local_currency_exchange_rate|number(decimal)|false|none|This parameter represents the exchange rate as a relative price of the base currency that appears as local currency in invoices and credit notes. The local currency exchange rate specifically refers to the exchange rate of a country's currency when converting it to another currency.<br><br>For example, if you want to convert US dollars to euros, the local currency exchange rate would be the rate at which you can convert US dollars to euros.<br>|
|create_reason_code|string|false|none|Reason code for creating the credit note. Must be one from a list of reason codes set in the Chargebee app in **Settings \> Configure Chargebee \> Reason Codes \> Credit Notes \> Create Credit Note**.<br>Must be passed if set as mandatory in the app. The codes are case-sensitive<br>|
|vat_number_prefix|string|false|none|An overridden value for the first two characters of the [full VAT number](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/VAT_identification_number).<br>Only applicable specifically for customers with [billing_address](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#billing_address)<br><br>`country`<br>as `XI`<br>(which is **United Kingdom - Northern Ireland**<br>).<br><br>When you have enabled [EU VAT](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/eu-vat.html)<br>in 2021 or have [manually enabled](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/brexit.html#what-needs-to-be-done-in-chargebee)<br>the Brexit configuration, you have the option of setting [billing_address](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#billing_address)<br><br>`country`<br>as `XI`.<br>That's the code for **United Kingdom - Northern Ireland** .<br>The first two characters of the VAT number in such a case is<br>`XI`<br>by default. |brand_id|string|false|none|The unique ID of the [brand](/docs/api/brands) this credit note belongs to. This is always the same as the brand of the invoice referenced by `reference_invoice_id`. It cannot be set independently.<br>|

|line_item_taxes|[object]|false|none|The list of taxes applied on line items<br>|
|line_item_addresses|[object]|false|none|The list of addresses used for tax calculation on line items.<br>|
|discounts|[object]|false|none|The list of discounts applied to this credit note<br>|
|taxes|[object]|false|none|The tax-lines of this credit note<br>|
|tax_origin|object|false|none|contains information about the tax details which is applied on the invoice.<br>|
|linked_refunds|[object]|false|none|Payment Refunds issued from this credit note<br>|
|linked_tax_withheld_refunds|[object]|false|none|The details of refunds recorded against the [invoice.linked_taxes_withheld](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#linked_taxes_withheld)<br>component of the `invoice`<br>[associated](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#reference_invoice_id)<br>with this `credit_note`.<br>|
|allocations|[object]|false|none|Invoice allocations made from this credit note.<br>|
|exchange_rates|[object]|false|none|List of exchange rates applied when converting credit note amounts to other currencies (such as VAT local currency and organization local currency). Each entry contains [`currency_code`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#exchange_rates_currency_code) and [`rate`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#exchange_rates_rate).<br><br>The credit note currency is the base currency. When multiple rates target the same currency, only one entry is returned.<br><br>This array is different from `exchange_rate` in the response. An entry whose `currency_code` matches [`local_currency_code`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#local_currency_code) uses the same rate as [`local_currency_exchange_rate`](/docs/api/credit_notes/credit_note-object#local_currency_exchange_rate).<br><br>This array is returned in the response only when the corresponding features are enabled.<br>|
|shipping_address|object|false|none|Shipping address for the credit note.<br>|
|billing_address|object|false|none|Billing address for the credit note.<br>|
|einvoice|object|false|none|An e-invoice or electronic invoice is a structured representation of an invoice that is interoperable between computerized invoicing systems. Depending on the country, e-invoicing can be necessary to meet financial/taxation authority regulations.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_CreditUnit">CreditUnit</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacreditunit"></a>
<a id="schema_CreditUnit"></a>
<a id="tocScreditunit"></a>
<a id="tocscreditunit"></a>

```json
null
```

Credit units power credit-based billing for usage-based products, letting you get paid upfront while customers spend credits as they use your product's features. Each credit unit is a customizable consumption unit, such as AI credits or API calls, that you define beyond Chargebee's built-in pricing dimensions.

When should you use credit units?
---------------------------------

Credit units are a good fit when:

* Customers have widely varying usage patterns
* Business costs scale with consumption
* Upfront cash flow is preferred

How does it work?
-----------------

1. Create a credit unit (say, "AI Credits")
2. Configure credit grants on your plans (e.g., a Pro Plan priced at $20 USD includes 100 AI Credits)
3. Track customer usage in real time
4. Bill for actual consumption

**What happens when credits are exhausted?**

Once the provisioned credits are exhausted, further consumption draws from the overdraft balance up to its configured limit. Configure overdraft behavior for a credit unit using [**is_unlimited**](#is_unlimited) and [**overdraft_amount**](#overdraft_amount), so customers can continue consuming, purchase more, or pay for overage depending on your setup.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|A unique and immutable identifier for the credit unit.<br>|
|name|string|true|none|Internal display name for the credit unit. This must be unique across the site.<br>|
|external_name|string|true|none|Customer-facing display name for the credit unit. This must be unique across the site.<br>If not provided during creation, `name` is used as the default.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The current lifecycle status of the credit unit.<br><br>* active - Grant configuration for items and grant configuration overrides at subscription layer can be created for active credit units.<br>* archived - Grant configuration for items and grant configuration overrides at subscription layer cannot be created for archived credit units. Already configured grants for credit units continue to be effective.<br>|
|resource_version|integer(int64)|false|none|The version number of this resource. For every change made to the resource, `resource_version`<br>is updated with a new timestamp in milliseconds.<br>|
|updated_at|integer(unix-time)|false|none|The time at which the credit unit was last updated.<br>|
|created_at|integer(unix-time)|true|none|The time at which the credit unit was created.<br>|
|created_by|string|false|none|The source (or the user) from where the credit unit has been created.<br>|
|updated_by|string|false|none|The source (or the user) from where the credit unit has been last updated.<br>|
|is_unlimited|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether this credit unit allows unlimited overdraft consumption. When `true`, grace consumption continues without a cap after the allocated grants are exhausted. When `false`, grace consumption is capped by `overdraft_amount`.<br>|
|overdraft_amount|string|false|none|The amount up to which grace consumption is allowed after the allocated grants are exhausted. A non-negative decimal value that applies only when `is_unlimited` is `false`; zero is accepted.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|archived|

<h2 id="tocS_Currency">Currency</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacurrency"></a>
<a id="schema_Currency"></a>
<a id="tocScurrency"></a>
<a id="tocscurrency"></a>

```json
null
```

Chargebee's Multi-currency feature allows you to create Plans in multiple currencies, enabling your customers to conveniently pay in their preferred local currency. Please review this [documentation](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/multi-currency-pricing.html) to understand the multi-currency feature in Chargebee.

This currency resource contains exchange rate configurations associated with a specific currency. The multi-currency feature must be [enabled](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/multi-currency-pricing.html#1-adding-and-managing-currencies), and all prerequisites must be addressed to successfully add a new currency via the API.

To invoke a single currency-specific API like update, retrieve, and more, the currency ID has to be passed as a path parameter. You can use list API to fetch the IDs of each currency configured in your site to use with the currency-specific APIs below. Chargebee supports billing in over [100 currencies](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/supported-currencies.html).

On this page, you can find information about how currency units are expressed in the API, as well as some pointers to keep in mind when using multiple currencies.

Currency values
---------------

By default, the Chargebee API supports only whole numbers for currency values. To allow for fractional (decimal) values, you must enable the [multi-decimal pricing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/multi-decimal-support.html) feature. Additionally, the units in which currencies are expressed in the API depend on whether the currency is zero-decimal and whether multi-decimal pricing is enabled.

### Whole number currency values

By default, Chargebee supports currency values in whole numbers; fractions are not supported. In the API, currency values can be identified by checking their data types. For all whole number currency values in this API, the data type is indicated as "in cents" in this documentation.

The specific unit used for the currency in the API depends on whether it is a zero-decimal currency:

* **Zero-decimal currencies** : For currencies that do not have decimal subunits, such as the Japanese Yen (JPY), the amount must be provided in the major unit of the currency. The major unit of a currency is the unit represented by its [ISO 4217 code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html). For example, to specify an amount of JPY 15, set the amount as `15`.
* **Other currencies** : For currencies that are not zero-decimal, Chargebee supports values up to two decimal places in the major unit of the currency. This value with two decimal places must be converted to an integer by multiplying it by 100. For example, $1.53 should be provided as 1.53 x 100, which is `153`.

### Fractional currency values

When [multi-decimal pricing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/multi-decimal-support.html#configuring-multi-decimal-support) is enabled in Chargebee, you can work with fractional currency values using dedicated API parameters and attributes of the `String` type. Usually, these attributes and parameters have the suffix `_in_decimal` in their names. The value is expressed in the major unit of the currency, which is the unit represented by its [ISO 4217 code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html). For example, $1.6782 should be provided as `1.6782`. The maximum number of decimal places supported by the API can be [configured](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/multi-decimal-support.html#configuring-multi-decimal-support) in the admin console.

**Note:** For **zero-decimal currencies**, such as the Japanese Yen (JPY), decimal places are not allowed.

#### Rounding of invoice line item amounts

While Chargebee supports multiple decimal places for currency values, at the [invoice line item](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#line_items_amount)
-level, the `amount`
attribute is always rounded off to two decimal places in the major unit of the currency. The major unit of a currency is the unit represented by its
[ISO 4217 code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html)
.

The rounding logic used is [ROUND_HALF_EVEN](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/7/docs/api/java/math/BigDecimal.html#ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
. For example, if the [quantity](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#line_items_quantity)
is 0.0765 and [unit_amount](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#line_items_unit_amount)
is $10.674, the line item [amount](/docs/api/invoices/invoice-object#line_items_amount)
is (0.0765 x $10.674) = $0.816561 and is rounded off to $0.82.

Multi-currency support
----------------------

By default, Chargebee is able to process transactions in only one currency. However, you can enable the [multi-currency](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/multi-currency-pricing.html) feature to support more currencies. The first currency enabled in Chargebee also becomes the "base currency" by default. If you have multiple currencies enabled and want to change the base currency for your site, reach out to [Support](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/getting-started/how-to-contact-chargebees-support-team?utm_source=docs_api&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=support) for assistance.  
**Warning**

For some API endpoints, the `currency_code` parameter becomes *required* when the multi-currency feature is enabled. Before enabling the feature for your site, ensure that you update your code to provide the `currency_code` parameter when calling the endpoints listed in the next section.

### List of affected endpoints

The following endpoints require the `currency_code`
parameter to be passed when the multi-currency feature has been enabled.

* Customer-related endpoints

* [Add promotional credits for a customer](/docs/api/promotional_credits/add-promotional-credits)
* [Deduct promotional credits from a customer](/docs/api/promotional_credits/deduct-promotional-credits)
* [Set promotional credits for a customer](/docs/api/promotional_credits/set-promotional-credits)
* [Record an excess payment for a customer](/docs/api/customers/record-an-excess-payment-for-a-customer)
* Invoice-related endpoints

* [Create an invoice](/docs/api/invoices/create-invoice-for-items-and-one-time-charges)
* Product catalog-related endpoints

* [Create an item price](/docs/api/item_prices/create-an-item-price)
* [Create a coupon](/docs/api/coupons/create-a-coupon-for-items)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier of a currency.<br>|
|enabled|boolean|true|none|This field mentions whether the foreign currency is active or archived. If the value is `false`<br>the foreign currency is archived else it is active.<br>|
|forex_type|string|false|none|This represents the exchange rate type set for the currency.<br><br>* auto -<br>  If `forex_type`<br>  is `auto`<br>  , conversion rate will be auto updated by Chargebee every day with third party providers (using external currency conversion providers).<br>* manual -<br>  If `forex_type`<br>  is `manual`<br>  , you will be able to set the conversion rate for the currency. You need to update the exchange rate each time your exchange rate provider changes it.<br>|
|currency_code|string|true|none|A three letter currency code. For example, GBR, INR, and more.<br>|
|is_base_currency|boolean|true|none|Check whether this is a base currency or not. The value of the attribute is `true`<br>when the currency matches the site's base currency.<br>|
|manual_exchange_rate|string|false|none|This attribute shows the exchange rate in decimal. When `forex_type`<br>is `manual`<br>you have to set the exchange rate for additional currencies in `manual_exchange_rate`<br>field.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|forex_type|manual|
|forex_type|auto|

<h2 id="tocS_Customer">Customer</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacustomer"></a>
<a id="schema_Customer"></a>
<a id="tocScustomer"></a>
<a id="tocscustomer"></a>

```json
null
```

Represents a customer, which can be an individual or organization that subscribes to your products or services. The customer resource associates with [subscriptions](/docs/api/subscriptions/subscription-object), [card information](/docs/api/cards/card-object), and billing addresses. The customer details include their ID, name, contact information, and any [custom attributes](/docs/api/advanced-features) you'd like to associate with them.  
**Breaking Change**:

* [**Sites**](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/2.0/sites-intro.html) **created before March 1, 2014** : [updating the card](/docs/api/cards/update-card-for-a-customer) deletes the customer's `billing_address` and `vat_number` and replaces them with values from the request.
* **Sites created on or after March 1, 2014** : updating the card doesn't change the `billing_address` and `vat_number`.

|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier of the `customer` resource. You have the option to specify this value when creating a customer. The original identifier is preserved for the transferred copy of the `customer` resource. (See also: [Mechanics of business entity transfer](/docs/api/business_entities).)<br>|

|offline_payment_method|string|false|none|The preferred offline payment method for the customer.<br><br>* sepa_credit - SEPA Credit<br>* cash - Cash<br>* no_preference - No Preference<br>* bank_transfer - Bank Transfer<br>* check - Check<br>* eu_automated_bank_transfer - EU Automated Bank Transfer<br>* jp_automated_bank_transfer - JP Automated Bank Transfer<br>* uk_automated_bank_transfer - UK Automated Bank Transfer<br>* custom - Custom<br>* boleto - Boleto<br>* mx_automated_bank_transfer - MX Automated Bank Transfer<br>* us_automated_bank_transfer - US Automated Bank Transfer<br>* ach_credit - ACH Credit<br>|

|tax_providers_fields|[object]|false|none|This represents information related to custom [Tax Provider Fields](/docs/api/subscriptions).<br>It includes the provider name, field Id, and its corresponding field value. It is used to send custom Tax provider fields to any tax provider.<br>|
|relationship|object|false|none|The [account hierarchy](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/account-hierarchy.html)<br>relationship that the customer is part of.<br>|
|parent_account_access|object|false|none|When the customer is part of an [account hierarchy](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/account-hierarchy.html), this attribute defines the level of access that the parent account has to the customer's information.<br>**Note:**<br>the 'parent' is the customer whose id is [payment_owner_id](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#relationship_payment_owner_id).<br>However, if the `payment_owner_id`<br>is the customer itself, then the parent is [parent_id](/docs/api/customers/customer-object#relationship_parent_id)<br>.<br>|
|child_account_access|object|false|none|When the customer is part of an [account hierarchy](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/account-hierarchy.html)<br>, this attribute defines the level of access that the customer has to its own information.<br>|

The `customer_entitlement` resource can be viewed as a subset of the [subscription_entitlement](/docs/api/subscription_entitlements) resource enhanced with the customer's ID. It is introduced to help [retrieve](/docs/api/customer_entitlements/list-customer-entitlements) all subscription entitlements for a specific customer.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer_id|string|true|none|The unique identifier of the [customer](/docs/api/customers)<br>to which this entitlement belongs.<br>|
|subscription_id|string|false|none|The unique identifier of the [subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions)<br>to which this entitlement belongs.<br>|
|feature_id|string|false|none|The unique identifier of the [feature](/docs/api/features)<br>towards which this subscription entitlement has been granted.<br>|
|value|string|false|none|The value denoting the effective entitlement level that the subscription has towards the feature.<br>|
|name|string|false|none|The display name for the entitlement level. The value is automatically generated based on `feature.type`:<br><br>* When `feature.type` is `range` or `quantity`: the `name` is the space-separated concatenation of `value` and the pluralized form of `feature.unit`. For example, if `value` is `20` and `feature.unit` is `user`, then `name` becomes `20 users`.<br>* When `feature.type` is `custom`, the `name` is the same as `value`.<br>* When `feature.type` is `switch`: `name` is set to `Available` when `value` is `true`; it's set to `Not Available` when `value` is `false`.<br>|
|is_enabled|boolean|true|none|When `true`<br>, indicates that the [subscription_entitlement](/docs/api/subscription_entitlements)<br>is enabled.  <br>**See also** :<br>[Enable or disable subscription entitlement](/docs/api/subscription_entitlements/enable-or-disable-subscription-entitlements).<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_DifferentialPrice">DifferentialPrice</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadifferentialprice"></a>
<a id="schema_DifferentialPrice"></a>
<a id="tocSdifferentialprice"></a>
<a id="tocsdifferentialprice"></a>

```json
null
```

Differential pricing helps implement a pricing strategy for addons and charges based on the plans they're purchased with. A differential price a specific price for an addon- or charge-[item price](/docs/api/item_prices) when purchased along with a particular plan.

Differential pricing for addons
-------------------------------

Consider an addon called 24x7 Customer Support provided with a cloud storage service. You can configure differential prices for each of the addon-item prices based on the plan they are purchased with, as follows:  

|---|-----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|   | **Addon item price**                                | **Price when applied to *Standard*** **Plan** | **Price when applied to** ***Enterprise*** **Plan** |
| 1 | 24x7 Customer Support, USD, Monthly, Flat fee, $100 | $90                                           | $150                                                |
| 2 | 24x7 Customer Support, USD, Yearly, Flat fee, $1000 | $900                                          | $1500                                               |

Differential pricing for charges
--------------------------------

Consider a charge, called Setup fee, for installing and configuring a cloud-based project management platform. There are two modes in which you can set up differential pricing for a charge:

#### Mode A: One charge differential price per plan-item

This mode is used to specify one differential price for the charge-item price per [plan-item](/docs/api/items) it is applied to.  

|-------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Charge-item price**         | **Price when applied to** ***Standard*** **plan** | **Price when applied to** ***Enterprise*** **plan** |
| Setup fee, USD, Flat fee $500 | $400                                              | $700                                                |

#### Mode B: Multiple charge differential prices per plan item

This mode is used to specify multiple differential prices for the charge per plan-item, based on the plan period.  

|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| **Charge-item price**         | **Price when applied to** ***Standard*** **plan, 6 months** | **Price when applied to** ***Standard*** **plan, yearly** |
| Setup fee, USD, Flat fee $500 | $400                                                        | $300                                                      |

In the above example, even if the "6 month" or "yearly" plan-item prices do not exist, the differential prices for the charge can still be created. They take effect whenever the plan-item prices are eventually created and used in subscriptions.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|A unique and immutable ID for the differential price. It is auto-generated when the differential price is created.<br>|
|item_price_id|string|true|none|The ID of the item price (`addon`<br>or `charge`<br>) whose price should change according to the plan-item it is applied to.<br>|
|parent_item_id|string|true|none|The ID of the plan-item, in relation to which, the differential pricing for the addon or charge is defined. For example, this would be the id of the *Standard*<br>or *Enterprise*<br>plans-items mentioned in the [examples above](/docs/api/differential_prices)<br>.<br>|
|price|integer(int64)|false|none|The differential price. If the pricing model of the `item_price_id`<br>is `tiered`<br>, `volume`<br>, or `stairstep`<br>, pass `tiers`<br>instead of this.<br>|
|price_in_decimal|string|false|none|The price of the item when the pricing_model is `flat_fee`.<br>When the pricing model is `per_unit`<br>, it is the price per unit quantity of the item. Not applicable for the other pricing models. The value is in decimal and in major units of the currency. Also, this is only applicable when [multi-decimal pricing](/docs/api/currencies)<br>is enabled.<br>|
|status|string|false|none|The item family state.<br><br>* active - New items can be created with the item family.<br>* deleted - No items allowed for the item family.<br>|
|resource_version|integer(int64)|false|none|Version number of this resource. The `resource_version`<br>is updated with a new timestamp in milliseconds for every change made to the resource. This attribute will be present only if the resource has been updated after 2016-09-28.<br>|
|updated_at|integer(unix-time)|false|none|Timestamp when this differential price was last updated.<br>|
|created_at|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Timestamp at which this differential price was created.<br>|
|modified_at|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Timestamp at which this differential price was last modified.<br>|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The currency code (ISO 4217 format) of the plan<br>|
|business_entity_id|string|false|none|The unique ID of the<br>[business entity](/docs/api/getting-started)<br>of this subscription. This is applicable only when multiple business entities have been created for the site. The value of this attribute indicates that the resource is specific to the given business entity.<br>|
|deleted|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether the differential price has been deleted or not.<br>|
|tiers|[object]|false|none|List of quantity-based pricing tiers for the differential price. Applicable only for `tiered`<br>, `volume`<br>, and `stairstep`<br>`pricing_model`<br>s. The tiers are exactly the same as those set for the item price. Only the `price`<br>attribute for the various tiers can be overridden for the differential price.<br>|
|parent_periods|[object]|false|none|When `item_price_id`<br>is a charge-item, you can specify the plan period for which the price applies. Although an array, currently you can specify only one period. In other words, only index `0`<br>is allowed. Create another differential price to specify another period. Is permitted only when `item_price_id`<br>is a charge-item.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|deleted|

<h2 id="tocS_Discount">Discount</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadiscount"></a>
<a id="schema_Discount"></a>
<a id="tocSdiscount"></a>
<a id="tocsdiscount"></a>

```json
null
```

A `discount`, just like [coupons](/docs/api/coupons), represents a deduction from the amounts in an `invoice`. While coupons are typically used by your customers, `discount`s can be directly applied to subscriptions by your sales team while negotiating new deals or upgrades. If the negotiations are on the price itself, the [price override](
https://www.chargebee.com/docs/price-override.html#api) feature helps adjust the price further.

Although a `discount` appears as a deduction on an invoice, it is applied to a `subscription` while creating or updating the `subscription`. Every `discount` in Chargebee is attached to only one `subscription`.  
**Note:**

* The sum of the line-item-level and invoice-level coupons together for a subscription, cannot exceed 10.
* When discounts are enabled in Chargebee, the [multi-coupons feature](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/coupons.html#applying-multiple-coupons-to-a-subscription) is automatically activated.

Adding a discount
-----------------

### Subscriptions

A `discount` can be added to a `subscription` by calling either [Create subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/create-subscription-for-items) or [Update subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/update-subscription-for-items). Once added, the `discount` is applied to all subsequent invoices if `apply_on` is set to `invoice_amount`. When `apply_on` = `specific_item_price`, the discount is applied (as a `discount.line_item_discount`) in each invoice of the subscription that contains the specified item.

### Invoices

A `discount` can be added to an `invoice` using [Create invoice for items and one-time charges](/docs/api/invoices/create-invoice-for-items-and-one-time-charges) using the `discounts` parameter.

### Quotes

A `discount` can be added to a `quote` using the following operations:

* [Create a quote for new subscription](/docs/api/quotes/create-a-quote-for-a-new-subscription-items)
* [Create a quote for updating a subscription](/docs/api/quotes/create-a-quote-for-update-subscription-items)
* [Create a quote for charge and charge item](/docs/api/quotes/create-a-quote-for-charge-and-charge-items)
* [Edit a quote for a new subscription](/docs/api/quotes/edit-create-subscription-quote-for-items)
* [Edit a quote for updating a subscription](/docs/api/quotes/edit-update-subscription-quote-for-items)
* [Edit a quote for charge items and charges](/docs/api/quotes/edit-quote-for-charge-items-and-charges)

### Estimates

A discount can be added to an estimate using the following endpoints:

* [Estimate for creating a subscription.](/docs/api/estimates/estimate-for-creating-a-subscription)
* [Estimate for creating a customer and subscription](/docs/api/estimates/estimate-for-creating-a-customer-and-subscription)
* [Estimate for updating a subscription](/docs/api/estimates/estimate-for-updating-a-subscription)

Removing a discount
-------------------

### Subscriptions

A `discount` can be removed by calling [Update subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions/update-subscription-for-items) with the relevant `discounts[operation_type][]` set to `remove`. Also, discounts that have `duration_type` as `one_time` or `limited_period` are removed automatically upon expiry.

### Quotes

A discount can be removed from a quote using the following operations:

* [Edit a quote for a new subscription](/docs/api/quotes/edit-create-subscription-quote-for-items)
* [Edit a quote for updating a subscription](/docs/api/quotes/edit-update-subscription-quote-for-items)

### Estimates

A discount can be removed from an estimate using the following operation:

* [Estimate for updating a subscription](/docs/api/estimates/estimate-for-updating-a-subscription)

Listing discounts
-----------------

A discount is associated with exactly one subscription. You can fetch all the discounts currently attached to a subscription by calling the [List discounts for a subscription API](/docs/api/subscriptions/list-discounts-for-a-subscription) or by passing `include_discounts` as `true` while creating, importing, updating or retrieving a subscription.

Order of application of coupons and discounts
---------------------------------------------

When both [coupons](/docs/api/coupons) and [discounts](/docs/api/discounts) are applied simultaneously to a [subscription](/docs/api/subscriptions) or [one-time invoice](/docs/api/invoices/create-invoice-for-items-and-one-time-charges), they're applied in the following order:  

|----|---------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|    | **Summary**                           | **Description**                                                                           |
| 1  | Line-level, fixed amount coupons      | `coupon` with `apply_on` = `each_specified_item` and `discount_type` = `flat`             |
| 2  | Line-level, fixed amount discounts    | `discount` with `apply_on` = `specific_item_price` and `type` = `fixed_amount`            |
| 3  | Line-level, percentage coupons        | `coupon` with `apply_on` = `each_specified_item` and `discount_type` = `percentage`       |
| 4  | Line-level, percentage discounts      | `discount` with `apply_on` = `specific_item_price` and `type` = `percentage`              |
| 5  | Line-level, offer quantity coupons    | `coupon` with `apply_on` = `each_specified_item` and `discount_type` = `offer_quantity`   |
| 6  | Line-level, offer quantity discounts  | `discount` with `apply_on` = `specific_item_price` and `discount_type` = `offer_quantity` |
| 7  | Invoice-level, fixed amount coupons   | `coupon` with `apply_on` = `invoice_amount` and `discount_type` = `flat`                  |
| 8  | Invoice-level, fixed amount discounts | `discount` with `apply_on` = `invoice_amount` and `type` = `fixed_amount`                 |
| 9  | Invoice-level, percentage coupons     | `coupon` with `apply_on` = `invoice_amount` and `discount_type` = `percentage`            |
| 10 | Invoice-level, percentage discounts   | `discount` with `apply_on` = `invoice_amount` and `type` = `percentage`                   |

For example, consider the following scenario:

A subscription is created with:

* a plan price of $200 per month
* an addon price of $20 per month
* a flat $5 invoice discount
* a 1% off coupon on the addon
* a flat $2 coupon on the invoice

The above coupons and discount are applied in the following order:  

|---|---------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|   | **Discount or coupon applied**              | **Subtotal at each step**                     |
| 1 | Initial subtotal (plan price + addon price) | $200 + $20 = $220                             |
| 2 | 1% off coupon on the addon                  | $200 + $(20 - 0.02) = $200 + $19.98 = $219.98 |
| 3 | Flat $2 coupon on the invoice               | $219.98 - $2 = $217.98                        |
| 4 | Flat $5 invoice discount                    | $217.98 - $5 = **$212.98**                    |

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|An immutable unique id for the discount. It is always auto-generated.<br>|
|invoice_name|string|false|none|The name of the discount as it should appear on customer-facing pages and documents such as [invoices](/docs/api/invoices)<br>and [hosted pages](/docs/api/hosted_pages).<br>This is auto-generated based on the `type`<br>, `amount`<br>, and `currency_code`<br>of the discount. For example, it can be `10% off`<br>or `10$ off`<br>.<br>|
|type|string|true|none|The type of discount.<br>Possible value are:<br><br>* percentage - The specified percentage will be given as discount.<br>* fixed_amount - The specified amount will be given as discount.<br>* offer_quantity -<br>  A specified number of units of the item price are offered for free. The number of free units is specified in [quantity](/docs/api/discounts).<br>  The `offer_quantity`<br>  option is valid only when [apply_on](/docs/api/discounts/discount-object#apply_on)<br>  is set to `each_specified_item`<br>  and the [pricing_model](/docs/api/item_prices/item_price-object#pricing_model)<br>  of the item price is `per_unit`<br>  .<br>|
|percentage|number(double)|false|none|The percentage of the original amount that should be deducted from it. Only applicable when `discount.type`<br>is `percentage`.<br>|
|amount|integer(int64)|false|none|The value of the discount. [The format of this value](/docs/api/currencies)<br>depends on the kind of currency. This is only applicable when `discount.type`<br>is `fixed_amount`.<br>|
|quantity|integer(int32)|false|none|Specifies the number of free units provided for the item, without affecting the total quantity sold. This parameter is applicable only when `discount.type`<br>is `offer_quantity`.<br>|
|currency_code|string|false|none|The currency code ([ISO 4217 format](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/supported-currencies.html)<br>) of the discount. This is only applicable when `discount.type`<br>is `fixed_amount`<br>.<br>|
|duration_type|string|true|none|Specifies the time duration for which this discount is attached to the subscription.<br><br>* forever -<br>  The discount is attached to the subscription and applied on the invoices till it is [explicitly removed](/docs/api/subscriptions/update-subscription-for-items#discounts_operation_type)<br>  .<br>* limited_period -<br>  The discount is attached to the subscription and applied on the invoices for a limited duration. This duration starts from the point it is applied to an invoice for the first time and expires after a period specified by `period`<br>  and `period_unit`<br>  .<br>* one_time -<br>  The discount stays attached to the subscription till it is applied on an invoice **once**.<br>  It is removed after that from the subscription.<br>|
|period|integer(int32)|false|none|The duration of time for which the discount is attached to the subscription, in `period_units`.<br>Applicable only when `duration_type`<br>is `limited_period`.<br>|
|period_unit|string|false|none|The unit of time for `period`.<br>Applicable only when `duration_type`<br>is `limited_period`.<br><br>* year - A period of 1 calendar year.<br>* month - A period of 1 calendar month.<br>* week - A period of 7 days.<br>* day - A period of 24 hours.<br>|
|included_in_mrr|boolean|true|none|The discount is included in MRR calculations for your site. This attribute is only applicable when `duration_type`<br>is `one_time`<br>and when the [feature is enabled](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/reporting.html#dashboards_flexible-mrr-calculation)<br>in Chargebee. Also, If the [site-level setting](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/reporting.html#chart_flexible-mrr-calculation)<br>is to exclude one-time discounts from MRR calculations, this value is always returned `false`.<br>|
|apply_on|string|true|none|The amount on the invoice to which the discount is applied.<br><br>* invoice_amount -<br>  The discount is applied to the invoice `sub_total`<br>  .<br>* specific_item_price -<br>  The discount is applied to the `invoice.line_item.amount`<br>  that corresponds to the item price specified by `item_price_id`<br>  .<br>|
|item_price_id|string|false|none|The [id of the item price](/docs/api/subscriptions/subscription-object#subscription_items_item_price_id)<br>in the subscription to which the discount is to be applied. Relevant only when `apply_on`<br>= `specific_item_price`.<br>|
|created_at|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Timestamp indicating when this discount is created.<br>|
|apply_till|integer(unix-time)|false|none|Specifies till when the limited period discount is applicable. This attribute will be sent in the response only for `limited_period`<br>duration type discount.<br>|
|applied_count|integer(int32)|false|none|Specifies the number of times the discount has been applied.<br>|
|coupon_id|string|true|none|Used to uniquely identify the coupon in your website/application and to integrate with Chargebee.  <br>**Note:**<br><br>When the coupon ID contains a special character; for example: `#`, the API returns an error. Make sure that you [encode](https://www.urlencoder.org/) the coupon ID in the path parameter before making an API call.<br>|
|index|integer(int32)|true|none|The index number of the subscription to which the item price is added. Provide a unique number between `0`<br>and `4`<br>(inclusive) for each subscription that is to be created.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|type|percentage|
|type|offer_quantity|
|duration_type|one_time|
|duration_type|forever|
|duration_type|limited_period|
|period_unit|day|
|period_unit|week|
|period_unit|month|
|period_unit|year|
|apply_on|invoice_amount|
|apply_on|specific_item_price|

<h2 id="tocS_Dispute">Dispute</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadispute"></a>
<a id="schema_Dispute"></a>
<a id="tocSdispute"></a>
<a id="tocsdispute"></a>

```json
null
```

This resource represents a [dispute](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/payments/2.0/others/chargeback) raised against a payment collected on your site. A dispute is created when a cardholder questions a payment with their card issuer, either as a formal `chargeback` or as a pre-chargeback `inquiry`.

Chargebee records each dispute against the [transaction](/docs/api/transactions/transaction-object) that was disputed, the [customer](/docs/api/customers/customer-object) who made the payment, and the gateway account that processed it. As the payment gateway moves the dispute toward a resolution, Chargebee updates the dispute [`status`](/docs/api/disputes/dispute-object#status).

Disputes are read-only through the API. Chargebee creates and updates them from the notifications it receives from the payment gateway, so there are no operations to create, update, or delete a dispute.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|Uniquely identifies the dispute.<br>|
|customer_id|string|true|none|Identifier of the [customer](/docs/api/customers/customer-object)<br>whose payment was disputed.<br>|
|transaction_id|string|true|none|Identifier of the [transaction](/docs/api/transactions/transaction-object)<br>that was disputed.<br>|
|gateway_account_id|string|true|none|Identifier of the gateway account that processed the disputed payment.<br>|
|id_at_gateway|string|false|none|The id with which this dispute is referred in the gateway. Use this value to reconcile the dispute with the corresponding record in the gateway.<br>|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The currency code ([ISO 4217 format](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/supported-currencies.html)) of the disputed amount.<br>|
|amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The amount under dispute. The unit depends on the [type of currency](/docs/api/getting-started)<br>.<br>When `is_partial_dispute`<br>is `true`, this is only the disputed part of the transaction amount.<br>|
|reason|string|false|none|The reason for which the payment was disputed, as reported by the gateway. The set of values depends on the gateway and the card network.<br>|
|status|string|true|none|The current state of the dispute.<br><br>* won - The dispute was resolved in the merchant's favor.<br>* cancelled - The dispute was withdrawn before it was resolved.<br>* funds_withdrawn - The gateway has withdrawn the disputed amount pending resolution.<br>* in_review - Evidence has been submitted and the dispute is being reviewed.<br>* lost - The dispute was resolved in the cardholder's favor.<br>* initiated - The dispute has been raised by the cardholder and the funds are yet to be withdrawn.<br>|
|type|string|true|none|The nature of the dispute raised against the payment.<br><br>* inquiry - A pre-dispute inquiry raised by the issuer before a chargeback.<br>* chargeback - A formal reversal of the payment raised through the card network.<br>|
|is_partial_dispute|boolean|true|none|Indicates that only a part of the transaction amount is under dispute.<br>|
|created_at|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Timestamp indicating when the dispute was created.<br>|
|resource_version|integer(int64)|false|none|Version number of this resource. The `resource_version`<br>is updated with a new timestamp in milliseconds for every change made to the resource.<br>|
|updated_at|integer(unix-time)|false|none|Timestamp indicating when this dispute was last updated.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|initiated|
|status|funds_withdrawn|
|status|in_review|
|status|cancelled|
|status|lost|
|status|won|
|type|chargeback|
|type|inquiry|

<h2 id="tocS_Einvoice">Einvoice</h2>

```json
null
```

An e-invoice record associated with an invoice or credit note. It includes processing status, provider references, nested artifacts (for example application responses), and related status messages.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The unique `id` for the e-invoice. This is auto-generated by Chargebee.<br>|
|entity_type|string|true|none|The type of the parent document this e-invoice belongs to.<br><br>* invoice - Invoice<br>* credit_note - Credit note<br>|
|entity_id|string|true|none|The unique id of the parent document this e-invoice belongs to. When `entity_type` is `invoice`, this is the invoice id; when `entity_type` is `credit_note`, this is the credit note id.<br>|
|reference_id|string|false|none|Identifier returned by the connected e-invoicing provider for this submission (for example, a document submission id). Chargebee uses this value when communicating with the provider to retrieve submission status and related artifacts.<br>|
|reference_number|string|false|none|This attribute is used to populate the unique reference number assigned to an invoice on the Invoice Registration Portal (IRP) network. It is essential for identifying and tracking invoices that are processed through the IRP network.<br><br>In the future, this field may be used to store similar reference numbers for other networks.<br>|
|status|string|true|none|The status of processing the e-invoice. To obtain detailed information about the current `status`, see `message`.<br><br>* message_acknowledgement - An acknowledgment confirming that the application response was successfully received by the receiving entity.<br>* in_progress - The e-invoice has been sent and Chargebee is waiting for confirmation from the receiving entity.<br>* under_query - The receiving entity has raised a query regarding the e-invoice. Additional information or clarification is required before proceeding.<br>* registered - The e-invoice was sent and there was an error due to which it was not delivered but got cleared in the IRP.<br>* accepted - The e-invoice was sent and it was accepted by the receiving entity. The sending entity shall also accept the e-invoice.<br>* success - The e-invoice has been successfully delivered to the customer.<br>* rejected - The e-invoice was sent and it was rejected by the receiving entity due to some reason. The sending entity shall also reject the e-invoice.<br>* in_process - The e-invoice is currently being processed by the receiving entity.<br>* paid - The receiving entity has confirmed that the e-invoice has been paid.<br>* skipped - The e-invoice was not sent. This could be due to missing information or because the `entity_identifier` is not registered on the e-invoicing network.<br>* failed - The e-invoice was sent and there was an error due to which it was not delivered.<br>* scheduled - Sending the e-invoice to the customer has been scheduled.<br>* conditionally_accepted - The e-invoice has been accepted with conditions.<br>|
|message|string|false|none|Detailed information about the status of the e-invoice. When `status` is `skipped` or `failed`, this contains the reason or error details. The following are some valid examples:<br><br>* Invoice successfully sent to customer via the e-invoicing network 9090:123456<br>* Invoice successfully sent to customer via email id abc@acme.com<br>|
|created_at|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Timestamp indicating when this e-invoice resource was created.<br>|
|resource_version|integer(int64)|false|none|Version number of this resource. The `resource_version` is updated with a new timestamp in milliseconds for every change made to the resource. This attribute will be present only if the resource has been updated after 2016-09-28.<br>|
|updated_at|integer(unix-time)|false|none|Timestamp indicating when this e-invoice was last updated. This attribute will be present only if the resource has been updated after 2016-09-28.<br>|
|deleted|boolean|true|none|Indicates that this resource has been deleted.<br>|
|provider_references|[object]|false|none|List of key-value pairs from the e-invoicing provider (for example, a Receipt Message ID).<br>|
|business_entity_id|string|false|none|The unique ID of the [business entity](/docs/api/advanced-features) of this e-invoice. Same as the business entity of the parent invoice or credit note.<br>|
|artifacts|[object]|false|none|List of e-invoice artifacts related to this e-invoice (for example application responses).<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|entity_type|invoice|
|entity_type|credit_note|
|status|scheduled|
|status|skipped|
|status|in_progress|
|status|success|
|status|failed|
|status|registered|
|status|accepted|
|status|rejected|
|status|message_acknowledgement|
|status|in_process|
|status|under_query|
|status|conditionally_accepted|
|status|paid|

<h2 id="tocS_EmailLog">EmailLog</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaemaillog"></a>
<a id="schema_EmailLog"></a>
<a id="tocSemaillog"></a>
<a id="tocsemaillog"></a>

